1.6.3.s:
daśāvarā rātrīr uṣitvā sahadhanaḥ prayāsyann ādhāyāneyāny anapohyāny apoddhṛtyordhvam̐ prātarāhuteḥ sarveṣu yukteṣu \\ amīvahā vāstoṣpate \ vāstoṣpate \\ ity ete nigadyāhutiṃ juhoti /
tubhyaṃ tā aṅgirastama \ viśvāḥ sukṣitayaḥ pṛthak / \ agne kāmāya yemire //
iti dvitīyām /
1.6.3.d:
दशावरा रात्रीर् उषित्वा सहधनः प्रयास्यन्न् आधायानेयान्य् अनपोह्यान्य् अपोद्धृत्योर्ध्वम्̐ प्रातराहुतेः सर्वेषु युक्तेषु \\ अमीवहा वास्तोष्पते \ वास्तोष्पते \\ इत्य् एते निगद्याहुतिं जुहोति /
तुभ्यं ता अङ्गिरस्तम \ विश्वाः सुक्षितयः पृथक् / \ अग्ने कामाय येमिरे //
इति द्वितीयाम् /
1.6.3.m:
Having dwelt at least ten nights, when about to depart with his property, having loaded the things to be taken, having set aside the things not to be abandoned, after the morning offering, when all [the draught animals] are harnessed, having recited 'O slayer of disease, Lord of the dwelling! O Lord of the dwelling!', he offers an oblation.

'To you, O most Angiras-like, all those good dwellings singly / have yielded to your desire, O Agni.'

1.6.3.s: pravatsyan \\ ayaṃ te yonir ṛtviyas \\ ity araṇyoḥ samāropayati / yadi gataśrīḥ sarvān //
1.6.3.d: प्रवत्स्यन् \\ अयं ते योनिर् ऋत्वियस् \\ इत्य् अरण्योः समारोपयति / यदि गतश्रीः सर्वान् //
1.6.3.m: When about to set out on a journey, he mounts [the fires] into the two churning sticks with: 'This is your seasonal womb...'; if he is one who has attained prosperity, [he mounts] all [the fires].

1.6.3.s: yā te agne yajñiyā tanūs tayehi \\ ārohātmanātmānam achā \ vasūni kurvann aryā purūṇi \ yajño bhūtvā yajñam āsīda svam̐ yoniṃ bhuva ājāyamānaḥ svakṣaya ehi \\ ity ātmani vā samāropayati /
1.6.3.d: या ते अग्ने यज्ञिया तनूस् तयेहि \\ आरोहात्मनात्मानम् अछा \ वसूनि कुर्वन्न् अर्या पुरूणि \ यज्ञो भूत्वा यज्ञम् आसीद स्वम्̐ योनिं भुव आजायमानः स्वक्षय एहि \\ इत्य् आत्मनि वा समारोपयति /
1.6.3.m: Or he mounts them into himself with: 'Agni, that sacrificial body of yours, with that come! Mount into me yourself through yourself! Making noble and many treasures, becoming sacrifice, sit upon the sacrifice! Coming into your own womb, the earth, being born, come into your own dwelling!'
Having caused the parts to be burned to be consumed, having set out, a wandering ascetic who travels with his sacrificial fires proceeds.

1.6.3.s:
upāvaroha jātavedaḥ punas tvam\ devebhyo havyā vahatu prajānan /
āyuḥ prajām̐ rayim asmāsu dhehi\ ajasro dīdihi no duroṇe //
iti manthiṣyañ japati /
1.6.3.d:
उपावरोह जातवेदः पुनस् त्वम्\ देवेभ्यो हव्या वहतु प्रजानन् /
आयुः प्रजाम्̐ रयिम् अस्मासु धेहि\ अजस्रो दीदिहि नो दुरोणे //
इति मन्थिष्यञ् जपति /
1.6.3.m:
'Descend again, O Jātavedas; / knowing, let him carry the offerings to the gods. /'

'Place in us lifespan, offspring, and wealth; / shine unceasingly in our home.'

1.6.3.s: evam evāharahar adhvānam eṣyan samāropayati \\ upāvaroha \\ iti ca //
1.6.3.d: एवम् एवाहरहर् अध्वानम् एष्यन् समारोपयति \\ उपावरोह \\ इति च //
1.6.3.m: In this very manner, day after day, when about to undertake a journey, he mounts [the fires], and [churns them down] with 'Descend...'

1.6.3.s: agnīñ jyotiṣmataḥ kuru \\ ity uktvā pravatsyañ jvalata upatiṣṭhate // ahirbudhnya mantraṃ me pāhi \ taṃ me gopāyāsmākaṃ punar āgamāt \\ ity āvasathyam upatiṣṭhate saprathaḥ sabhāṃ me pāhi tāṃ me gopāyāsmākaṃ punar āgamāt \\ iti sabhyam \\ paśūn me śam̐sya pāhi \\ ity āhavanīyam \\ prajāṃ me narya pāhi \\ iti gārhapatyam annaṃ me budhya pāhi \\ iti dakṣiṇāgnim //
1.6.3.d: अग्नीञ् ज्योतिष्मतः कुरु \\ इत्य् उक्त्वा प्रवत्स्यञ् ज्वलत उपतिष्ठते // अहिर्बुध्न्य मन्त्रं मे पाहि \ तं मे गोपायास्माकं पुनर् आगमात् \\ इत्य् आवसथ्यम् उपतिष्ठते सप्रथः सभां मे पाहि तां मे गोपायास्माकं पुनर् आगमात् \\ इति सभ्यम् \\ पशून् मे शम्̐स्य पाहि \\ इत्य् आहवनीयम् \\ प्रजां मे नर्य पाहि \\ इति गार्हपत्यम् अन्नं मे बुध्य पाहि \\ इति दक्षिणाग्निम् //
1.6.3.m: Having said, 'Make the fires bright', when about to set out on a journey, he reverences them while blazing: with 'O Ahirbudhnya, protect my sacred formula; guard it for me until our return', he reverences the āvasathya fire; with 'O wide-extending one, protect my assembly hall; guard it for me until our return', the sabhya fire; with 'O praiseworthy one, protect my cattle', the āhavanīya fire; with 'O protector of men, protect my offspring', the gārhapatya fire; with 'O wise one, protect my food', the southern fire.

1.6.3.s: imān me mitrāvaruṇau gṛhān gopāyatam̐ yuvam ity antarāgnī tiṣṭhañ japati /
1.6.3.d: इमान् मे मित्रावरुणौ गृहान् गोपायतम्̐ युवम् इत्य् अन्तराग्नी तिष्ठञ् जपति /
1.6.3.m: Standing between the two fires, he mutters: 'O Mitra and Varuṇa, do you two guard these dwellings of mine.'

1.6.3.s:
mama nāma prathamaṃ jātavedaḥ \ pitā mātā ca dadhatur nv agre /
tat tvaṃ bibhṛhi punar ā mamaitos \ tavāham agne bibharāṇi nāma //
ity āhavanīyam upatiṣṭhate /
1.6.3.d:
मम नाम प्रथमं जातवेदः \ पिता माता च दधतुर् न्व् अग्रे /
तत् त्वं बिभृहि पुनर् आ ममैतोस् \ तवाहम् अग्ने बिभराणि नाम //
इत्य् आहवनीयम् उपतिष्ठते /
1.6.3.m:
'My first name, O Jātavedas, / which father and mother gave [me] formerly, /'

'Hold that until my return; / I will bear your name, O Agni.'

With this he reverences the āhavanīya fire.

1.6.3.s:
mā pragāma patho vayam\ mā yajñād indra sominaḥ / \ mānta sthur no arātayaḥ //
ity abhipravrajyāgnisakāśe vācam̐ yachaty asakāśe [ vācam̐ ] visṛjati /
1.6.3.d:
मा प्रगाम पथो वयम्\ मा यज्ञाद् इन्द्र सोमिनः / \ मान्त स्थुर् नो अरातयः //
इत्य् अभिप्रव्रज्याग्निसकाशे वाचम्̐ यछत्य् असकाशे [ वाचम्̐ ] विसृजति /
1.6.3.m:
'May we not stray from the path, / nor from the sacrifice of Soma, O Indra! / Let not enemies bar our way!'

Having set out with this, within sight of the fires he restrains speech; out of sight [of the fires], he releases speech.
While dwelling away from home, at the time of the offering, he reverences the fires towards each quarter.

1.6.3.s:
viśvadānīm ābharantas\ anātureṇa manasā / \ agne mā te prativeśā riṣāma //
iti pratyetya samidhāv āharaty asakāśe vācam̐ yachaty agnisakāśe visṛjati //
1.6.3.d:
विश्वदानीम् आभरन्तस्\ अनातुरेण मनसा / \ अग्ने मा ते प्रतिवेशा रिषाम //
इति प्रत्येत्य समिधाव् आहरत्य् असकाशे वाचम्̐ यछत्य् अग्निसकाशे विसृजति //
1.6.3.m:
'Bringing [offerings] at all times / with an unperturbed mind, / O Agni, may we, your neighbors, not come to harm!'

Having returned with this, he brings two kindling-sticks; out of sight [of the fires], he restrains speech; within sight of the fires, he releases [speech].

1.6.3.s: agnim̐ samādhehi \\ ity uktvā bhasma tva upatiṣṭhate //
1.6.3.d: अग्निम्̐ समाधेहि \\ इत्य् उक्त्वा भस्म त्व उपतिष्ठते //
1.6.3.m: Having said, 'Put the fire together', he reverences the ashes.

1.6.3.s: ahirbudhnya mantraṃ me 'jugupas taṃ me punar dehi \\ ity āvasathyam upatiṣṭhate saprathaḥ sabhāṃ me 'jugupas tāṃ me punar dehi \\ iti sabhyam \\ paśūn me śam̐syājugupas \\ ity āhavanīyam \\ prajāṃ me naryājugupas \\ iti gārhapatyam annaṃ me budhyājugupas \\ iti dakṣiṇāgnim //
1.6.3.d: अहिर्बुध्न्य मन्त्रं मे ऽजुगुपस् तं मे पुनर् देहि \\ इत्य् आवसथ्यम् उपतिष्ठते सप्रथः सभां मे ऽजुगुपस् तां मे पुनर् देहि \\ इति सभ्यम् \\ पशून् मे शम्̐स्याजुगुपस् \\ इत्य् आहवनीयम् \\ प्रजां मे नर्याजुगुपस् \\ इति गार्हपत्यम् अन्नं मे बुध्याजुगुपस् \\ इति दक्षिणाग्निम् //
1.6.3.m: With 'O Ahirbudhnya, you have guarded my sacred formula; give it back to me', he reverences the āvasathya fire; with 'O wide-extending one, you have guarded my assembly hall; give it back to me', the sabhya fire; with 'O praiseworthy one, you have guarded my cattle', the āhavanīya fire; with 'O protector of men, you have guarded my offspring', the gārhapatya fire; with 'O wise one, you have guarded my food', the southern fire.

1.6.3.s: imān me mitrāvaruṇau gṛhāñ jugupatam̐ yuvam ity antarāgnī tiṣṭhañ japati /
1.6.3.d: इमान् मे मित्रावरुणौ गृहाञ् जुगुपतम्̐ युवम् इत्य् अन्तराग्नी तिष्ठञ् जपति /
1.6.3.m: Standing between the two fires, he mutters: 'O Mitra and Varuṇa, you two have guarded these dwellings of mine.'

1.6.3.s:
tava ca nāma mama ca jātavedas\ vāsasī iva vivasānau carāvaḥ /
te hi bibhṛvo mahase jīvase ca \ yathāyathaṃ nau tan nau jātavedaḥ //
iti samidho 'gniṣv ādadhat tūṣṇīm̐ sabhyāvasathyayoḥ /
1.6.3.d:
तव च नाम मम च जातवेदस्\ वाससी इव विवसानौ चरावः /
ते हि बिभृवो महसे जीवसे च \ यथायथं नौ तन् नौ जातवेदः //
इति समिधो ऽग्निष्व् आदधत् तूष्णीम्̐ सभ्यावसथ्ययोः /
1.6.3.m:
'Your name and mine, O Jātavedas, / wearing like two garments, let us go about; /'

'For we two bear them for greatness and for life; / properly for each other, that [is our bond], O Jātavedas!'

Putting the kindling-sticks into the fires with this, [he puts them] silently into the sabhya and āvasathya fires.

1.6.3.s: samilliṅgair itareṣūpasthāya cen na pravaset punaretyopatiṣṭheta /
1.6.3.d: समिल्लिङ्गैर् इतरेषूपस्थाय चेन् न प्रवसेत् पुनरेत्योपतिष्ठेत /
1.6.3.m: Having reverenced the other [fires] with verses containing the characteristic word 'kindling-stick', if he should not set out, he should reverence them after returning.

1.6.3.s:
yady anupasthitāgniḥ pravāsam āpadyeta
ihaiva sam̐s tatra santaṃ tvāgne \ hṛdā vācā manasā bibharmi /
tiro me yajña āyur mā prahāsīr \ vaiśvānarasya tvā cakṣuṣopatiṣṭhe //
ity upatiṣṭhate /
1.6.3.d:
यद्य् अनुपस्थिताग्निः प्रवासम् आपद्येत
इहैव सम्̐स् तत्र सन्तं त्वाग्ने \ हृदा वाचा मनसा बिभर्मि /
तिरो मे यज्ञ आयुर् मा प्रहासीर् \ वैश्वानरस्य त्वा चक्षुषोपतिष्ठे //
इत्य् उपतिष्ठते /
1.6.3.m:
If he should happen to go on a journey without having reverenced the fires, [then]:

'Being here, O Agni, you who are there / I bear with heart, voice, and mind; /'

'Do not forsake my sacrifice, [nor] my lifespan; / I reverence you with the eye of Vaiśvānara.'

1.6.4.s: parvaṇy āgrayaṇaṃ kurvīta vasante yavānāṃ śaradi vrīhīṇām /
1.6.4.d: पर्वण्य् आग्रयणं कुर्वीत वसन्ते यवानां शरदि व्रीहीणाम् /
1.6.4.m: On a new- or full-moon day, he should perform the Āgrayaṇa sacrifice: of barley in the spring, of rice in the autumn.
Having sacrificed of the first-fruits, he may eat of the new [grain].
He apportions [oblations] to Agni and Indra, to the Viśvedevas, and to Dyāvāpṛthivī.
In autumn, [he apportions an oblation] of millet to Soma in a different vessel.

1.6.4.s: nānābījānāṃ dharmam̐ vidhāsyāmo vaṣaṭkārapradānānāṃ caikakapālānāṃ ca /
1.6.4.d: नानाबीजानां धर्मम्̐ विधास्यामो वषट्कारप्रदानानां चैककपालानां च /
1.6.4.m: We shall prescribe the rule for different grains, for offerings made with the vaṣaṭ-call, and for single-potsherd cakes.
The touching of the different grains is performed separately.
He summons the preparer of the oblation over the principal ones.
Beginning with the pouring into the mortar up to the end of the dehusking [is done] for each one [separately]; up to the winnowing for barley.
He places twelve potsherds for [the cake to] Agni and Indra, and one for [the cake to] Dyāvāpṛthivī.
Having set [the milk] for Agni-Indra on the fire, he sets the boiled oblation for the Viśvedevas on the fire.

1.6.4.s: pavitrāntarhite paya ānīya taṇḍulān opyāṅguṣṭhaparvamātraṃ kūtīpalāśamātram̐ vā dyāvāpṛthivīyam adhiśritya saumyaṃ carum adhiśrayati /
1.6.4.d: पवित्रान्तर्हिते पय आनीय तण्डुलान् ओप्याङ्गुष्ठपर्वमात्रं कूतीपलाशमात्रम्̐ वा द्यावापृथिवीयम् अधिश्रित्य सौम्यं चरुम् अधिश्रयति /
1.6.4.m: Having poured milk into [a vessel] lined with a strainer and thrown in the rice grains, having placed [the cake] for Dyāvāpṛthivī on the fire—the size of a thumb-joint or of a *kūtīpalāśa* leaf—he places the boiled oblation for Soma on the fire.

1.6.4.s: pavitrāntarhite 'pa ānīya taṇḍulān opya mekṣaṇena pradakṣiṇaṃ carū śrapayati /
1.6.4.d: पवित्रान्तर्हिते ऽप आनीय तण्डुलान् ओप्य मेक्षणेन प्रदक्षिणं चरू श्रपयति /
1.6.4.m: Having poured water into [a vessel] lined with a strainer and thrown in the rice grains, he cooks the boiled oblations clockwise with the stirring stick.
While garnishing the single-potsherd cake in another dish, he covers it completely [with clarified butter].

1.6.4.s: pracaraṇavelāyāṃ barhiṣi sādayitvopastīryaikakapālam̐ sakṛt sarvam avadyati /
1.6.4.d: प्रचरणवेलायां बर्हिषि सादयित्वोपस्तीर्यैककपालम्̐ सकृत् सर्वम् अवद्यति /
1.6.4.m: At the time of proceeding, having placed [the oblations] on the sacrificial grass and having spread [clarified butter as an underlayer], he cuts off the single-potsherd cake entirely at once.

1.6.4.s: āśayasyānvāsicya dvir abhighāryopām̐śv ekakapālena pracarya vaṣaṭkṛte madhye pāṇinā juhoty ṛjuṃ pratiṣṭhitam āśayenābhijuhoti /
1.6.4.d: आशयस्यान्वासिच्य द्विर् अभिघार्योपाम्̐श्व् एककपालेन प्रचर्य वषट्कृते मध्ये पाणिना जुहोत्य् ऋजुं प्रतिष्ठितम् आशयेनाभिजुहोति /
1.6.4.m: Having poured after it from the resting-pan and basted twice with clarified butter, having proceeded with the single-potsherd cake in a whisper, when the *vaṣaṭ* call is uttered, he offers it with the hand in the middle [of the fire]; he pours [clarified butter] over it from the resting-pan while it is resting upright.
If it should turn over, it has been explained in the Brāhmaṇa.

1.6.4.s:
prāk sviṣṭakṛtaḥ ṣaḍ ājyāhutīr juhoti
śatāyudhāya śatavīryāya \ śatotaye 'bhimātiṣāhe /
śatam̐ yo naḥ śarado nayat\ indro viśvasya duritasya pāram //
ime catvāro rajaso vimāne\ antarā dyāvāpṛthivī viyantu panthānaḥ /
teṣām ajyānam̐ yatamo na āvahāt \ tasmai no devāḥ paridatta viśve //
vasanto grīṣmo madhumanti varṣāḥ \ śarad dhemantaḥ suvite dadhātu /
teṣām ṛtūnām̐ śataśāradānām\ nivāta eṣām abhayāḥ syāma //
sam̐vatsarāya parivatsarāyedāvatsarāyānuvatsarāyodvatsarāya kṛṇutā bṛhan namaḥ /
teṣām̐ vayam̐ sumatau yajñiyānām\ jyogjīvā ahatāḥ syāma //
iyam̐ svastiḥ sam̐vatsarīyā parivatsarīyedāvatsarīyānuvatsarīyodvatsarīyā /
sā naḥ pipartv ahṛṇīyamānā\ enāhnedam ahar aśīya //
ā naḥ prajāṃ janayatu prajāpatir iti ṣaṣṭhī /
1.6.4.d:
प्राक् स्विष्टकृतः षड् आज्याहुतीर् जुहोति
शतायुधाय शतवीर्याय \ शतोतये ऽभिमातिषाहे /
शतम्̐ यो नः शरदो नयत्\ इन्द्रो विश्वस्य दुरितस्य पारम् //
इमे चत्वारो रजसो विमाने\ अन्तरा द्यावापृथिवी वियन्तु पन्थानः /
तेषाम् अज्यानम्̐ यतमो न आवहात् \ तस्मै नो देवाः परिदत्त विश्वे //
वसन्तो ग्रीष्मो मधुमन्ति वर्षाः \ शरद् धेमन्तः सुविते दधातु /
तेषाम् ऋतूनाम्̐ शतशारदानाम्\ निवात एषाम् अभयाः स्याम //
सम्̐वत्सराय परिवत्सरायेदावत्सरायानुवत्सरायोद्वत्सराय कृणुता बृहन् नमः /
तेषाम्̐ वयम्̐ सुमतौ यज्ञियानाम्\ ज्योग्जीवा अहताः स्याम //
इयम्̐ स्वस्तिः सम्̐वत्सरीया परिवत्सरीयेदावत्सरीयानुवत्सरीयोद्वत्सरीया /
सा नः पिपर्त्व् अहृणीयमाना\ एनाह्नेदम् अहर् अशीय //
आ नः प्रजां जनयतु प्रजापतिर् इति षष्ठी /

1.6.4.m:
The sixth [verse is]: "May Prajāpati bring forth offspring for us..."

He cuts off [portions] from the resting-pan of the single-potsherd cake for the Sviṣṭakṛt offering and for the iḍā portion.
The sacrificer consumes [his part] of the iḍā portion:

1.6.4.s:
etam u tyaṃ madhunā sam̐yutam̐ yavam\ sarasvatyā adhi manāv acarkṛṣuḥ /
indra āsīt sīrapatiḥ śatakratuḥ \ kīnāśā āsan marutaḥ sudānavaḥ //
iti yavānām /
1.6.4.d:
एतम् उ त्यं मधुना सम्̐युतम्̐ यवम्\ सरस्वत्या अधि मनाव् अचर्कृषुः /
इन्द्र आसीत् सीरपतिः शतक्रतुः \ कीनाशा आसन् मरुतः सुदानवः //
इति यवानाम् /
1.6.4.m:
"Indeed, that barley mixed with honey, / which they plowed along the Sarasvatī under Manu;

Indra of a hundred rites was the lord of the plow; / the generous Maruts were the plowmen"—

1.6.4.s:
bhadrānnaḥ śreyaḥ samanaiṣṭa devās \ tvayāvasena samaśīmahi tvā /
sa no mayobhūḥ pitur āviveśa \ śivas tokāya tanvo na edhi //
iti vrīhīṇām /
1.6.4.d:
भद्रान्नः श्रेयः समनैष्ट देवास् \ त्वयावसेन समशीमहि त्वा /
स नो मयोभूः पितुर् आविवेश \ शिवस् तोकाय तन्वो न एधि //
इति व्रीहीणाम् /
1.6.4.m:
"The gods have led us from good to better; / through thee as our food may we reach thee!

May it enter us, bringing delight to the father; / be auspicious to our progeny and to our body!"—

1.6.4.s:
agniḥ prāśnātu prathamaḥ \ sa hi veda yathā haviḥ /
śivā asmabhyam oṣadhīḥ \ kṛṇotu viśvacarṣaṇiḥ //
iti śyāmākānām̐ vasante veṇuyavānām /
1.6.4.d:
अग्निः प्राश्नातु प्रथमः \ स हि वेद यथा हविः /
शिवा अस्मभ्यम् ओषधीः \ कृणोतु विश्वचर्षणिः //
इति श्यामाकानाम्̐ वसन्ते वेणुयवानाम् /

1.6.4.m: A first-born calf is the sacrificial gift.

1.6.4.s: bubhukṣan śyāmākeneṣṭvā babhruṃ piṅgalam̐ vatsataraṃ dadyād vasanaṃ ca /
1.6.4.d: बुभुक्षन् श्यामाकेनेष्ट्वा बभ्रुं पिङ्गलम्̐ वत्सतरं दद्याद् वसनं च /
1.6.4.m: One who desires food, having sacrificed with *śyāmāka* grain, should give a brown, reddish-brown young bull and a garment.

1.6.5.s: āhiteṣu vyṛdhyamānaḥ pūrvāṃ paurṇamāsīm upoṣyāgnaye vaiśvānarāya dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet /
1.6.5.d: आहितेषु व्यृध्यमानः पूर्वां पौर्णमासीम् उपोष्याग्नये वैश्वानराय द्वादशकपालं निर्वपेत् /
1.6.5.m: If he suffers misfortune after the fires have been established, having fasted on the previous full-moon day, he should apportion a twelve-potsherd cake to Agni Vaiśvānara.
On the full-moon day, he should let them go while blazing.
The re-establishment [of the fires] is explained by the establishment of the fires.
We shall set forth the modifications.

1.6.5.s: yathāmnātam̐ varṣāsu śaradi punarvasvor anurādhāsu vā /
1.6.5.d: यथाम्नातम्̐ वर्षासु शरदि पुनर्वस्वोर् अनुराधासु वा /
1.6.5.m: As handed down: in the rainy season, in the autumn, or under the Punarvasus or Anurādhās.
Among the materials, he should make coarse grass into reed-grass.

1.6.5.s: parigītaṃ parigītam̐ // yat tvā kruddhaḥ parovapa manyunā \\ iti tisṛbhis triḥ saminddhe //
1.6.5.d: परिगीतं परिगीतम्̐ // यत् त्वा क्रुद्धः परोवप मन्युना \\ इति तिसृभिस् त्रिः समिन्द्धे //
1.6.5.m: He kindles [the fire] three times, sung around each time, with three [verses]: "Because in anger, with wrath, I scattered thee away..."

1.6.5.s: punas tvādityā rudrā vasavaḥ samindhatām iti prāk pūrṇāhuteḥ ṣaṭ saṃtatihomāñ juhoti /
1.6.5.d: पुनस् त्वादित्या रुद्रा वसवः समिन्धताम् इति प्राक् पूर्णाहुतेः षट् संततिहोमाञ् जुहोति /
1.6.5.m: Before the full offering, he offers six continuity offerings with: "May the Ādityas, Rudras, and Vasus kindle thee again..."

1.6.5.s: āgneyam eva pañcakapālam̐ vibhaktīḥ prayājānuyājeṣv āgneyāv ājayabhāgau //
1.6.5.d: आग्नेयम् एव पञ्चकपालम्̐ विभक्तीः प्रयाजानुयाजेष्व् आग्नेयाव् आजयभागौ //
1.6.5.m: There is only a five-potsherd cake for Agni, case-endings in the fore-offerings and after-offerings, and two clarified butter portions for Agni.

1.6.5.s: punar ūrjā nivartasva \\ iti purastāt prayājānām āhutiṃ juhoti
1.6.5.d: पुनर् ऊर्जा निवर्तस्व \\ इति पुरस्तात् प्रयाजानाम् आहुतिं जुहोति
1.6.5.m: Before the fore-offerings he offers an oblation with: "Return again with strength..."

1.6.5.s: dakṣiṇākāle punarutsyūtam̐ vāso deyaṃ punarṇavo rathaḥ punarutsṛṣṭo 'naḍvān sauvarṇaśātamāniko rukmo 'gnyādheyikyaś ca dakṣiṇāḥ //
1.6.5.d: दक्षिणाकाले पुनरुत्स्यूतम्̐ वासो देयं पुनर्णवो रथः पुनरुत्सृष्टो ऽनड्वान् सौवर्णशातमानिको रुक्मो ऽग्न्याधेयिक्यश् च दक्षिणाः //
1.6.5.m: At the time of the sacrificial gift, a resewn garment is to be given, a renovated chariot, a released ox, a golden ornament weighing a hundred *mānas*, and the sacrificial gifts belonging to the establishment of the fires.

1.6.5.s: saha rayyā nivartasva \\ ity upariṣṭād anuyājānāṃ catasra āhutīr juhoti /
1.6.5.d: सह रय्या निवर्तस्व \\ इत्य् उपरिष्टाद् अनुयाजानां चतस्र आहुतीर् जुहोति /
1.6.5.m: After the after-offerings he offers four oblations with: "Return with wealth..."
When [the fires] are interrupted without intention, he should not perform the kindling verses.
The introductory sacrifice is performed everywhere; the introductory sacrifice is performed everywhere.

1.7.1.s: cāturmāsyāny ārapsyamānaḥ pūrvā paurṇamāsīm upoṣyāgnaye vaiśvānarāya dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapati pārjanyaṃ ca carum /
1.7.1.d: चातुर्मास्यान्य् आरप्स्यमानः पूर्वा पौर्णमासीम् उपोष्याग्नये वैश्वानराय द्वादशकपालं निर्वपति पार्जन्यं च चरुम् /
1.7.1.m: One about to begin the four-monthly sacrifices, having fasted on the previous full-moon day, apportions a twelve-potsherd cake to Agni Vaiśvānara and a boiled oblation to Parjanya.
About to bring forward the water, he recites the five-priest formula mentally and offers.
A milch-cow and an ox are the sacrificial gift.
The sacrifice concludes when completed.

1.7.1.s: prācīnapravaṇe vaiśvadevena yajeta phālgunyāṃ caitryām̐ vasante vā /
1.7.1.d: प्राचीनप्रवणे वैश्वदेवेन यजेत फाल्गुन्यां चैत्र्याम्̐ वसन्ते वा /
1.7.1.m: One should sacrifice with the Vaiśvadeva on ground sloping to the east, on the full-moon day of Phālguna, or of Caitra, or in spring.
On the preparation day of the four-monthly sacrifices, the sacrificer does not have his hair and beard shaved.
Having fetched a branch for one who has undertaken the vow, he separates the calves.

1.7.1.s: āpyāyadhvam aghnyā devebhyo viśvebhyo devebhyo bhāgam iti gāḥ prārpayati /
1.7.1.d: आप्यायध्वम् अघ्न्या देवेभ्यो विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यो भागम् इति गाः प्रार्पयति /
1.7.1.m: He drives the cows forward with: "Swell, O inviolable ones, for the gods, a portion for the All-Gods!"

1.7.1.s: prasūnaḥ prastaraḥ / tredhā saṃnaddham idhmābarhir dvau bhāgau tūṣṇīm̐ saṃnahyāsaṃnaddhaṃ tṛtīyaṃ tad ekadhā mantreṇa saṃnahyati tūṣṇīm idhmam /
1.7.1.d: प्रसूनः प्रस्तरः / त्रेधा संनद्धम् इध्माबर्हिर् द्वौ भागौ तूष्णीम्̐ संनह्यासंनद्धं तृतीयं तद् एकधा मन्त्रेण संनह्यति तूष्णीम् इध्मम् /
1.7.1.m: The sacred grass bundle is flowered. The sacrificial fuel and sacrificial grass are tied in three parts: having tied two parts silently, the third untied [part]—he ties that together as one with a sacred formula; the sacrificial fuel silently.

1.7.1.s: tisṛṣu dugdhāsu bahu dugdhi viśvebhyo devebhyo havir iti trir uktvā vācam̐ visṛjate //
1.7.1.d: तिसृषु दुग्धासु बहु दुग्धि विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यो हविर् इति त्रिर् उक्त्वा वाचम्̐ विसृजते //
1.7.1.m: When three [cows] are milked, having said three times: "Yield abundantly the oblation for the All-Gods!", he releases his speech.

1.7.1.s: viśvebhyas tvā devebhyo bhāgaṃ somenātanacmi \\ ity ātanakti /
1.7.1.d: विश्वेभ्यस् त्वा देवेभ्यो भागं सोमेनातनच्मि \\ इत्य् आतनक्ति /
1.7.1.m: He curdles it with: "For the All-Gods, as their share, I curdle thee with Soma."
[The procedure is] established up to the employment of the vessels.

1.7.1.s: carukapālaṃ prayunakti dvitīyam ājyasthālīṃ pṛṣadājyāya srucaṃ copabhṛto 'nantarā /
1.7.1.d: चरुकपालं प्रयुनक्ति द्वितीयम् आज्यस्थालीं पृषदाज्याय स्रुचं चोपभृतो ऽनन्तरा /
1.7.1.m: He sets out the pot for the boiled oblation, a second [pot], a clarified-butter pot for the spotted butter, and a ladle right after the upabhṛt.

1.7.1.s: āgneyo 'ṣṭākapāla itiprabhṛtīni pañca nirvapati marudbhyaḥ svatavadbhyaḥ saptakapālaṃ dyāvāpṛthivīyam ekakapālam /
1.7.1.d: आग्नेयो ऽष्टाकपाल इतिप्रभृतीनि पञ्च निर्वपति मरुद्भ्यः स्वतवद्भ्यः सप्तकपालं द्यावापृथिवीयम् एककपालम् /
1.7.1.m: He apportions five [oblations] beginning with the eight-potsherd [cake] for Agni, a seven-potsherd [cake] for the powerful Maruts, [and] a one-potsherd [cake] for Dyāvāpṛthivī.
Before pouring [the grains], he sets aside those destined for the boiled oblations.
Having poured out [the grains], he places the potsherds [on the fire].
From among those winnowed, he sets aside flour for Pūṣan.
In boiled oblations, Pūṣan receives flour everywhere.
He sets the oblations on the fire in succession.

1.7.1.s: mārutam adhiśritya tapte prātardohe sāyaṃdoham ānīyāmikṣāṃ karoti /
1.7.1.d: मारुतम् अधिश्रित्य तप्ते प्रातर्दोहे सायंदोहम् आनीयामिक्षां करोति /
1.7.1.m: Having put [the cake] for the Maruts on the fire, he pours the evening milk into the heated morning milk and makes the curd mixture.
By this, the curd mixture is explained everywhere.

1.7.1.s: ājyaṃ nirupya pṛṣadājyāya dadhi nirvapati samānadharmam ājyena /
1.7.1.d: आज्यं निरुप्य पृषदाज्याय दधि निर्वपति समानधर्मम् आज्येन /
1.7.1.m: Having apportioned the clarified butter, he apportions curd for the spotted butter, with the same procedure as for clarified butter.
[The ritual is] established up to the cleansing of the ladles.
The cleansing of the upabhṛt and of the vessel for spotted butter is the same.
[The ritual is] established up to the drawing of the clarified butter.

1.7.1.s: caturgṛhītāny ājyāni pṛṣadājyadhānyāṃ dvir upastīrya dadhy ānīya sakṛd abhighārayan pṛṣat karoti /
1.7.1.d: चतुर्गृहीतान्य् आज्यानि पृषदाज्यधान्यां द्विर् उपस्तीर्य दध्य् आनीय सकृद् अभिघारयन् पृषत् करोति /
1.7.1.m: Having spread an underlayer twice in the vessel for spotted butter with the portions of clarified butter drawn four times, he pours in the curd and, basting it once with clarified butter, makes it spotted butter.
In the rainy season, he should spread an underlayer once and baste twice.
[The ritual is] established up to the depositing of the clarified butter portions.
The depositing of the upabhṛt and of the vessel for spotted butter is the same.

1.7.1.s: prāg abhighāraṇād āmikṣām̐ vivājināṃ kṛtvotkare vājinam āsādayati /
1.7.1.d: प्राग् अभिघारणाद् आमिक्षाम्̐ विवाजिनां कृत्वोत्करे वाजिनम् आसादयति /
1.7.1.m: Before basting with clarified butter, having separated the whey from the curd mixture, he places the whey on the heap of rubbish.
Having adorned [them], he brings the oblations near in succession.
Before the touching, he proceeds with the churned [fire].

1.7.1.s: uttarasya paścātparidhisaṃdher agner janitram asi \\ ity adhimanthanam̐ śakalam avasthāpayati //
1.7.1.d: उत्तरस्य पश्चात्परिधिसंधेर् अग्नेर् जनित्रम् असि \\ इत्य् अधिमन्थनम्̐ शकलम् अवस्थापयति //
1.7.1.m: With the mantra, "You are the birthplace of Agni," he places the churning-chip behind the northern junction of the enclosing sticks.

1.7.1.s: vṛṣaṇau sthas \\ iti tatra prāñcāv aprachinnaprāntau darbhau nidhāya \\ urvaśy asi \\ iti tayor udaktūlām adharāraṇiṃ paścāt prajananāṃ mūlata uttarāraṇim āyur asi \\ ity ājyasthālyā [ ājyena ] bile snehayám̐s triḥ samanakti //
1.7.1.d: वृषणौ स्थस् \\ इति तत्र प्राञ्चाव् अप्रछिन्नप्रान्तौ दर्भौ निधाय \\ उर्वश्य् असि \\ इति तयोर् उदक्तूलाम् अधरारणिं पश्चात् प्रजननां मूलत उत्तरारणिम् आयुर् असि \\ इत्य् आज्यस्थाल्या [ आज्येन ] बिले स्नेहय्áम्̐स् त्रिः समनक्ति //
1.7.1.m: With "You two are the testicles," having placed there two darbha blades pointing eastward with uncut tips, with "You are Urvaśī," [he places] upon them the lower churning stick with its tips pointing northward and its socket to the west; with "You are Āyus," moistening the upper churning stick at its base in the socket with [clarified butter] from the clarified-butter pot, he anoints it three times.
With "You are Purūravas," he joins [them].
He prompts [the hotṛ]: "Recite for Agni as he is being churned."

1.7.1.s: gāyatram asi \ triṣṭub asi \ jagad asi \\ iti pradakṣiṇaṃ trir adhimanthati //
1.7.1.d: गायत्रम् असि \ त्रिष्टुब् असि \ जगद् असि \\ इति प्रदक्षिणं त्रिर् अधिमन्थति //
1.7.1.m: With "You are the Gāyatrī," "You are the Triṣṭubh," "You are the Jagatī," he churns clockwise three times.
When it is being carried forward, [he prompts]: "[Recite] for Agni as he is being carried forward."

1.7.1.s: agreṇottaraṃ paridhim anvavahṛtyānvārabdhe yajamāne vācayan bhavataṃ naḥ samanasau \\ iti svāhākārāntena prahṛtya śakalam agnāv adhyasyati //
1.7.1.d: अग्रेणोत्तरं परिधिम् अन्ववहृत्यान्वारब्धे यजमाने वाचयन् भवतं नः समनसौ \\ इति स्वाहाकारान्तेन प्रहृत्य शकलम् अग्नाव् अध्यस्यति //
1.7.1.m: Bringing [the fire] down in front along the northern enclosing stick, while the sacrificer holds onto him from behind, making him recite, he throws [the fire] with the mantra ending in Svāhā: "Be of one mind with us," and tosses the chip onto the fire.
With "Agni moves within Agni," he offers an oblation [of clarified butter] with the sruva ladle.
Having deposited the full sruva ladle, he makes [the sacrificer] touch the seasonal offerings with the pañcahotṛ formula.

1.7.2.s: siddham ā prayājebhyaḥ /
1.7.2.d: सिद्धम् आ प्रयाजेभ्यः /
1.7.2.m: [The ritual is] established up to the fore-offerings.

1.7.2.s: āśrāvaṃ nava prayājān yajati /
1.7.2.d: आश्रावं नव प्रयाजान् यजति /
1.7.2.m: Having called for the response, he offers nine fore-offerings.

1.7.2.s: trīn hutvā samānayati trīn hutvā samānayati / dvau hutvā sarvam̐ samānīyaikam̐ hutvātyākramyānupūrvam̐ havīm̐ṣy abhighārayaty antataḥ pṛṣadājyaṃ nopabhṛtam /
1.7.2.d: त्रीन् हुत्वा समानयति त्रीन् हुत्वा समानयति / द्वौ हुत्वा सर्वम्̐ समानीयैकम्̐ हुत्वात्याक्रम्यानुपूर्वम्̐ हवीम्̐ष्य् अभिघारयत्य् अन्ततः पृषदाज्यं नोपभृतम् /
1.7.2.m: Having offered three, he pours together; having offered three, he pours together; having offered two, he pours all together; having offered one, stepping across, he bastes the oblations in succession; at the end [he bastes] the spotted butter, not the upabhṛt.

1.7.2.s: siddham ā pracaraṇāt /
1.7.2.d: सिद्धम् आ प्रचरणात् /

1.7.2.s: upām̐śu sāvitraikakapālābhyāṃ pracarati /
1.7.2.d: उपाम्̐शु सावित्रैककपालाभ्यां प्रचरति /
1.7.2.m: He proceeds in a whisper with [the cake] for Savitṛ and the one-potsherd cake.

1.7.2.s: siddham ā sviṣṭakṛtaḥ /
1.7.2.d: सिद्धम् आ स्विष्टकृतः /

1.7.2.s: prāk sviṣṭakṛtas \\ madhave svāhā \\ itiprabhṛtīni māsanāmāni juhoti catvāri vaiśvadeve catvāri varuṇapraghāseṣu catvāri sākamedheṣvekam̐ śunāsīrye /
1.7.2.d: प्राक् स्विष्टकृतस् \\ मधवे स्वाहा \\ इतिप्रभृतीनि मासनामानि जुहोति चत्वारि वैश्वदेवे चत्वारि वरुणप्रघासेषु चत्वारि साकमेधेष्वेकम्̐ शुनासीर्ये /
1.7.2.m: Before the Sviṣṭakṛt offering, he offers the names of the months beginning with: "To Madhu, svāhā!"—four at the Vaiśvadeva, four at the Varuṇapraghāsa, four at the Sākamedha, [and] one at the Śunāsīrya.

1.7.2.s: dakṣiṇākāle vatsaḥ prathamajo dakṣiṇā /
1.7.2.d: दक्षिणाकाले वत्सः प्रथमजो दक्षिणा /
1.7.2.m: At the time of the sacrificial gifts, a first-born calf is the sacrificial gift.

1.7.2.s: siddham ānuyājebhyaḥ /
1.7.2.d: सिद्धम् आनुयाजेभ्यः /

1.7.2.s: pṛṣadājyaṃ juhvām ānīyāśrāvaṃ navānuyājān yajati /
1.7.2.d: पृषदाज्यं जुह्वाम् आनीयाश्रावं नवानुयाजान् यजति /
1.7.2.m: Pouring the spotted butter into the juhū and having called for the response, he offers nine after-offerings.

1.7.2.s: vājavatyopabhṛtā saha pṛṣadājyadhānīṃ nigṛhṇāti vyudgṛhṇāti saṃpragṛhṇāti nirasyati //
1.7.2.d: वाजवत्योपभृता सह पृषदाज्यधानीं निगृह्णाति व्युद्गृह्णाति संप्रगृह्णाति निरस्यति //
1.7.2.m: Together with the upabhṛt with the vājavatī verse, he holds down the spotted butter vessel, raises it, holds it firmly together, and casts it away.

1.7.2.s: ghṛtācyau stho yajamānasya dhuryau pātam iti vedyam̐sayoḥ srucau vimuñcati /
1.7.2.d: घृताच्यौ स्थो यजमानस्य धुर्यौ पातम् इति वेद्यम्̐सयोः स्रुचौ विमुञ्चति /
1.7.2.m: With "You two are full of ghee; protect the yoked bearers of the sacrificer," he puts down the two ladles on the shoulders of the altar.

1.7.2.s: sruci camase vāntarvedy ūrdhvas tiṣṭhan barhir anuviṣiñcan vājinaṃ gṛhṇāti //
1.7.2.d: स्रुचि चमसे वान्तर्वेद्य् ऊर्ध्वस् तिष्ठन् बर्हिर् अनुविषिञ्चन् वाजिनं गृह्णाति //
1.7.2.m: In a ladle or in a cup, standing upright within the altar and sprinkling over the sacrificial grass, he takes the whey.

1.7.2.s: vājibhyo 'nubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati /
1.7.2.d: वाजिभ्यो ऽनुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति /
1.7.2.m: He prompts [the hotṛ]: "Recite for the Vājins."

1.7.2.s: āśrāvya vājino yaja \\ iti preṣyati /
1.7.2.d: आश्राव्य वाजिनो यज \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
1.7.2.m: Having called for the response, he gives the call: "Sacrifice to the Vājins!"

1.7.2.s: vaṣaṭkṛtānuvaṣṭkṛte hutvoccheṣeṇa diśaḥ pratiyajati diśaḥ svāhā \\ iti dikṣu pūrvārdhād upakramya pradakṣiṇaṃ pañcamena madhye ṣaṣṭhena pūrvārdhe /
1.7.2.d: वषट्कृतानुवष्ट्कृते हुत्वोच्छेषेण दिशः प्रतियजति दिशः स्वाहा \\ इति दिक्षु पूर्वार्धाद् उपक्रम्य प्रदक्षिणं पञ्चमेन मध्ये षष्ठेन पूर्वार्धे /
1.7.2.m: Having offered at the vaṣaṭ-call and the second vaṣaṭ-call, with the remainder he makes offerings to the quarters, starting from the eastern quarter clockwise with "To the quarters, svāhā!", with the fifth in the middle, [and] with the sixth in the eastern quarter.

1.7.2.s: śeṣam̐ samadhā vibhajya \\ upahūtopahvayasva \\ ity uktvā \\ upahūtā upahvayadhvam iti vā /
1.7.2.d: शेषम्̐ समधा विभज्य \\ उपहूतोपह्वयस्व \\ इत्य् उक्त्वा \\ उपहूता उपह्वयध्वम् इति वा /
1.7.2.m: Dividing the remainder into equal portions, having said, "Invited, do you invite," or "Invited ones, do you invite,"

1.7.2.s:
ā mā viśantv indavas \\ ā galdā dhamanīnām /
rasena me rasaṃ pṛṇa \ vājino me yajñam̐ vahān //
ity ṛtvijaḥ prāśnanti yajamānaś ca / hotā prathamo bhakṣayate /
1.7.2.d:
आ मा विशन्त्व् इन्दवस् \\ आ गल्दा धमनीनाम् /
रसेन मे रसं पृण \ वाजिनो मे यज्ञम्̐ वहान् //
इत्य् ऋत्विजः प्राश्नन्ति यजमानश् च / होता प्रथमो भक्षयते /
1.7.2.m:
with:
"May the drops enter me, the trickling stream of the veins;
fill my sap with sap; may the Vājins convey my sacrifice,"
the officiating priests and the sacrificer eat; the hotṛ priest consumes first.

1.7.2.s: siddham ā samiṣṭayajuṣaḥ /
1.7.2.d: सिद्धम् आ समिष्टयजुषः /
1.7.2.m: [The ritual is] established up to the samiṣṭayajus formulas.

1.7.2.s: dvir dhruvām āpyāyya \\ eṣa te yajñas \\ devā gātuvidas \\ iti dve samiṣṭayajuṣī juhoti //
1.7.2.d: द्विर् ध्रुवाम् आप्याय्य \\ एष ते यज्ञस् \\ देवा गातुविदस् \\ इति द्वे समिष्टयजुषी जुहोति //
1.7.2.m: Having replenished the dhruvā ladle twice, he offers the two samiṣṭayajus formulas: "This is your sacrifice..." and "O path-finding gods..."

1.7.2.s: sam̐vatsarīyām̐ svastim āśāse \\ ity āha yajamānaḥ /
1.7.2.d: सम्̐वत्सरीयाम्̐ स्वस्तिम् आशासे \\ इत्य् आह यजमानः /
1.7.2.m: The sacrificer says: "I pray for a year's welfare."

1.7.2.s: siddheṣṭiḥ saṃtiṣṭhate /
1.7.2.d: सिद्धेष्टिः संतिष्ठते /
1.7.2.m: The established sacrifice is concluded.

1.7.2.s:
sadyaḥ paurṇamāsīm̐ sam̐sthāpya
ṛtam eva parameṣṭhi \\ ṛtaṃ nātyeti kiṃcana /
ṛte samudra āhitaḥ \ samudreṇa pṛthivī dṛḍhā //
agnis tigmena śociṣā \ tapa ākrāntam uṣṇihā /
śiras tapasy āhitam \\ vaiśvānarasya tejasi //
ṛtenāsya nivartaya \ satyena parivartaya \ tapasāsyānuvartaya /
śivenāsyopavartaya \ śagmenāsyābhivartaya //
iti triśyetayā śalalyā lauhāyasena kṣureṇa nivartayati keśān vapati śmaśrūṇi //
1.7.2.d:
सद्यः पौर्णमासीम्̐ सम्̐स्थाप्य
ऋतम् एव परमेष्ठि \\ ऋतं नात्येति किंचन /
ऋते समुद्र आहितः \ समुद्रेण पृथिवी दृढा //
अग्निस् तिग्मेन शोचिषा \ तप आक्रान्तम् उष्णिहा /
शिरस् तपस्य् आहितम् \\ वैश्वानरस्य तेजसि //
ऋतेनास्य निवर्तय \ सत्येन परिवर्तय \ तपसास्यानुवर्तय /
शिवेनास्योपवर्तय \ शग्मेनास्याभिवर्तय //
इति त्रिश्येतया शलल्या लौहायसेन क्षुरेण निवर्तयति केशान् वपति श्मश्रूणि //

1.7.2.s: tad ṛtam \\ tat satyam \\ tañ śakeyam \\ tena śakeyam \\ tena rādhyāsam \\ tan me rādhyatām iti japati yajamānaḥ /
1.7.2.d: तद् ऋतम् \\ तत् सत्यम् \\ तञ् शकेयम् \\ तेन शकेयम् \\ तेन राध्यासम् \\ तन् मे राध्यताम् इति जपति यजमानः /
1.7.2.m: The sacrificer mutters: "That is cosmic order; that is truth; may I be capable of that; by that may I be able; through that may I succeed; may that succeed for me."

1.7.2.s: caturo māsān na mām̐sam aśnāti na striyam upaiti noparyāste / jugupsetānṛtāt prāṅ śete / madhv aśnāty ṛtau bhāryām upaiti /
1.7.2.d: चतुरो मासान् न माम्̐सम् अश्नाति न स्त्रियम् उपैति नोपर्यास्ते / जुगुप्सेतानृतात् प्राङ् शेते / मध्व् अश्नात्य् ऋतौ भार्याम् उपैति /
1.7.2.m: For four months he does not eat meat, does not approach a woman, does not sit on a raised seat; he should shrink from falsehood; he sleeps facing east; he eats honey; he approaches his wife in her season.

1.7.3.s: varuṇapraghāsāś caturṣu māseṣu /
1.7.3.d: वरुणप्रघासाश् चतुर्षु मासेषु /
1.7.3.m: The Varuṇapraghāsa rites take place in four months.

1.7.3.s: vaiśvadevikam̐ vidhānam /
1.7.3.d: वैश्वदेविकम्̐ विधानम् /
1.7.3.m: The ritual procedure is that of the Vaiśvadeva [sacrifice].

1.7.3.s: pañca saṃcarāṇām /
1.7.3.d: पञ्च संचराणाम् /

1.7.3.s: mārutyai pratiprasthātā vatsān apākaroty adhvaryur vāruṇyai /
1.7.3.d: मारुत्यै प्रतिप्रस्थाता वत्सान् अपाकरोत्य् अध्वर्युर् वारुण्यै /
1.7.3.m: The pratiprasthātṛ drives away the calves for the [offering] to the Maruts; the adhvaryu, for the [offering] to Varuṇa.

1.7.3.s: pṛthag idhmābarhiṣī saṃnahyataḥ / sakṛt saṃnaddhaṃ pratiprasthātā /
1.7.3.d: पृथग् इध्माबर्हिषी संनह्यतः / सकृत् संनद्धं प्रतिप्रस्थाता /
1.7.3.m: They bind the sacrificial fuel and sacrificial grass separately. The pratiprasthātṛ binds it once.

1.7.3.s: yathākālaṃ pṛthag dohayataḥ /
1.7.3.d: यथाकालं पृथग् दोहयतः /
1.7.3.m: At the proper time they milk separately.

1.7.3.s: siddham ā pātraprayojanāt /
1.7.3.d: सिद्धम् आ पात्रप्रयोजनात् /
1.7.3.m: It is established up to the setting out of the utensils.

1.7.3.s: pṛthak pātrāṇi prayunakti sruvapañcamāḥ srucaḥ pratiprasthātā dve carusthālyau sphyam̐ vedaṃ ca /
1.7.3.d: पृथक् पात्राणि प्रयुनक्ति स्रुवपञ्चमाः स्रुचः प्रतिप्रस्थाता द्वे चरुस्थाल्यौ स्फ्यम्̐ वेदं च /
1.7.3.m: The pratiprasthātṛ sets out the utensils separately: the spoons with the sruva spoon as fifth, two pots for boiled oblation, the wooden sword, and the veda bundle.

1.7.3.s: siddham ā nirvapaṇāt /
1.7.3.d: सिद्धम् आ निर्वपणात् /

1.7.3.s: pañca saṃcarāṇi nirupyādhvaryur aindrāgnaṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapati kāyam ekakapālam /
1.7.3.d: पञ्च संचराणि निरुप्याध्वर्युर् ऐन्द्राग्नं द्वादशकपालं निर्वपति कायम् एककपालम् /
1.7.3.m: Having apportioned the five common oblations, the adhvaryu apportions [the oblation] on twelve potsherds for Indra and Agni, [and] the [cake] on one potsherd for Ka.

1.7.3.s: yathākālam āmikṣe pṛthak saṃpādayataḥ /
1.7.3.d: यथाकालम् आमिक्षे पृथक् संपादयतः /
1.7.3.m: At the proper time they prepare the two curd portions separately.

1.7.3.s: siddham ābhivāsanāt /
1.7.3.d: सिद्धम् आभिवासनात् /

1.7.3.s: piṣṭalepaṃ nidhāyāgreṇāhavanīyaṃ triṣu prakrameṣv aparimite vāvakāśe pṛṣṭhyāśaṅkuṃ nihatya vedādānaprabhṛti vedim̐ vidadhāti ṣaṭśayāṃ prācīṃ catuḥśayāṃ paścāt triśayāṃ purastāt /
1.7.3.d: पिष्टलेपं निधायाग्रेणाहवनीयं त्रिषु प्रक्रमेष्व् अपरिमिते वावकाशे पृष्ठ्याशङ्कुं निहत्य वेदादानप्रभृति वेदिम्̐ विदधाति षट्शयां प्राचीं चतुःशयां पश्चात् त्रिशयां पुरस्तात् /
1.7.3.m: Having placed down the dough scrapings, having driven in the spinal peg in front of the āhavanīya fire at three paces or in an unmeasured space, [the adhvaryu] arranges the altar beginning with the taking of the veda bundle: six spans long towards the east, four spans wide behind, [and] three spans wide in front.

1.7.3.s: pūrvārdhe vedyā vitṛtīyamātre 'ratnimātrīṃ caturdiṣṭim uttaravedim̐ vidadhāti /
1.7.3.d: पूर्वार्धे वेद्या वितृतीयमात्रे ऽरत्निमात्रीं चतुर्दिष्टिम् उत्तरवेदिम्̐ विदधाति /
1.7.3.m: In the eastern half of the altar, at the distance of one third, he arranges the high altar measuring a cubit [or] four spans.

1.7.3.s: agreṇotkaraṃ prakramamātre veder uddhaty āvokṣya cātvālam̐ śamyayā parimimīte taptāyanī me 'si \\ iti dakṣiṇatas \\ vittāyanī me 'si \\ iti paścāt \\ avatān mā nāthitam ity uttaratas \\ avatād vyathitam iti purastāt //
1.7.3.d: अग्रेणोत्करं प्रक्रममात्रे वेदेर् उद्धत्य् आवोक्ष्य चात्वालम्̐ शम्यया परिमिमीते तप्तायनी मे ऽसि \\ इति दक्षिणतस् \\ वित्तायनी मे ऽसि \\ इति पश्चात् \\ अवतान् मा नाथितम् इत्य् उत्तरतस् \\ अवताद् व्यथितम् इति पुरस्तात् //
1.7.3.m: In front of the rubbish heap, at the distance of a pace, having dug up from the altar and sprinkled with water, he measures out the cātvāla trench with the yoke-pin, [saying] to the south: 'You are Taptāyanī to me'; to the west: 'You are Vittāyanī to me'; to the north: 'May you protect me who am distressed'; to the east: 'May you protect the afflicted.'

1.7.3.s: agne aṅgiras \\ iti purastāt pratyaṅmukhaś cātvālam̐ sphyenābhihanti //
1.7.3.d: अग्ने अङ्गिरस् \\ इति पुरस्तात् प्रत्यङ्मुखश् चात्वालम्̐ स्फ्येनाभिहन्ति //
1.7.3.m: Facing west, from the east he strikes the cātvāla trench with the wooden sword, [saying:] 'O Agni, Aṅgiras.'

1.7.3.s: āyunā nāmnehi \\ iti pām̐sūn pāṇau kurute //
1.7.3.d: आयुना नाम्नेहि \\ इति पाम्̐सून् पाणौ कुरुते //
1.7.3.m: He takes dust in his hand, [saying:] 'Come with the name of living.'

1.7.3.s: vasavas tvā harantu \\ itiprabhṛtibhiḥ prāṅmukha uttaravedyāṃ nivapati // yo dvitīyasyām iti dvitīyam \\ yas tṛtīyasyām iti tṛtīyam̐ samānam anyat tūṣṇīṃ caturtham //
1.7.3.d: वसवस् त्वा हरन्तु \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिः प्राङ्मुख उत्तरवेद्यां निवपति // यो द्वितीयस्याम् इति द्वितीयम् \\ यस् तृतीयस्याम् इति तृतीयम्̐ समानम् अन्यत् तूष्णीं चतुर्थम् //
1.7.3.m: Facing east, he scatters it on the high altar with the [mantras] beginning with: 'May the Vasus bear you.' With 'Who in the second [heaven]' for the second [scattering]; with 'Who in the third [heaven]' for the third; the rest is identical; silently the fourth.

1.7.3.s: vider agne nabho nāma yat te \\ iti jānudaghnam ṛjuṃ caturasraṃ khātvottaravedyāṃ nivapati //
1.7.3.d: विदेर् अग्ने नभो नाम यत् ते \\ इति जानुदघ्नम् ऋजुं चतुरस्रं खात्वोत्तरवेद्यां निवपति //
1.7.3.m: Having dug [the trench] knee-deep, straight, [and] four-cornered, [saying:] 'May I know, O Agni, that name of yours which is the sky,' he scatters [the earth] on the high altar.

1.7.3.s: sim̐hīr asi \ mahiṣīr asi \\ ity uttaravediṃ karoti /
1.7.3.d: सिम्̐हीर् असि \ महिषीर् असि \\ इत्य् उत्तरवेदिं करोति /
1.7.3.m: He shapes the high altar, [saying:] 'You are a lioness; you are a buffalo cow.'

1.7.3.s: tasyāṃ madhye prādeśamātriṃ caturasrāṃ nābhiṃ karoti //
1.7.3.d: तस्यां मध्ये प्रादेशमात्रिं चतुरस्रां नाभिं करोति //
1.7.3.m: In the middle of it he makes a four-cornered navel measuring a span.

1.7.3.s: devebhyaḥ śundhasva \\ ity adbhir avokṣate //
1.7.3.d: देवेभ्यः शुन्धस्व \\ इत्य् अद्भिर् अवोक्षते //
1.7.3.m: He sprinkles it with water, [saying:] 'Cleanse yourself for the gods.'

1.7.3.s: devebhyaḥ śumbhasva \\ iti sikatābhiḥ prarocayati //
1.7.3.d: देवेभ्यः शुम्भस्व \\ इति सिकताभिः प्ररोचयति //
1.7.3.m: He makes it shine with sand, [saying:] 'Be adorned for the gods.'

1.7.3.s: āpo ripraṃ nirvahata \\ iti nābher adhi prāgudīcīr apo niḥsārayati /
1.7.3.d: आपो रिप्रं निर्वहत \\ इति नाभेर् अधि प्रागुदीचीर् अपो निःसारयति /
1.7.3.m: He leads the water out towards the northeast from the navel, [saying:] 'O waters, carry away the defilement.'

1.7.3.s: pratiprasthātā dakṣiṇām̐ vediṃ karoty ottarasmāt parigrahād aratnimātram antarā /
1.7.3.d: प्रतिप्रस्थाता दक्षिणाम्̐ वेदिं करोत्य् ओत्तरस्मात् परिग्रहाद् अरत्निमात्रम् अन्तरा /
1.7.3.m: The pratiprasthātṛ makes the southern altar up to the northern boundary, leaving an interval of a cubit.

1.7.3.s: same prācī bhavato yathā havīm̐ṣi saṃbhaveyus tathā tiraścī /
1.7.3.d: समे प्राची भवतो यथा हवीम्̐षि संभवेयुस् तथा तिरश्ची /
1.7.3.m: They are equal towards the east; across, [they are of such a size] that the oblations may fit.

1.7.3.s: eka utkaraḥ /
1.7.3.d: एक उत्करः /

1.7.3.s: apareṇottarām̐ stambayajur harati /
1.7.3.d: अपरेणोत्तराम्̐ स्तम्बयजुर् हरति /
1.7.3.m: He carries away the grass tuft formula behind the northern [altar].

1.7.3.s: prokṣaṇīḥ sam̐skṛtya \\ indraghoṣās tvā purastād vasubhiḥ pāntu \\ itiprabhṛtibhiḥ prāṅmukha uttaravediṃ prokṣati pradakṣiṇam uttarair anuparikrāman /
1.7.3.d: प्रोक्षणीः सम्̐स्कृत्य \\ इन्द्रघोषास् त्वा पुरस्ताद् वसुभिः पान्तु \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिः प्राङ्मुख उत्तरवेदिं प्रोक्षति प्रदक्षिणम् उत्तरैर् अनुपरिक्रामन् /
1.7.3.m: Having prepared the sprinkling waters, facing east, he sprinkles the high altar with the [mantras] beginning with: 'May the roaring Indras protect you from the east together with the Vasus,' circumambulating clockwise with the subsequent ones.

1.7.3.s: pratiparikramya pitṝṇāṃ bhāgadheyīḥ stha \\ iti śeṣaṃ dakṣiṇata uttaraveder ninayati /
1.7.3.d: प्रतिपरिक्रम्य पितॄणां भागधेयीः स्थ \\ इति शेषं दक्षिणत उत्तरवेदेर् निनयति /
1.7.3.m: Having circumambulated back, he pours out the remainder to the south of the high altar, [saying:] 'You are the shares of the fathers.'

1.7.3.s: hiraṇyam antardhāya pañcagṛhītena nābhim̐ vyāghārayati sim̐hīr asi sapatnasāhī svāhā \\ itiprabhṛtibhir dakṣiṇe 'm̐se savyāyām̐ śroṇau dakṣiṇāyām̐ śroṇau savye 'm̐se madhye pañcamam //
1.7.3.d: हिरण्यम् अन्तर्धाय पञ्चगृहीतेन नाभिम्̐ व्याघारयति सिम्̐हीर् असि सपत्नसाही स्वाहा \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् दक्षिणे ऽम्̐से सव्यायाम्̐ श्रोणौ दक्षिणायाम्̐ श्रोणौ सव्ये ऽम्̐से मध्ये पञ्चमम् //
1.7.3.m: Having interposed gold, he bastes the navel with a fivefold-drawn [offering of clarified butter], with [the mantras] beginning with: 'You are a lioness, conquering rivals, svāhā,' at the right shoulder, at the left buttock, at the right buttock, at the left shoulder, [and] the fifth in the middle.

1.7.3.s: bhūtebhyas tvā \\ ity ūrdhvām̐ srucam udgṛhṇāti /
1.7.3.d: भूतेभ्यस् त्वा \\ इत्य् ऊर्ध्वाम्̐ स्रुचम् उद्गृह्णाति /
1.7.3.m: He lifts up the upright ladle, [saying:] 'For the beings, you.'

1.7.3.s: āhavanīye 'gnipraṇayanāni pratyādhattaḥ /
1.7.3.d: आहवनीये ऽग्निप्रणयनानि प्रत्याधत्तः /
1.7.3.m: They place the fire-bringing [emplements/sticks] upon the āhavanīya fire.

1.7.3.s: nābhiṃ pautadāravaiḥ paridadhāti // viśvāyur asi \\ iti madhyamaṃ dhruvakṣitir asi \\ iti dakṣiṇam acyutakṣid asi \\ ity uttaram //
1.7.3.d: नाभिं पौतदारवैः परिदधाति // विश्वायुर् असि \\ इति मध्यमं ध्रुवक्षितिर् असि \\ इति दक्षिणम् अच्युतक्षिद् असि \\ इत्य् उत्तरम् //
1.7.3.m: He encloses the navel with [sticks] of pūtadāru wood: the middle one, [saying:] 'You are all-sustaining life'; the southern one, [saying:] 'You are a firm dwelling'; the northern one, [saying:] 'You are an unshakeable dwelling.'

1.7.3.s: agner bhasmāsi \\ agne purīṣam asi \\ iti saṃbhārān nivapati pūtadāruguggulakerusugandhitejanam̐ vṛṣṇer alūnapūrvasyāntarāśṛṅgād ūrṇāstukam //
1.7.3.d: अग्नेर् भस्मासि \\ अग्ने पुरीषम् असि \\ इति संभारान् निवपति पूतदारुगुग्गुलकेरुसुगन्धितेजनम्̐ वृष्णेर् अलूनपूर्वस्यान्तराशृङ्गाद् ऊर्णास्तुकम् //
1.7.3.m: He strews the ingredients, [saying:] 'You are the ash of Agni,' 'You are the soil of Agni': pūtadāru wood, bdellium, keru, fragrant reed grass, and a tuft of wool from between the horns of a ram never previously sheared.

1.7.3.s: vibhrāḍ bṛhat pibatu \\ iti saṃbhārān abhimṛśati /
1.7.3.d: विभ्राड् बृहत् पिबतु \\ इति संभारान् अभिमृशति /
1.7.3.m: He touches the ingredients, [saying:] 'May the shining, great one drink.'

1.7.3.s: cātvālād upayamanīḥ kurute vedipurīṣāt pratiprasthātā //
1.7.3.d: चात्वालाद् उपयमनीः कुरुते वेदिपुरीषात् प्रतिप्रस्थाता //
1.7.3.m: The pratiprasthātṛ takes supporting [earth] from the cātvāla trench, [or] from the loose earth of the altar.

1.7.3.s: agnaye praṇīyamānāyānubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayaty agnibhyām̐ vā /
1.7.3.d: अग्नये प्रणीयमानायानुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयत्य् अग्निभ्याम्̐ वा /
1.7.3.m: He prompts [the hotṛ]: 'Recite for Agni being brought forward,' or 'for the two fires.'

1.7.3.s: trir anūktāyām agnipraṇayanāny udyachataḥ /
1.7.3.d: त्रिर् अनूक्तायाम् अग्निप्रणयनान्य् उद्यछतः /
1.7.3.m: When it has been recited three times, they raise the fire-bringing [sticks].

1.7.3.s:
adhvaryur āgnīdhrāya pradāya
yat te pāvaka cakṛmā kaccid āgaḥ \ pūrvo yaḥ sann aparo bhavāsi /
ghṛtena tvaṃ tanvam̐ vardhayasva \ mā mā him̐sīr adhigataṃ purastāt / svāhā //
iti śeṣe juhoti /
1.7.3.d:
अध्वर्युर् आग्नीध्राय प्रदाय
यत् ते पावक चकृमा कच्चिद् आगः \ पूर्वो यः सन्न् अपरो भवासि /
घृतेन त्वं तन्वम्̐ वर्धयस्व \ मा मा हिम्̐सीर् अधिगतं पुरस्तात् / स्वाहा //
इति शेषे जुहोति /
1.7.3.m:
The adhvaryu, having given [them] over to the āgnīdhra,

‘Whatever fault we have committed against you, O purifier, / you who were former and will be later,

increase your body with ghee; / do not injure me who have approached [you] from before. Svāhā!’—

1.7.3.s: agnipraṇayanāny ādāya prācīm anu pradiśaṃ prehi vidvān iti harataḥ //
1.7.3.d: अग्निप्रणयनान्य् आदाय प्राचीम् अनु प्रदिशं प्रेहि विद्वान् इति हरतः //
1.7.3.m: Having taken the fire-bringing [sticks], they carry [them], [saying:] 'Go forward, knowing, along the eastern direction.'

1.7.3.s:
ūrṇāvantam ity ucyamāne
yajñaḥ praty u ṣṭhāt sumatau matīnām\ yatrāvahanti kavayaḥ purūṇi /
dīrgham āyur yajamānāya vinda\ athāsīdasva mahate sībhagāya //
iti saṃbhāreṣv agniṃ nidadhāty avokṣya pratiprasthātā samayā dakṣiṇasyāḥ pūrvārdhe /
1.7.3.d:
ऊर्णावन्तम् इत्य् उच्यमाने
यज्ञः प्रत्य् उ ष्ठात् सुमतौ मतीनाम्\ यत्रावहन्ति कवयः पुरूणि /
दीर्घम् आयुर् यजमानाय विन्द\ अथासीदस्व महते सीभगाय //
इति संभारेष्व् अग्निं निदधात्य् अवोक्ष्य प्रतिप्रस्थाता समया दक्षिणस्याः पूर्वार्धे /
1.7.3.m:
While 'Endowed with wool' is being recited,

‘The sacrifice has stood upright in the good favor of thoughts, / where the wise poets bring many [gifts].

Obtain long life for the sacrificer; / then sit down here for great good fortune’—

with [these verses], having sprinkled [with water], he deposits the fire on the ingredients; the pratiprasthātṛ, directly in the eastern half of the southern [altar].

1.7.3.s:
manuṣvat tvā nidhīmahi \ manuṣvat samidhīmahi /
agne manuṣvad aṅgiras\ devān devāyate yajamānāya svāhā //
iti samidhāvādadhataḥ //
1.7.3.d:
मनुष्वत् त्वा निधीमहि \ मनुष्वत् समिधीमहि /
अग्ने मनुष्वद् अङ्गिरस्\ देवान् देवायते यजमानाय स्वाहा //
इति समिधावादधतः //
1.7.3.m:
‘Like Manu may we place you down, / like Manu may we kindle you.

O Agni, Aṅgiras, like Manu, / to the gods, for the god-seeking sacrificer, svāhā!’—

with [these verses] they lay on two kindling sticks.

1.7.3.s: agneḥ kulāyam asi \\ iti dakṣiṇata āhavanīyasyopayamanīr nivapati /
1.7.3.d: अग्नेः कुलायम् असि \\ इति दक्षिणत आहवनीयस्योपयमनीर् निवपति /
1.7.3.m: He scatters the supporting [earth] to the south of the āhavanīya fire, [saying:] 'You are the nest of Agni.'

1.7.3.s: ulaparājibhyām āhavanīyau paristīrya sapta te agne samidhas \\ iti pūrṇāhutī juhutaḥ /
1.7.3.d: उलपराजिभ्याम् आहवनीयौ परिस्तीर्य सप्त ते अग्ने समिधस् \\ इति पूर्णाहुती जुहुतः /
1.7.3.m: Having strewn round the two āhavanīya fires with two rows of grass, they offer two full-ladle offerings, [saying:] 'Seven are your kindling sticks, O Agni.'

1.7.3.s: pratiprasthātā dakṣiṇasyā veder uttarasyāḥ śroṇer adhi sphyena sakṛt saṃbhinatty ottarasyā dakṣiṇasmād am̐sāt /
1.7.3.d: प्रतिप्रस्थाता दक्षिणस्या वेदेर् उत्तरस्याः श्रोणेर् अधि स्फ्येन सकृत् संभिनत्त्य् ओत्तरस्या दक्षिणस्माद् अम्̐सात् /
1.7.3.m: With the wooden sword, the pratiprasthātṛ cuts across once from the northern buttock of the southern altar up to the southern shoulder of the northern [altar].

1.7.3.s: pṛthak karmāṇi kurutaḥ /
1.7.3.d: पृथक् कर्माणि कुरुतः /
1.7.3.m: They perform the ritual acts separately.

1.7.3.s: adhvaryuḥ praiṣān āha /
1.7.3.d: अध्वर्युः प्रैषान् आह /

1.7.3.s: piṣṭalepau ninīyottarau parigrāhau parigṛhṇītaḥ /
1.7.3.d: पिष्टलेपौ निनीयोत्तरौ परिग्राहौ परिगृह्णीतः /
1.7.3.m: Having poured out the two dough scrapings, they trace the two subsequent boundaries.

1.7.3.s: siddham ājyagrahebhyaḥ /
1.7.3.d: सिद्धम् आज्यग्रहेभ्यः /
1.7.3.m: It is established up to the portions of clarified butter.

1.7.3.s: caturgṛhītāny ājyāni pṛṣadājyavanti gṛhṇāti /
1.7.3.d: चतुर्गृहीतान्य् आज्यानि पृषदाज्यवन्ति गृह्णाति /
1.7.3.m: He draws four-times-drawn clarified butter containing mixed clarified butter.

1.7.3.s: siddham ājyānām̐ sādanāt /
1.7.3.d: सिद्धम् आज्यानाम्̐ सादनात् /
1.7.3.m: It is established up to the placing of the clarified butter.

1.7.4.s: uttarato gārhapatyasya pratiprasthātāmayavapiṣṭānāṃ dadhnā karambhapātrāṇi karoty ekoddhīny aṅguṣṭhaparvamātrāṇi yāvanto 'mātyā yajamānasyaikaṃ cādhikam /
1.7.4.d: उत्तरतो गार्हपत्यस्य प्रतिप्रस्थातामयवपिष्टानां दध्ना करम्भपात्राणि करोत्य् एकोद्धीन्य् अङ्गुष्ठपर्वमात्राणि यावन्तो ऽमात्या यजमानस्यैकं चाधिकम् /
1.7.4.m: To the north of the gārhapatya fire, with curd, the pratiprasthātṛ makes porridge vessels out of raw barley flour, having a single rim and measuring the joint of a thumb, as many as there are members of the sacrificer's household, and one extra.
Having filled [them] with leaves of the śamī tree, he places [them] in a winnowing basket.

1.7.4.s: meṣaṃ kṛtvā meṣīṃ karoti yāvanti pulliṅgāni śavayeran strīliṅgāni meṣyāḥ pratiprasthātā /
1.7.4.d: मेषं कृत्वा मेषीं करोति यावन्ति पुल्लिङ्गानि शवयेरन् स्त्रीलिङ्गानि मेष्याः प्रतिप्रस्थाता /
1.7.4.m: Having made a ram, the pratiprasthātā makes an ewe, as many masculine marks [on the ram as there may be] and feminine marks on the ewe.
Having washed sheep's wool, the two stick [it] on.
They strew more than a hundred and more than a thousand śamī leaves in front.
Having drained off [the whey], they place the two curd messes into two vessels.

1.7.4.s: vāruṇyai niṣkāṣam̐ śiṣṭvā payasyayoḥ karīrasaktūn āvapataḥ /
1.7.4.d: वारुण्यै निष्काषम्̐ शिष्ट्वा पयस्ययोः करीरसक्तून् आवपतः /
1.7.4.m: Having left the scrapings for [the offering to] Varuṇa, they scatter karīra groats into the two curd offerings.
He places the ram into the [offering] to the Maruts, and the ewe into the [offering] to Varuṇa.

1.7.4.s: āsādayantau vipariharata aindrāgnaṣaṣṭhāny uttarasyāṃ mārutīṃ pratiprasthātā dakṣiṇasyām̐ vāruṇyekakapālāv uttarasyām ubhayatra nirmathyaḥ /
1.7.4.d: आसादयन्तौ विपरिहरत ऐन्द्राग्नषष्ठान्य् उत्तरस्यां मारुतीं प्रतिप्रस्थाता दक्षिणस्याम्̐ वारुण्येककपालाव् उत्तरस्याम् उभयत्र निर्मथ्यः /
1.7.4.m: Setting [the oblations] down, the two transpose them: [the adhvaryu places] the six oblations ending with that to Indra-Agni on the northern [fire-altar]; the pratiprasthātā [places] that to the Maruts on the southern [altar]; that to Varuṇa and the single potsherd [cake] on the northern [altar]; in both places fire is to be churned out.

1.7.4.s: saṃmṛṣṭa uttarasmin pratiprasthātā gārhapatyānte pṛchati patni kati te kāntā yadi mithyā vakṣyasi priyatamas te sam̐sthāsyati \\ iti / yaṃ nirdiśet tam̐ varuṇo gṛhṇātu \\ iti brūyāt //
1.7.4.d: संमृष्ट उत्तरस्मिन् प्रतिप्रस्थाता गार्हपत्यान्ते पृछति पत्नि कति ते कान्ता यदि मिथ्या वक्ष्यसि प्रियतमस् ते सम्̐स्थास्यति \\ इति / यं निर्दिशेत् तम्̐ वरुणो गृह्णातु \\ इति ब्रूयात् //
1.7.4.m: When [the spoons] have been wiped on the northern [altar], the pratiprasthātā asks at the edge of the gārhapatya: "Wife, how many lovers do you have? If you speak falsely, your dearest [relative] will perish." Whomever she indicates, he should say, "May Varuṇa seize him!"
The wife [recites]: "We invoke the Praghāsyas..."

1.7.4.s: karambhapātrāṇy ādāyāpareṇa vihāraṃ dakṣiṇātikramyāgreṇa dakṣiṇam agniṃ purastāt pratyañcāv avatiṣṭhete śūrpam̐ śirasoravadhāya //
1.7.4.d: करम्भपात्राण्य् आदायापरेण विहारं दक्षिणातिक्रम्याग्रेण दक्षिणम् अग्निं पुरस्तात् प्रत्यञ्चाव् अवतिष्ठेते शूर्पम्̐ शिरसोरवधाय //
1.7.4.m: Taking the groat dishes, having stepped to the south along the west of the sacrificial enclosure, in front of the southern fire facing west, having placed the winnowing baskets on their heads, the two stand [there].

1.7.4.s: mo ṣū ṇa indra \\ iti japati yajamāna uttaratas tiṣṭhan //
1.7.4.d: मो षू ण इन्द्र \\ इति जपति यजमान उत्तरतस् तिष्ठन् //
1.7.4.m: Standing to the north, the sacrificer mutters: "Do not, O Indra..."

1.7.4.s: yad grāme yad araṇye \\ iti juhutaḥ śūrpeṇa karambhapātrāṇi //
1.7.4.d: यद् ग्रामे यद् अरण्ये \\ इति जुहुतः शूर्पेण करम्भपात्राणि //
1.7.4.m: With the winnowing basket they both offer the groat dishes with [the mantra]: "Whatever [sin] in village, whatever in wilderness..."
They step out in different directions with: "The workers have done the work..."
When [the spoons] have been wiped on the southern [altar], [the procedure is] established up to the choosing of the hotṛ.
Having performed [the offerings] with the two clarified butter portions, the pratiprasthātā sits by.
The adhvaryu performs [the offerings] with the six oblations ending with that to Indra-Agni.
Giving the prompt, the pratiprasthātā performs [the offering] for that to the Maruts.

1.7.4.s: tasyāḥ pūrveṇāvadānena saha meṣīm avadyaty adhvaryur uttareṇa vāruṇyā meṣam /
1.7.4.d: तस्याः पूर्वेणावदानेन सह मेषीम् अवद्यत्य् अध्वर्युर् उत्तरेण वारुण्या मेषम् /
1.7.4.m: Together with the first cutting of that, he cuts off the ewe; the adhvaryu cuts off the ram with the subsequent [cutting] of the offering to Varuṇa.
Having performed [the offering] with the single potsherd [cake], he offers the names of the months.
In both places, having brought together the Sviṣṭakṛt offerings, [they bring together] the iḍā.
A pair of cattle is the sacrificial gift.
Both perform [the offering] to the Vājins with the two [portions of whey].
Having brought together the remainder, they consume [it].
[The procedure is] established up to the offerings to the wives of the gods.

1.7.4.s: adhvaryuḥ patnīḥ sam̐yājayaty ūhena patnīm̐ vedayor vācayaty ūhena yajamāno 'numantrayate /
1.7.4.d: अध्वर्युः पत्नीः सम्̐याजयत्य् ऊहेन पत्नीम्̐ वेदयोर् वाचयत्य् ऊहेन यजमानो ऽनुमन्त्रयते /
1.7.4.m: The adhvaryu makes offerings to the wives of the gods with modification [of the formulas]; he causes the wife to recite between the two grass bundles; the sacrificer accompanies with a mantra with modification.
[The procedure is] established up to the samiṣṭayajus formulas.

1.7.4.s: trir dhruvām āpyāyya yajña yajñaṃ gacha \\ eṣa te yajñas \\ devā gātuvidas \\ iti trīṇi samiṣṭayajūm̐ṣi juhoti dakṣiṇasmin pratiprasthātā /
1.7.4.d: त्रिर् ध्रुवाम् आप्याय्य यज्ञ यज्ञं गछ \\ एष ते यज्ञस् \\ देवा गातुविदस् \\ इति त्रीणि समिष्टयजूम्̐षि जुहोति दक्षिणस्मिन् प्रतिप्रस्थाता /
1.7.4.m: Having replenished the dhruvā spoon three times, the pratiprasthātā offers three samiṣṭayajus oblations on the southern [fire] with: "Go to the sacrifice, O sacrifice...", "This is your sacrifice...", and "O path-finding gods..."

1.7.4.s: ājyaśeṣe samānīya sruksruvāv ājyasthālīm ādatte pratiprasthātā tuṣaniṣkāṣam āgnīdhraḥ srucam adhvaryuḥ //
1.7.4.d: आज्यशेषे समानीय स्रुक्स्रुवाव् आज्यस्थालीम् आदत्ते प्रतिप्रस्थाता तुषनिष्काषम् आग्नीध्रः स्रुचम् अध्वर्युः //
1.7.4.m: Having brought together the remainder of the clarified butter, the pratiprasthātā takes the sruc and sruva ladles and the clarified butter pot, the āgnīdhra the chaff and scrapings, and the adhvaryu the sruc spoon.

1.7.4.s: urum̐ hi rājā varuṇaś cakāra \\ iti cātvālāt prayanto japanti //
1.7.4.d: उरुम्̐ हि राजा वरुणश् चकार \\ इति चात्वालात् प्रयन्तो जपन्ति //
1.7.4.m: Going forth from the pit, they mutter: "King Varuṇa has made a wide path..."

1.7.4.s: śataṃ te rājan \\ ity apaḥ parādṛśya tiṣṭhanto 'vabhṛthe pracaranti /
1.7.4.d: शतं ते राजन् \\ इत्य् अपः परादृश्य तिष्ठन्तो ऽवभृथे प्रचरन्ति /
1.7.4.m: Looking away from the water with "A hundred, O king...", standing, they perform the rites of the purificatory bath.
Having thrown a blade of grass into standing waters, he makes an offering into the waters.

1.7.4.s: agner anīkam iti caturgṛhītasya sraucam āghāram āghārayati /
1.7.4.d: अग्नेर् अनीकम् इति चतुर्गृहीतस्य स्रौचम् आघारम् आघारयति /
1.7.4.m: With "Face of Agni...", he pours out a libation with the ladle from the fourfold-drawn [clarified butter].
He offers the fore-offerings and after-offerings without the barhis.

1.7.4.s: ājyabhāgābhyāṃ pracarya tuṣaniṣkāṣasyāvadāya varuṇam̐ yajati śeṣeṇāgnīvaruṇau sviṣṭakṛtsthāne /
1.7.4.d: आज्यभागाभ्यां प्रचर्य तुषनिष्काषस्यावदाय वरुणम्̐ यजति शेषेणाग्नीवरुणौ स्विष्टकृत्स्थाने /
1.7.4.m: Having performed [the offerings] with the two clarified butter portions, having cut off from the chaff scrapings, he sacrifices to Varuṇa; with the remainder, to Agni-Varuṇa in the place of the Sviṣṭakṛt.

1.7.4.s: vicṛttau varuṇasya pāśas \\ ity apo 'ntād viṣyanti // pratyasto varuṇasya pāśas \\ iti pratyasyanti // namo varuṇasya pāśāya \\ iti namas kurvanti //
1.7.4.d: विचृत्तौ वरुणस्य पाशस् \\ इत्य् अपो ऽन्ताद् विष्यन्ति // प्रत्यस्तो वरुणस्य पाशस् \\ इति प्रत्यस्यन्ति // नमो वरुणस्य पाशाय \\ इति नमस् कुर्वन्ति //
1.7.4.m: With "Untied is Varuṇa's noose!", they cast water off from the edge. With "Repelled is Varuṇa's noose!", they throw [water] back. With "Homage to Varuṇa's noose!", they pay homage.
With the three [verses beginning with] "From abode to abode...", they wipe themselves clean beyond the cowpen.
They return without looking back.
From there itself, they fetch two kindling sticks.

1.7.4.s: edho 'sy edhiṣīmahi \\ iti samidham ādadhāti samid asi samedhiṣīmahi \\ iti dvitīyām //
1.7.4.d: एधो ऽस्य् एधिषीमहि \\ इति समिधम् आदधाति समिद् असि समेधिषीमहि \\ इति द्वितीयाम् //
1.7.4.m: He puts on a kindling stick with: "You are kindling; may we kindle"; a second with: "You are fuel; may we thrive."

1.7.4.s: apo adyānvacāriṣam ity upatiṣṭhante gārhapatye tūṣṇīṃ patnī /
1.7.4.d: अपो अद्यान्वचारिषम् इत्य् उपतिष्ठन्ते गार्हपत्ये तूष्णीं पत्नी /
1.7.4.m: With "The waters have I frequented today...", they attend upon the gārhapatya; the wife silently.
They throw the two barhis into the fire.

1.7.4.s: parivatsarīyām̐ svastim āśāse \\ ity āha yajamānaḥ /
1.7.4.d: परिवत्सरीयाम्̐ स्वस्तिम् आशासे \\ इत्य् आह यजमानः /
1.7.4.m: The sacrificer says: "I pray for well-being for the entire year."
The established iṣṭi concludes.

1.7.4.s:
sadyaḥ paurṇamāsīm̐ sam̐sthāpya
yad gharmaḥ paryāvartayat \ tad antāt pṛthivyā adhi /
tenāham asya brahmaṇā \ nivartayāmi jīvase //
1.7.4.d:
सद्यः पौर्णमासीम्̐ सम्̐स्थाप्य
यद् घर्मः पर्यावर्तयत् \ तद् अन्तात् पृथिव्या अधि /
तेनाहम् अस्य ब्रह्मणा \ निवर्तयामि जीवसे //

1.7.4.m: Beginning with "Agni with sharp radiance...", [the ritual] is the same.

1.7.5.m: The Sākamedha sacrifices take place after four months.

1.7.5.d: पूर्वां पौर्णमासीम् उपोष्याग्नये ऽनीकवते प्रातरष्टाकपालं निर्वपति /
1.7.5.m: Having fasted on the preceding full-moon day, he apportions an eight-potsherd [cake] for Agni Anīkavat in the morning.
The established iṣṭi concludes.
He does not throw the barhis into the fire.

1.7.5.s: gṛhamedhīye tūṣṇīkam ājyabhāgābhyāṃ / palāśaśākhayā sarvān vatsān apākaroti /
1.7.5.d: गृहमेधीये तूष्णीकम् आज्यभागाभ्यां / पलाशशाखया सर्वान् वत्सान् अपाकरोति /
1.7.5.m: In the Gṛhamedhīya sacrifice, the two clarified butter portions are [offered] silently. He drives away all the calves with a palāśa branch.
At midday, there is a caru for the Sāṃtapana Maruts.
The sacrificial grass is that of the [offering to Agni] Anīkavat.
The established offering comes to a close.
For the Gṛhamedhīya offering, he ties together sacrificial fuel and sacrificial grass, except for the sacred grass bundle and enclosing sticks.

1.7.5.s: hute sāyamagnihotre marudbhyo gṛhamedhebhyaḥ sarvāsāṃ dugdha odanam̐ śrapayati /
1.7.5.d: हुते सायमग्निहोत्रे मरुद्भ्यो गृहमेधेभ्यः सर्वासां दुग्ध ओदनम्̐ श्रपयति /
1.7.5.m: When the evening Agnihotra has been offered, he cooks boiled rice for the Maruts, the Gṛhamedhas, with the milk of all [the cows].
He sets down the sacrificial fuel and sacrificial grass.
He makes the wife take her place with a sacred formula.
Having sprinkled the sacrificial fuel and sacrificial grass and strewn around the āhavanīya fire, he encloses it with pieces of sacrificial fuel.
He deposits the crust from the head [of the pot].
Having made an underlayer, he scoops out three portions of boiled rice.
To the west of the āhavanīya fire, he deposits [them] pointing north, and [also] the clarified butter.

1.7.5.s: idhmam upasamādhāyājyabhāgābhyāṃ pracarya sarveṣām̐ samavadāyābhighārya marudbhyo gṛhamedhebhyo 'nubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati /
1.7.5.d: इध्मम् उपसमाधायाज्यभागाभ्यां प्रचर्य सर्वेषाम्̐ समवदायाभिघार्य मरुद्भ्यो गृहमेधेभ्यो ऽनुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति /
1.7.5.m: Having added the sacrificial fuel [to the fire] and performed [the rites] with the two clarified butter portions, having cut off [portions] from all of them and basted them with clarified butter, he causes [the hotṛ] to recite: 'Recite for the Maruts, the Gṛhamedhas.'

1.7.5.s: āśrāvya maruto gṛhamedhān yaja \\ iti preṣyati /
1.7.5.d: आश्राव्य मरुतो गृहमेधान् यज \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
1.7.5.m: Having called for recitation, he issues the call: 'Worship the Maruts, the Gṛhamedhas!'
Cutting off [a portion] into the southern one and invoking the iḍā portion, they eat [it].
Having anointed themselves with clarified butter, they are satisfied with the Gṛhamedhīya oblation.

1.7.5.s: api prativeśo 'nya odanaḥ / tasyāmātyāḥ suhitā bhavanti /
1.7.5.d: अपि प्रतिवेशो ऽन्य ओदनः / तस्यामात्याः सुहिता भवन्ति /
1.7.5.m: There is also another, neighbouring portion of boiled rice; with it the household members are satisfied.
The cows dwell with their calves, except for one whose calf has died.

1.7.5.s: purā prātaragnihotrād gārhapatye pūrṇā darve \ dehi me \\ ity etābhyāṃ śironiṣkāṣasya pūrṇadarvam ṛṣabham āhūya ruvati juhuyāt /
1.7.5.d: पुरा प्रातरग्निहोत्राद् गार्हपत्ये पूर्णा दर्वे \ देहि मे \\ इत्य् एताभ्यां शिरोनिष्काषस्य पूर्णदर्वम् ऋषभम् आहूय रुवति जुहुयात् /
1.7.5.m: Before the morning Agnihotra, in the gārhapatya fire, with these two [mantras], 'O full ladle…', 'Give to me…', having called the bull, he should offer a full ladle of the crust from the head [of the pot] while [the bull] roars.

1.7.5.s: yady ṛṣabho na ruyād brahmāṇam āmantrya juhuyāt /
1.7.5.d: यद्य् ऋषभो न रुयाद् ब्रह्माणम् आमन्त्र्य जुहुयात् /
1.7.5.m: If the bull does not roar, having addressed the brahman priest, he should make the offering.

1.7.5.s: hute prātaragnihotre marudbhyaḥ krīḍibhyaḥ sākam̐ raśmibhiḥ saptakapāla udyatsu raśmiṣu pracarati /
1.7.5.d: हुते प्रातरग्निहोत्रे मरुद्भ्यः क्रीडिभ्यः साकम्̐ रश्मिभिः सप्तकपाल उद्यत्सु रश्मिषु प्रचरति /
1.7.5.m: When the morning Agnihotra has been offered, he performs [the rite] with a seven-potsherd [cake] for the sporting Maruts together with the rays [of the sun], as the rays are rising.

1.7.5.s: āgneyo 'ṣṭākapāla itiprabhṛtīny aṣṭau vaiśvakarmaṇāntānām uttaravedyām atipraṇayed yathā varuṇapraghāseṣu //
1.7.5.d: आग्नेयो ऽष्टाकपाल इतिप्रभृतीन्य् अष्टौ वैश्वकर्मणान्तानाम् उत्तरवेद्याम् अतिप्रणयेद् यथा वरुणप्रघासेषु //
1.7.5.m: Beginning with the eight-potsherd cake for Agni, he should carry forward the eight [oblations] ending with that to Viśvakarman onto the high altar, as in the Varuṇapraghāsa rites.

1.7.5.s: agne ver hotram iti caturgṛhītasya sraucam āghāram āghārayati /
1.7.5.d: अग्ने वेर् होत्रम् इति चतुर्गृहीतस्य स्रौचम् आघारम् आघारयति /
1.7.5.m: With 'May Agni perceive the priestly office...', he pours the ladle libation from the fourfold-drawn [clarified butter].
Before the Sviṣṭakṛt offering, he offers the names of the months.

1.7.6.m: They perform the ancestral rite proceeding toward the southeast.
They cut the sacrificial grass close to the root, except for the sacred grass bundle.

1.7.6.s: bhūya idhmābarhiḥ saṃnahyāparau paristīryaikaikaṃ pātrāṇi prayunakty anyat prāśitraharaṇāt /
1.7.6.d: भूय इध्माबर्हिः संनह्यापरौ परिस्तीर्यैकैकं पात्राणि प्रयुनक्त्य् अन्यत् प्राशित्रहरणात् /
1.7.6.m: Having bound together more sacrificial fuel and sacrificial grass, and having strewn around the two western [fires], he prepares the utensils one by one, except for the vessel for the prāśitra portion.
He sets down the praṇītā waters to the south-east of the southern fire.
He scorches [the utensils] over the southern fire.

1.7.6.s: dakṣiṇato 'gniṣṭhān nirvapati / somāya pitṛmate ṣaṭkapālaṃ pitṛbhyo barhiṣadbhyo yavān dhānābhyaḥ pitṛbhyo 'gniṣvāt tebhyo yavān manthāya /
1.7.6.d: दक्षिणतो ऽग्निष्ठान् निर्वपति / सोमाय पितृमते षट्कपालं पितृभ्यो बर्हिषद्भ्यो यवान् धानाभ्यः पितृभ्यो ऽग्निष्वात् तेभ्यो यवान् मन्थाय /
1.7.6.m: Standing to the south of the fire, he apportions: a six-potsherd cake for Soma accompanied by the fathers; barley for the parched grains for the fathers seated on the sacrificial grass; barley for the mash for the fire-consumed fathers.
While [the grains] are being roasted, he carries fire around them.
He grinds the other half of the parched grains for the mash.

1.7.6.s: piṣṭalepaṃ nidhāyāgreṇa dakṣiṇam agniṃ triṣu prakrameṣv aparimite vāvakāśe puruṣamātriṃ caturasrāṃ dikkuṣṭhām̐ vediṃ karoti /
1.7.6.d: पिष्टलेपं निधायाग्रेण दक्षिणम् अग्निं त्रिषु प्रक्रमेष्व् अपरिमिते वावकाशे पुरुषमात्रिं चतुरस्रां दिक्कुष्ठाम्̐ वेदिं करोति /
1.7.6.m: Having deposited the dough residue, in front of the southern fire at three paces, or in an unlimited space, he makes an altar one fathom square, with its corners pointing to the cardinal directions.
He encloses it with mats up to the northern enclosing line.
He makes a door toward the northern hip [of the altar].

1.7.6.s: dakṣiṇāgner ekolmukam abhyukṣya madhye veder nidhāya tasminn upasamādhāya parisamuhya paryukṣya piṣṭalepaṃ ninīyottaraṃ parigrāhaṃ parigṛhṇāti /
1.7.6.d: दक्षिणाग्नेर् एकोल्मुकम् अभ्युक्ष्य मध्ये वेदेर् निधाय तस्मिन्न् उपसमाधाय परिसमुह्य पर्युक्ष्य पिष्टलेपं निनीयोत्तरं परिग्राहं परिगृह्णाति /
1.7.6.m: Having sprinkled a single firebrand from the southern fire and placed it in the middle of the altar, having added fuel to it, swept around it, sprinkled around it, and poured out the dough residue, he traces the northern enclosing line.
[The rite] is established up to the drawings of clarified butter.
He takes fourfold portions of clarified butter up to the gārhapatya fire.
Having shaken out the sacrificial grass, he strews it.

1.7.6.s: prasavyam uddhāvaṃ triḥ paristīryoddhavāt prastaraṃ tūṣṇīṃ gṛhṇāti /
1.7.6.d: प्रसव्यम् उद्धावं त्रिः परिस्तीर्योद्धवात् प्रस्तरं तूष्णीं गृह्णाति /
1.7.6.m: Having strewn counter-clockwise three times shaking it out, he takes silently the sacred grass bundle from what was shaken out.

1.7.6.s: abhivānyāyāḥ payaso 'rdhapātre prasavyam ikṣuśalākayā mantham āyauti śalākāsthaṃ / na śalākām uddharati /
1.7.6.d: अभिवान्यायाः पयसो ऽर्धपात्रे प्रसव्यम् इक्षुशलाकया मन्थम् आयौति शलाकास्थं / न शलाकाम् उद्धरति /
1.7.6.m: In half a cup of milk from a cow whose calf has died, he stirs the mash counter-clockwise with a stalk of sugarcane, keeping it on the stalk; he does not lift out the stalk.

1.7.6.s: alaṃkṛtyaikaikam abhyudānayaty udakumbham ājyāni havīm̐ṣi tathāparāṇi yajñāṅgāni /
1.7.6.d: अलंकृत्यैकैकम् अभ्युदानयत्य् उदकुम्भम् आज्यानि हवीम्̐षि तथापराणि यज्ञाङ्गानि /
1.7.6.m: Having embellished them, he brings near one by one the water jar, the clarified butter portions, the oblations, and likewise the other limbs of the sacrifice.

1.7.6.s: ekā sāmidhenī / tasyās tṛtīye praṇave sakṛd idhmam ādadhāti /
1.7.6.d: एका सामिधेनी / तस्यास् तृतीये प्रणवे सकृद् इध्मम् आदधाति /
1.7.6.m: There is a single kindling verse; at its third praṇava he places the sacrificial fuel [on the fire] once.
He offers the fore-offerings and after-offerings without [the one to] the sacrificial grass.

1.7.6.s: ājyabhāgābhyāṃ pracarya visram̐sya yajñopavītāni prācīnāvavītāni kurvanti /
1.7.6.d: आज्यभागाभ्यां प्रचर्य विस्रम्̐स्य यज्ञोपवीतानि प्राचीनाववीतानि कुर्वन्ति /
1.7.6.m: Having performed [the rites] with the two clarified butter portions, loosening their sacred threads, they make them hang over their right shoulders.

1.7.6.s: viparikrāmanty ṛtvijo yathāsthānam̐ / hotāgreṇātipraṇītaṃ parikramyopaviśaty uttarato brahmāgreṇa hotāram adhvaryur apareṇa /
1.7.6.d: विपरिक्रामन्त्य् ऋत्विजो यथास्थानम्̐ / होताग्रेणातिप्रणीतं परिक्रम्योपविशत्य् उत्तरतो ब्रह्माग्रेण होतारम् अध्वर्युर् अपरेण /
1.7.6.m: The officiating priests walk around according to their places: the hotṛ priest, having walked around in front of the carried-forward [fire], sits down to the north; the brahman priest in front of the hotṛ priest; the adhvaryu priest behind.
The āgnīdhra priest transposes the oblations.

1.7.6.s: yathāsthānaṃ juhūr madhya upabhṛd dhruvā dakṣiṇā / yathāsthānaṃ puroḍāśo madhye dhānā mantho dakṣiṇataḥ /
1.7.6.d: यथास्थानं जुहूर् मध्य उपभृद् ध्रुवा दक्षिणा / यथास्थानं पुरोडाशो मध्ये धाना मन्थो दक्षिणतः /
1.7.6.m: In the regular place is the offering ladle, in the middle the upabhṛt, the dhruvā to the south; in the regular place is the sacrificial cake, in the middle the parched grains, the mash to the south.
He cuts off [the portions] five times; six times for a descendant of Jamadagni.

1.7.6.s: apareṇa srugdaṇḍān udaṅṅ atikramya somāya pitṛmate 'nu svadhā \\ ity anuvācayati \\ om̐ svadhā \\ ity āśrāvayati \\ astu svadhā \\ iti pratyāśrāvayati /
1.7.6.d: अपरेण स्रुग्दण्डान् उदङ्ङ् अतिक्रम्य सोमाय पितृमते ऽनु स्वधा \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति \\ ओम्̐ स्वधा \\ इत्य् आश्रावयति \\ अस्तु स्वधा \\ इति प्रत्याश्रावयति /
1.7.6.m: Having stepped northwards along the rear of the spoon-handles, he causes [the hotṛ] to recite the invitatory verse with: "To Soma with the fathers, svadhā"; he calls for the response with: "Om svadhā"; he gives the response with: "Astu svadhā."

1.7.6.s: pratyāśrute somaṃ pitṛmantam̐ svadhā \\ iti preṣyati //
1.7.6.d: प्रत्याश्रुते सोमं पितृमन्तम्̐ स्वधा \\ इति प्रेष्यति //
1.7.6.m: When it has been responded to, he gives the order: "Svadhā to Soma accompanied by the fathers!"

1.7.6.s: svadhā namas \\ ity ukte dakṣiṇā tiṣṭhan madhye juhoti /
1.7.6.d: स्वधा नमस् \\ इत्य् उक्ते दक्षिणा तिष्ठन् मध्ये जुहोति /
1.7.6.m: When "svadhā namas" has been uttered, standing on the south he offers in the middle [of the fire].
He proceeds thus with the roasted barley grains, thus with the barley mash.

1.7.6.s: agnaye kavyavāhanāya sviṣṭakṛte samavadyati dvir trir yadi pañcāvadānasya /
1.7.6.d: अग्नये कव्यवाहनाय स्विष्टकृते समवद्यति द्विर् त्रिर् यदि पञ्चावदानस्य /
1.7.6.m: He cuts portions together for Agni Kavyavāhana Sviṣṭakṛt, twice, [or] thrice if it is of five cuttings.
He offers [it], not connected [with the previous offerings], in the north-eastern part of the southern half.
Turning back and letting down [the sacred thread], they make their sacred threads [worn] over the left shoulder, having been wearing the sacred thread over the right shoulder.
The officiating priests turn back. He brings the oblations back around.

1.7.6.s: manthe haviḥśeṣam avadāyeḍām upahūya na bhakṣayante /
1.7.6.d: मन्थे हविःशेषम् अवदायेडाम् उपहूय न भक्षयन्ते /
1.7.6.m: Having cut off the remainder of the oblation into the barley mash and having invoked the iḍā portion, they do not eat [it].

1.7.6.s: samidhā pratipadya dvāv anuyājau yajati devau yaja \\ iti prathamam̐ [ yaja ] yaja \\ ity uttamam /
1.7.6.d: समिधा प्रतिपद्य द्वाव् अनुयाजौ यजति देवौ यज \\ इति प्रथमम्̐ [ यज ] यज \\ इत्य् उत्तमम् /
1.7.6.m: Having begun with a kindling stick, he sacrifices the two after-offerings: "Sacrifice to the two gods!" as the first; "Sacrifice, sacrifice!" as the last.
He grasps all the ladles together.
Having offered the two offerings of the southern fire, he releases the potsherds.

1.7.6.d: उदकाञ्जलिप्रभृति सिद्धम्̐ यथा पिण्डपितृयज्ञे ऽन्यद् धोमात् /
1.7.6.m: From the water-cupful onwards, it is established as in the ancestral ball-offering, other than the fire offering.
They perform the water rites with a water jar.

1.7.6.s: saṃnīyeḍām̐ sraktiṣu piṇḍān nidadhāty ūrdhvaṃ prapitāmahāt trīn anvācakṣāṇo 'muto 'rvāciḥ /
1.7.6.d: संनीयेडाम्̐ स्रक्तिषु पिण्डान् निदधात्य् ऊर्ध्वं प्रपितामहात् त्रीन् अन्वाचक्षाणो ऽमुतो ऽर्वाचिः /
1.7.6.m: Having combined the iḍā portion, he deposits balls [of food] in the corners, reciting three [generations] up from the great-grandfather, from that [generation] towards this.
He wipes the residue on the northern buttock of the altar.

1.7.6.s: atra pitaro mādayadhvam iti pariśritān niṣkrāmanti //
1.7.6.d: अत्र पितरो मादयध्वम् इति परिश्रितान् निष्क्रामन्ति //
1.7.6.m: With: "Here, O fathers, rejoice!" they step out of the enclosed space.

1.7.6.s: susaṃdṛśaṃ tvā vayam ity āhavanīyam upatiṣṭhante / mantrānte praṇavena tāmyante // yad antarikṣam iti gārhapatyam //
1.7.6.d: सुसंदृशं त्वा वयम् इत्य् आहवनीयम् उपतिष्ठन्ते / मन्त्रान्ते प्रणवेन ताम्यन्ते // यद् अन्तरिक्षम् इति गार्हपत्यम् //
1.7.6.m: They attend upon the āhavanīya fire with: "We [attend upon] thee of fair aspect..."; at the end of the mantra they pause with the praṇava; upon the gārhapatya fire with: "Whatever the intermediate space..."
With: "The fathers have rejoiced," they enter the enclosed space.
From the tuft of wool onwards, it is established as in the ancestral ball-offering.

1.7.6.s: paretana pitaraḥ somyāsas \\ ity udakumbhenāgniṃ prasavyaṃ triḥ pariṣiñcan paryeti /
1.7.6.d: परेतन पितरः सोम्यासस् \\ इत्य् उदकुम्भेनाग्निं प्रसव्यं त्रिः परिषिञ्चन् पर्येति /
1.7.6.m: With: "Depart, O fathers, worthy of soma!" he walks around the fire three times counter-clockwise, sprinkling around with the water jar.
Setting it down each time, he walks around back three times without sprinkling.
Having cast the balls into the fire, he singes the altar.
From: "They have eaten, they have rejoiced..." onwards, it is the same.

1.7.7.m: North of the gārhapatya fire, he cooks as many one-potsherd cakes as there are groat vessels.
Having basted them with clarified butter silently, he takes them off the fire towards the north.

1.7.7.s: dakṣiṇāgner ekolmukaṃ dhūpāyat parācīnam̐ haranty anapekṣamāṇāḥ prāgudīcyāṃ diśi mūtenaikakapālān //
1.7.7.d: दक्षिणाग्नेर् एकोल्मुकं धूपायत् पराचीनम्̐ हरन्त्य् अनपेक्षमाणाः प्रागुदीच्यां दिशि मूतेनैककपालान् //
1.7.7.m: Without looking back, they carry a single smoking ember away from the southern fire facing backward, in a woven basket to the north-eastern quarter with the one-potsherd cakes.

1.7.7.s: ākhuṃ te rudra paśuṃ karomi \\ ity ākhukirā ekam upavapati /
1.7.7.d: आखुं ते रुद्र पशुं करोमि \\ इत्य् आखुकिरा एकम् उपवपति /
1.7.7.m: With: "A mole I make thine animal, O Rudra," he casts one [cake] upon a molehill.

1.7.7.s: ulmukaṃ catuṣpathe nidhāya tasminn upasamādhāya parisamuhya paryukṣya paristīrya madhyamaparṇe sarveṣām̐ samavadāyābhighārya \\ eṣa te rudra bhāgas \\ iti juhoti /
1.7.7.d: उल्मुकं चतुष्पथे निधाय तस्मिन्न् उपसमाधाय परिसमुह्य पर्युक्ष्य परिस्तीर्य मध्यमपर्णे सर्वेषाम्̐ समवदायाभिघार्य \\ एष ते रुद्र भागस् \\ इति जुहोति /
1.7.7.m: Having placed the ember at a crossroad, having built [the fire] upon it, having swept around, having sprinkled around, having strewn [grass] around, having cut portions together from all [cakes] on a middle palāśa leaf and having basted with clarified butter, he offers with: "This is thy portion, O Rudra."

1.7.7.s: pṛthag ādāya \\ avāmba rudram adimahi \\ iti tisṛbhis triḥ pariyanti patikāmā ca //
1.7.7.d: पृथग् आदाय \\ अवाम्ब रुद्रम् अदिमहि \\ इति तिसृभिस् त्रिः परियन्ति पतिकामा च //
1.7.7.m: Taking [them] individually, they and a woman desiring a husband walk around three times with three [verses]: "We have appeased Rudra..."

1.7.7.s: urvārukam iva bandhanāt \\ mṛtyor mukṣīya māmṛtāt \\ iti japanti // mṛtyor mukṣīya mā patyur iti patikāmā /
1.7.7.d: उर्वारुकम् इव बन्धनात् \\ मृत्योर् मुक्षीय मामृतात् \\ इति जपन्ति // मृत्योर् मुक्षीय मा पत्युर् इति पतिकामा /
1.7.7.m: They mutter: "...like a cucumber from its stalk, may I be freed from death, not from immortality!"; "...may I be freed from death, not from my husband!" the woman desiring a husband [mutters].

1.7.7.s: tān ūrdhvān udasyodasya bhago 'si bhagasya lapsīya \\ iti pratilabhante /
1.7.7.d: तान् ऊर्ध्वान् उदस्योदस्य भगो ऽसि भगस्य लप्सीय \\ इति प्रतिलभन्ते /
1.7.7.m: Tossing them up again and again, they catch them with: "Thou art fortune; may I obtain fortune!"
They pour them together for the sacrificer and for the woman desiring a husband.

1.7.7.s: tān mūte kṛtvā rudraiṣa te bhāgas \\ iti vṛkṣa āsacati //
1.7.7.d: तान् मूते कृत्वा रुद्रैष ते भागस् \\ इति वृक्ष आसचति //
1.7.7.m: Putting them in a basket, he fastens it onto a tree with: "O Rudra, this is thy portion."
With: "From domain to domain..." that has been explained.
He should apportion a boiled oblation in clarified butter for the Ādityas.

1.7.7.s: punaretya gṛheṣu \\ idāvatsarīyām̐ svastim āśāse \\ ity āha yajamānaḥ /
1.7.7.d: पुनरेत्य गृहेषु \\ इदावत्सरीयाम्̐ स्वस्तिम् आशासे \\ इत्य् आह यजमानः /
1.7.7.m: Returning home, the sacrificer says: "I pray for well-being for the Idāvatsara year."
The offering is concluded in the established manner.

1.7.7.s:
sadyaḥ paurṇamāsīm̐ sam̐sthāpya
yo asyāḥ pṛthivyā adhi tvaci \ nivartayaty oṣadhīḥ /
tenāham asya brahmaṇā \ nivartayāmi jīvase //
1.7.7.d:
सद्यः पौर्णमासीम्̐ सम्̐स्थाप्य
यो अस्याः पृथिव्या अधि त्वचि \ निवर्तयत्य् ओषधीः /
तेनाहम् अस्य ब्रह्मणा \ निवर्तयामि जीवसे //
1.7.7.m:
Immediately concluding the full-moon sacrifice,

"He who upon the surface of this earth / brings back the plants,

by his sacred prayer I bring him back / to live."
From: "Agni with sharp radiance..." onwards, it is the same.

1.7.8.s: śunāsīrya caturṣu māseṣu sadyaś caturahe māsi vā /
1.7.8.d: शुनासीर्य चतुर्षु मासेषु सद्यश् चतुरहे मासि वा /
1.7.8.m: The Śunāsīrya is [performed] in the fourth month, immediately, or in four days, or in a month.
[The procedure] is explained by the Vaiśvadeva [offering].

1.7.8.s: āgneyo 'ṣṭākapāla itiprabhṛtīny aṣṭau saurya ekakapāla ityantāni /
1.7.8.d: आग्नेयो ऽष्टाकपाल इतिप्रभृतीन्य् अष्टौ सौर्य एककपाल इत्यन्तानि /
1.7.8.m: The eight [oblations] beginning with the [cake] on eight potsherds for Agni, end with the one on one potsherd for Sūrya.
Before the Sviṣṭakṛt offering, he offers the names of the months.
A plow with a team of twelve [oxen] is the sacrificial gift, or a team of draft animals, [or] an ox.

1.7.8.s: anuvatsarīyodvatsarīye svastim āśāse \\ ity āha yajamānaḥ /
1.7.8.d: अनुवत्सरीयोद्वत्सरीये स्वस्तिम् आशासे \\ इत्य् आह यजमानः /
1.7.8.m: The sacrificer says: "I pray for well-being for the Anuvatsara and Udvatsara years."
