The offering is concluded in the established manner.

1.7.8.s:
sadyaḥ paurṇamāsīm̐ sam̐sthāpya
yena māsā ardhamāsās\ ṛtavaḥ parivatsarāḥ /
yenaite prajāpater \ ījānasya nivartayan /
tenāham asya brahmaṇā \ nivartayāmi jīvase //
1.7.8.d:
सद्यः पौर्णमासीम्̐ सम्̐स्थाप्य
येन मासा अर्धमासास्\ ऋतवः परिवत्सराः /
येनैते प्रजापतेर् \ ईजानस्य निवर्तयन् /
तेनाहम् अस्य ब्रह्मणा \ निवर्तयामि जीवसे //
1.7.8.m:
Immediately concluding the full-moon sacrifice,

"Whereby the months, the half-months, / the seasons, the years,

whereby they brought back [the hair] of Prajāpati / when he sacrificed,

by his sacred prayer I bring him back / to live."

1.7.8.s: agnis tigmena śociṣā \\ itiprabhṛti samānam anyad vratebhyaḥ /
1.7.8.d: अग्निस् तिग्मेन शोचिषा \\ इतिप्रभृति समानम् अन्यद् व्रतेभ्यः /
1.7.8.m: From: "Agni with sharp radiance..." onwards, it is the same, except for the observances.
The sacrificer has his entire hair and beard shaved.

1.7.8.s: parvaṇy anantarā somena yajeta paśunā vā /
1.7.8.d: पर्वण्य् अनन्तरा सोमेन यजेत पशुना वा /
1.7.8.m: At the immediately following junction [day], he should sacrifice with soma or with an animal.
The ritual framework is that of the Vaiśvānara and Parjanya offerings.

1.7.8.s: prasiddhaḥ prathamaḥ sam̐vatsaraḥ / tasyānte yā pūrvā paurṇamāsī tām̐ śunāsīryāyopavasati yottarā tām̐ vaiśvadevāya /
1.7.8.d: प्रसिद्धः प्रथमः सम्̐वत्सरः / तस्यान्ते या पूर्वा पौर्णमासी ताम्̐ शुनासीर्यायोपवसति योत्तरा ताम्̐ वैश्वदेवाय /
1.7.8.m: The first year is well known. At the end of it, he fasts on that full-moon day which is earlier for the Śunāsīrya, and on that which is later for the Vaiśvadeva.
The second year is well known.

1.7.8.s: tathā tṛtīyo / māsam utsṛjya vaiśvadevena yajeta /
1.7.8.d: तथा तृतीयो / मासम् उत्सृज्य वैश्वदेवेन यजेत /
1.7.8.m: tathā tṛtīyo / māsam utsṛjya vaiśvadevena yajeta

1.7.8.s: tathā pañcamaḥ / tasya sākamedhebhyo 'dhi śunāsīryaṃ pañcasu māseṣu māseṣu /
1.7.8.d: तथा पञ्चमः / तस्य साकमेधेभ्यो ऽधि शुनासीर्यं पञ्चसु मासेषु मासेषु /
1.7.8.m: tathā pañcamaḥ / tasya sākamedhebhyo 'dhi śunāsīryaṃ pañcasu māseṣu māseṣu

1.8.1.s: aindrāgnena paśunā yakṣyamāṇas \\ vāg dhotā \ dīkṣā patnī \\ āpo 'dhvaryur \ vāto 'bhigaraḥ \ prāṇo havir \ mano brahmā \ tapasi juhomi svāhā \\ iti ṣaḍḍhotāraṃ manasānudrutya juhoti /
1.8.1.d: ऐन्द्राग्नेन पशुना यक्ष्यमाणस् \\ वाग् धोता \ दीक्षा पत्नी \\ आपो ऽध्वर्युर् \ वातो ऽभिगरः \ प्राणो हविर् \ मनो ब्रह्मा \ तपसि जुहोमि स्वाहा \\ इति षड्ढोतारं मनसानुद्रुत्य जुहोति /
1.8.1.m: aindrāgnena paśunā yakṣyamāṇas \\ vāg dhotā \ dīkṣā patnī \\ āpo 'dhvaryur \ vāto 'bhigaraḥ \ prāṇo havir \ mano brahmā \ tapasi juhomi svāhā \\ iti ṣaḍḍhotāraṃ manasānudrutya juhoti

1.8.1.s: āgnāvaiṣṇavam ekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapati / pūrṇāhutim̐ vā //
1.8.1.d: आग्नावैष्णवम् एकादशकपालं निर्वपति / पूर्णाहुतिम्̐ वा //
1.8.1.m: āgnāvaiṣṇavam ekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapati / pūrṇāhutim̐ vā

1.8.1.s: uru viṣṇo vikramasva \\ ity āhavanīye hutvā yūpam achaiti pālāśaṃ khādiram̐ rauhitakam̐ vā / bailvaṃ brahmavarcasakāmasya /
1.8.1.d: उरु विष्णो विक्रमस्व \\ इत्य् आहवनीये हुत्वा यूपम् अछैति पालाशं खादिरम्̐ रौहितकम्̐ वा / बैल्वं ब्रह्मवर्चसकामस्य /
1.8.1.m: uru viṣṇo vikramasva \\ ity āhavanīye hutvā yūpam achaiti pālāśaṃ khādiram̐ rauhitakam̐ vā / bailvaṃ brahmavarcasakāmasya

1.8.1.s: ayūpyān atikramya \\ aty anyān agāṃ nānyān upāgām iti yūpaṃ joṣayate bahuśākhaṃ bahuparṇam aśuṣkāgram asuṣiram anadhiśākhyam ṛjum ūrdhvaśalkam upariṣṭādupāvanataṃ prāgudañcaṃ prahāṇaṃ prāñcaṃ pratyañcam̐ vā //
1.8.1.d: अयूप्यान् अतिक्रम्य \\ अत्य् अन्यान् अगां नान्यान् उपागाम् इति यूपं जोषयते बहुशाखं बहुपर्णम् अशुष्काग्रम् असुषिरम् अनधिशाख्यम् ऋजुम् ऊर्ध्वशल्कम् उपरिष्टादुपावनतं प्रागुदञ्चं प्रहाणं प्राञ्चं प्रत्यञ्चम्̐ वा //
1.8.1.m: ayūpyān atikramya \\ aty anyān agāṃ nānyān upāgām iti yūpaṃ joṣayate bahuśākhaṃ bahuparṇam aśuṣkāgram asuṣiram anadhiśākhyam ṛjum ūrdhvaśalkam upariṣṭādupāvanataṃ prāgudañcaṃ prahāṇaṃ prāñcaṃ pratyañcam̐ vā

1.8.1.s: viṣṇave tvā \\ ity ājyena paryanakty alkasamare śalkasamare vā //
1.8.1.d: विष्णवे त्वा \\ इत्य् आज्येन पर्यनक्त्य् अल्कसमरे शल्कसमरे वा //
1.8.1.m: viṣṇave tvā \\ ity ājyena paryanakty alkasamare śalkasamare vā

1.8.1.s: oṣadhe trāyasvainam iti dakṣiṇasmin yūpānte darbham antardadhāti //
1.8.1.d: ओषधे त्रायस्वैनम् इति दक्षिणस्मिन् यूपान्ते दर्भम् अन्तर्दधाति //
1.8.1.m: oṣadhe trāyasvainam iti dakṣiṇasmin yūpānte darbham antardadhāti

1.8.1.s: svadhite mainam̐ him̐sīr iti paraśunā praharati /
1.8.1.d: स्वधिते मैनम्̐ हिम्̐सीर् इति परशुना प्रहरति /
1.8.1.m: svadhite mainam̐ him̐sīr iti paraśunā praharati

1.8.1.s: prathamotpatitam̐ śalkam avayachati /
1.8.1.d: प्रथमोत्पतितम्̐ शल्कम् अवयछति /
1.8.1.m: prathamotpatitam̐ śalkam avayachati

1.8.1.s: takṣāchinatty anakṣasaṅgam̐ sthāṇum ucchim̐ṣati //
1.8.1.d: तक्षाछिनत्त्य् अनक्षसङ्गम्̐ स्थाणुम् उच्छिम्̐षति //
1.8.1.m: takṣāchinatty anakṣasaṅgam̐ sthāṇum ucchim̐ṣati

1.8.1.s: yaṃ tvām ayam iti prāñcaṃ prahāpayati //
1.8.1.d: यं त्वाम् अयम् इति प्राञ्चं प्रहापयति //
1.8.1.m: yaṃ tvām ayam iti prāñcaṃ prahāpayati

1.8.1.s: divam agreṇa mā him̐sīr iti patantam anumantrayate //
1.8.1.d: दिवम् अग्रेण मा हिम्̐सीर् इति पतन्तम् अनुमन्त्रयते //
1.8.1.m: divam agreṇa mā him̐sīr iti patantam anumantrayate

1.8.1.s: vanaspate śatavalśo viroha \\ ity āvraścane juhoti //
1.8.1.d: वनस्पते शतवल्शो विरोह \\ इत्य् आव्रश्चने जुहोति //
1.8.1.m: vanaspate śatavalśo viroha \\ ity āvraścane juhoti

1.8.1.s: sahasravalśā vi vayam̐ ruhema \\ ity ātmānaṃ pratyabhimṛśati /
1.8.1.d: सहस्रवल्शा वि वयम्̐ रुहेम \\ इत्य् आत्मानं प्रत्यभिमृशति /
1.8.1.m: sahasravalśā vi vayam̐ ruhema \\ ity ātmānaṃ pratyabhimṛśati

1.8.1.s: aṣṭāśriṃ gopuchaṃ karoty asthūlam anaṇum ataṣṭamūlam /
1.8.1.d: अष्टाश्रिं गोपुछं करोत्य् अस्थूलम् अनणुम् अतष्टमूलम् /
1.8.1.m: aṣṭāśriṃ gopuchaṃ karoty asthūlam anaṇum ataṣṭamūlam

1.8.1.s: pañcāratniprabhṛtyāmnātaṃ pramāṇam /
1.8.1.d: पञ्चारत्निप्रभृत्याम्नातं प्रमाणम् /
1.8.1.m: pañcāratniprabhṛtyāmnātaṃ pramāṇam

1.8.1.s: yūpasya svaruṃ kuryāc caṣālaṃ ca pṛthumātram aṣṭāśri sam̐saktamadhyam /
1.8.1.d: यूपस्य स्वरुं कुर्याच् चषालं च पृथुमात्रम् अष्टाश्रि सम्̐सक्तमध्यम् /
1.8.1.m: yūpasya svaruṃ kuryāc caṣālaṃ ca pṛthumātram aṣṭāśri sam̐saktamadhyam

1.8.1.s: aśribhir aśrīḥ saṃpādyāṅgulimātram ūrdhvaṃ caṣālād yūpasya svaruṃ kuryāt /
1.8.1.d: अश्रिभिर् अश्रीः संपाद्याङ्गुलिमात्रम् ऊर्ध्वं चषालाद् यूपस्य स्वरुं कुर्यात् /
1.8.1.m: aśribhir aśrīḥ saṃpādyāṅgulimātram ūrdhvaṃ caṣālād yūpasya svaruṃ kuryāt

1.8.1.s: vratopetasyedhmābarhiḥ saṃnahyaty āśvavālaḥ prastaro vidhṛtī ca kārṣmaryamayāḥ paridhayo / vim̐śatidārv idhmam /
1.8.1.d: व्रतोपेतस्येध्माबर्हिः संनह्यत्य् आश्ववालः प्रस्तरो विधृती च कार्ष्मर्यमयाः परिधयो / विम्̐शतिदार्व् इध्मम् /
1.8.1.m: vratopetasyedhmābarhiḥ saṃnahyaty āśvavālaḥ prastaro vidhṛtī ca kārṣmaryamayāḥ paridhayo / vim̐śatidārv idhmam

1.8.1.s: vediṃ karoti yathottarām̐ vāruṇapraghāsikīm /
1.8.1.d: वेदिं करोति यथोत्तराम्̐ वारुणप्रघासिकीम् /
1.8.1.m: vediṃ karoti yathottarām̐ vāruṇapraghāsikīm

1.8.1.s: niḥsāraṇāntāṃ kṛtvā vasanti /
1.8.1.d: निःसारणान्तां कृत्वा वसन्ति /
1.8.1.m: niḥsāraṇāntāṃ kṛtvā vasanti

1.8.1.s: śvobhūte pāṇī prakṣālya vihāraṃ paristīrya pāśukāni pātrāṇi prayunakty abhriṃ prathamotpatitaṃ plakṣaśākhām̐ vapāśarapaṇyau raśane śūlaṃ maitrāvaruṇadaṇḍam avadānaśrapaṇīm̐ svarum̐ svadhitiṃ ca /
1.8.1.d: श्वोभूते पाणी प्रक्षाल्य विहारं परिस्तीर्य पाशुकानि पात्राणि प्रयुनक्त्य् अभ्रिं प्रथमोत्पतितं प्लक्षशाखाम्̐ वपाशरपण्यौ रशने शूलं मैत्रावरुणदण्डम् अवदानश्रपणीम्̐ स्वरुम्̐ स्वधितिं च /
1.8.1.m: śvobhūte pāṇī prakṣālya vihāraṃ paristīrya pāśukāni pātrāṇi prayunakty abhriṃ prathamotpatitaṃ plakṣaśākhām̐ vapāśarapaṇyau raśane śūlaṃ maitrāvaruṇadaṇḍam avadānaśrapaṇīm̐ svarum̐ svadhitiṃ ca

1.8.1.s: uttaravedeḥprokṣaṇaprabhṛti siddham ā pūrṇāhuteḥ /
1.8.1.d: उत्तरवेदेःप्रोक्षणप्रभृति सिद्धम् आ पूर्णाहुतेः /
1.8.1.m: uttaravedeḥprokṣaṇaprabhṛti siddham ā pūrṇāhuteḥ

1.8.1.s: pṛṣadājyavanti pātrāṇi prayunakti /
1.8.1.d: पृषदाज्यवन्ति पात्राणि प्रयुनक्ति /
1.8.1.m: pṛṣadājyavanti pātrāṇi prayunakti

1.8.1.s: sam̐sādyolaparājim̐ stṛṇāti /
1.8.1.d: सम्̐साद्योलपराजिम्̐ स्तृणाति /
1.8.1.m: sam̐sādyolaparājim̐ stṛṇāti

1.8.1.s: yajurutpūtābhiḥ prātrāṇi prokṣya dadhyājyaṃ nirupya paryagniṃ karoti /
1.8.1.d: यजुरुत्पूताभिः प्रात्राणि प्रोक्ष्य दध्याज्यं निरुप्य पर्यग्निं करोति /
1.8.1.m: yajurutpūtābhiḥ prātrāṇi prokṣya dadhyājyaṃ nirupya paryagniṃ karoti

1.8.1.s: uttaraṃ parigrāhaṃ parigṛhṇāti /
1.8.1.d: उत्तरं परिग्राहं परिगृह्णाति /
1.8.1.m: uttaraṃ parigrāhaṃ parigṛhṇāti

1.8.1.s: siddham ājyagrahebhyaḥ /
1.8.1.d: सिद्धम् आज्यग्रहेभ्यः /
1.8.1.m: siddham ājyagrahebhyaḥ

1.8.1.s: caturgṛhītāny ājyāni pṛṣadājyavanti gṛhṇāti /
1.8.1.d: चतुर्गृहीतान्य् आज्यानि पृषदाज्यवन्ति गृह्णाति /
1.8.1.m: caturgṛhītāny ājyāni pṛṣadājyavanti gṛhṇāti

1.8.1.s: siddham ājyānām̐ sādanāt /
1.8.1.d: सिद्धम् आज्यानाम्̐ सादनात् /
1.8.1.m: siddham ājyānām̐ sādanāt

1.8.2.s: uttarato gārhapatyasya devasya tvā savituḥ prasave \\ ity abhrim ādatte //
1.8.2.d: उत्तरतो गार्हपत्यस्य देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवे \\ इत्य् अभ्रिम् आदत्ते //
1.8.2.m: uttarato gārhapatyasya devasya tvā savituḥ prasave \\ ity abhrim ādatte

1.8.2.s: abhrir asi \ nārir asi \\ ity abhimantrayate //
1.8.2.d: अभ्रिर् असि \ नारिर् असि \\ इत्य् अभिमन्त्रयते //
1.8.2.m: abhrir asi \ nārir asi \\ ity abhimantrayate

1.8.2.s: idam aham̐ rakṣaso grīvā apikṛntāmi \\ ity agreṇāhavanīyam̐ yūpāvaṭaṃ parilikhati \\ idam aham̐ yo me samānas \\ iti dvitīyam \\ yo 'samānas \\ iti tṛtīyam̐ samānam anyat tūṣṇīṃ caturtham /
1.8.2.d: इदम् अहम्̐ रक्षसो ग्रीवा अपिकृन्तामि \\ इत्य् अग्रेणाहवनीयम्̐ यूपावटं परिलिखति \\ इदम् अहम्̐ यो मे समानस् \\ इति द्वितीयम् \\ यो ऽसमानस् \\ इति तृतीयम्̐ समानम् अन्यत् तूष्णीं चतुर्थम् /
1.8.2.m: idam aham̐ rakṣaso grīvā apikṛntāmi \\ ity agreṇāhavanīyam̐ yūpāvaṭaṃ parilikhati \\ idam aham̐ yo me samānas \\ iti dvitīyam \\ yo 'samānas \\ iti tṛtīyam̐ samānam anyat tūṣṇīṃ caturtham

1.8.2.s: tasyārdham antarvedy ardhaṃ bahirvedy uparasaṃmitaṃ khanati /
1.8.2.d: तस्यार्धम् अन्तर्वेद्य् अर्धं बहिर्वेद्य् उपरसंमितं खनति /
1.8.2.m: tasyārdham antarvedy ardhaṃ bahirvedy uparasaṃmitaṃ khanati

1.8.2.s: yūpaṃ prakṣālya tīrthenānvavahṛtyāgreṇa yūpāvaṭam̐ sam̐stīrṇe prāñcaṃ nidadhāti / mūle prathamotpatitaṃ madhye svarum̐ raśanām agre caṣālam /
1.8.2.d: यूपं प्रक्षाल्य तीर्थेनान्ववहृत्याग्रेण यूपावटम्̐ सम्̐स्तीर्णे प्राञ्चं निदधाति / मूले प्रथमोत्पतितं मध्ये स्वरुम्̐ रशनाम् अग्रे चषालम् /
1.8.2.m: yūpaṃ prakṣālya tīrthenānvavahṛtyāgreṇa yūpāvaṭam̐ sam̐stīrṇe prāñcaṃ nidadhāti / mūle prathamotpatitaṃ madhye svarum̐ raśanām agre caṣālam

1.8.2.s: apsu yavān opya yūpaṃ prokṣati // pṛthivyai tvā \\ iti mūlam antarikṣāya tvā \\ iti madhyam \\ dive tvā \\ ity agram //
1.8.2.d: अप्सु यवान् ओप्य यूपं प्रोक्षति // पृथिव्यै त्वा \\ इति मूलम् अन्तरिक्षाय त्वा \\ इति मध्यम् \\ दिवे त्वा \\ इत्य् अग्रम् //
1.8.2.m: apsu yavān opya yūpaṃ prokṣati // pṛthivyai tvā \\ iti mūlam antarikṣāya tvā \\ iti madhyam \\ dive tvā \\ ity agram

1.8.2.s: śundhantāṃ lokāḥ pitṛṣadanās \\ iti yūpāvaṭam avasiñcati //
1.8.2.d: शुन्धन्तां लोकाः पितृषदनास् \\ इति यूपावटम् अवसिञ्चति //
1.8.2.m: śundhantāṃ lokāḥ pitṛṣadanās \\ iti yūpāvaṭam avasiñcati

1.8.2.s: yavo 'si \\ iti yavān āvapati //
1.8.2.d: यवो ऽसि \\ इति यवान् आवपति //
1.8.2.m: yavo 'si \\ iti yavān āvapati

1.8.2.s: pitṛṣadanaṃ tvā lokam avastṛṇāmi \\ iti darbhair avastṛṇāti //
1.8.2.d: पितृषदनं त्वा लोकम् अवस्तृणामि \\ इति दर्भैर् अवस्तृणाति //
1.8.2.m: pitṛṣadanaṃ tvā lokam avastṛṇāmi \\ iti darbhair avastṛṇāti

1.8.2.s: svāveśo 'si \\ iti prathamotpatitam̐ śalkam avadadhāti //
1.8.2.d: स्वावेशो ऽसि \\ इति प्रथमोत्पतितम्̐ शल्कम् अवदधाति //
1.8.2.m: svāveśo 'si \\ iti prathamotpatitam̐ śalkam avadadhāti

1.8.2.s: ghṛtena dyāvāpṛthivī āpṛṇa \\ ity abhijuhoti //
1.8.2.d: घृतेन द्यावापृथिवी आपृण \\ इत्य् अभिजुहोति //
1.8.2.m: ghṛtena dyāvāpṛthivī āpṛṇa \\ ity abhijuhoti

1.8.2.s: ājyasthālīm̐ sruvaṃ cādāya yūpāyājyam ānāyānubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati //
1.8.2.d: आज्यस्थालीम्̐ स्रुवं चादाय यूपायाज्यम् आनायानुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति //
1.8.2.m: ājyasthālīm̐ sruvaṃ cādāya yūpāyājyam ānāyānubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati

1.8.2.s: devas tvā savitā madhvānaktu \\ iti yajamānaḥ svaktam anakty agrād adhy ā mūlāt \\ indrasya caṣālam asi \\ iti caṣālam //
1.8.2.d: देवस् त्वा सविता मध्वानक्तु \\ इति यजमानः स्वक्तम् अनक्त्य् अग्राद् अध्य् आ मूलात् \\ इन्द्रस्य चषालम् असि \\ इति चषालम् //
1.8.2.m: devas tvā savitā madhvānaktu \\ iti yajamānaḥ svaktam anakty agrād adhy ā mūlāt \\ indrasya caṣālam asi \\ iti caṣālam

1.8.2.s: supippalā oṣadhīs kṛdhi \\ iti pratimuñcati /
1.8.2.d: सुपिप्पला ओषधीस् कृधि \\ इति प्रतिमुञ्चति /
1.8.2.m: supippalā oṣadhīs kṛdhi \\ iti pratimuñcati

1.8.2.s: aktaṃ nāvasṛjed ā parivyayaṇāt //
1.8.2.d: अक्तं नावसृजेद् आ परिव्ययणात् //
1.8.2.m: aktaṃ nāvasṛjed ā parivyayaṇāt

1.8.2.s: yūpāyocchriyamāṇāyānubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati //
1.8.2.d: यूपायोच्छ्रियमाणायानुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति //
1.8.2.m: yūpāyocchriyamāṇāyānubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati

1.8.2.s: divam agreṇottabhāna \\ ity ucchrayati //
1.8.2.d: दिवम् अग्रेणोत्तभान \\ इत्य् उच्छ्रयति //
1.8.2.m: divam agreṇottabhāna \\ ity ucchrayati

1.8.2.s: tā te dhāmāni \\ ity avadadhāti //
1.8.2.d: ता ते धामानि \\ इत्य् अवदधाति //
1.8.2.m: tā te dhāmāni \\ ity avadadhāti

1.8.2.s: viṣṇoḥ karmāṇi paśyata \\ iti paścādupastham̐ samam̐ sthāpayaty agnim abhimukhām agniṣṭhām //
1.8.2.d: विष्णोः कर्माणि पश्यत \\ इति पश्चादुपस्थम्̐ समम्̐ स्थापयत्य् अग्निम् अभिमुखाम् अग्निष्ठाम् //
1.8.2.m: viṣṇoḥ karmāṇi paśyata \\ iti paścādupastham̐ samam̐ sthāpayaty agnim abhimukhām agniṣṭhām

1.8.2.s: brahmavaniṃ tvā kṣatravaniṃ paryūhāmi \\ iti pām̐subhiḥ paryūhati //
1.8.2.d: ब्रह्मवनिं त्वा क्षत्रवनिं पर्यूहामि \\ इति पाम्̐सुभिः पर्यूहति //
1.8.2.m: brahmavaniṃ tvā kṣatravaniṃ paryūhāmi \\ iti pām̐subhiḥ paryūhati

1.8.2.s: brahma dṛm̐ha \ kṣatraṃ dṛm̐ha \\ iti yajamāno maitrāvaruṇadaṇḍena pradakṣiṇam̐ saṃmṛśati /
1.8.2.d: ब्रह्म दृम्̐ह \ क्षत्रं दृम्̐ह \\ इति यजमानो मैत्रावरुणदण्डेन प्रदक्षिणम्̐ संमृशति /
1.8.2.m: brahma dṛm̐ha \ kṣatraṃ dṛm̐ha \\ iti yajamāno maitrāvaruṇadaṇḍena pradakṣiṇam̐ saṃmṛśati

1.8.2.s: apo 'nupariṣiñcati /
1.8.2.d: अपो ऽनुपरिषिञ्चति /

1.8.2.s: darbhānām̐ raśane dviguṇā dvivyāyāmā triguṇā trivyāyāmā //
1.8.2.d: दर्भानाम्̐ रशने द्विगुणा द्विव्यायामा त्रिगुणा त्रिव्यायामा //
1.8.2.m: darbhānām̐ raśane dviguṇā dvivyāyāmā triguṇā trivyāyāmā

1.8.2.s: tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam iti trivṛtā svaruṇā ca yūpam ūrdhvaṃ triḥ samunmārṣṭi //
1.8.2.d: तद् विष्णोः परमं पदम् इति त्रिवृता स्वरुणा च यूपम् ऊर्ध्वं त्रिः समुन्मार्ष्टि //
1.8.2.m: tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam iti trivṛtā svaruṇā ca yūpam ūrdhvaṃ triḥ samunmārṣṭi

1.8.2.s: yūpāya parivīyamāṇāyānubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati //
1.8.2.d: यूपाय परिवीयमाणायानुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति //
1.8.2.m: yūpāya parivīyamāṇāyānubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati

1.8.2.s: parivīr asi \\ iti nābhidaghne trivṛtā triḥ parivyayaty uttaramuttaraṃ pradakṣiṇam /
1.8.2.d: परिवीर् असि \\ इति नाभिदघ्ने त्रिवृता त्रिः परिव्ययत्य् उत्तरमुत्तरं प्रदक्षिणम् /
1.8.2.m: parivīr asi \\ iti nābhidaghne trivṛtā triḥ parivyayaty uttaramuttaraṃ pradakṣiṇam

1.8.2.s: prādeśamātre samasyāṇīyām̐sam̐ sthavīyasy upakarṣati /
1.8.2.d: प्रादेशमात्रे समस्याणीयाम्̐सम्̐ स्थवीयस्य् उपकर्षति /
1.8.2.m: prādeśamātre samasyāṇīyām̐sam̐ sthavīyasy upakarṣati

1.8.2.s: ūrdhvām uduhya raśanām \\ divaḥ sānūpeṣa \\ ity uttarato 'gniṣṭhāyā uttame guṇe svarum upakarṣati //
1.8.2.d: ऊर्ध्वाम् उदुह्य रशनाम् \\ दिवः सानूपेष \\ इत्य् उत्तरतो ऽग्निष्ठाया उत्तमे गुणे स्वरुम् उपकर्षति //
1.8.2.m: ūrdhvām uduhya raśanām \\ divaḥ sānūpeṣa \\ ity uttarato 'gniṣṭhāyā uttame guṇe svarum upakarṣati

1.8.2.s: snātam ānaya \\ iti preṣyati /
1.8.2.d: स्नातम् आनय \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
1.8.2.m: He gives the order: "Bring him who has bathed!"

1.8.2.s: ajam apratiṣiddham̐ rohitaṃ dvirūpaṃ [ vā ] kālālaṃ pīvānam̐ samāṅgaṃ pannadaṃ tīrthena prapādya purastāt pratyaṅmukham avasthāpayati /
1.8.2.d: अजम् अप्रतिषिद्धम्̐ रोहितं द्विरूपं [ वा ] कालालं पीवानम्̐ समाङ्गं पन्नदं तीर्थेन प्रपाद्य पुरस्तात् प्रत्यङ्मुखम् अवस्थापयति /
1.8.2.m: Having brought in by the tirtha an unblemished he-goat, red or of two colors, black-spotted, fat, with symmetrical limbs, and that has shed its teeth, he makes it stand in the front facing west.

1.8.3.s:
prajāpater jāyamānāḥ \ prajā jātāś ca yā imā /
tā asmai prativedaya \ cikitvān anumanyatām //
imaṃ paśuṃ paśupate te 'dya \ badhnāmy agne sukṛtāsya madhye /
anumanyasva suyajā yaje hi \ juṣṭaṃ devebhya idam astu havyam //
ity aupākaraṇau juhoti //
1.8.3.d:
प्रजापतेर् जायमानाः \ प्रजा जाताश् च या इमा /
ता अस्मै प्रतिवेदय \ चिकित्वान् अनुमन्यताम् //
इमं पशुं पशुपते ते ऽद्य \ बध्नाम्य् अग्ने सुकृतास्य मध्ये /
अनुमन्यस्व सुयजा यजे हि \ जुष्टं देवेभ्य इदम् अस्तु हव्यम् //
इत्य् औपाकरणौ जुहोति //
1.8.3.m:
"The offspring of Prajāpati being born, / and these offspring that have been born—

report them to him; / let the mindful one approve."

"This animal, O lord of animals, for you today / I bind, O Agni, in the midst of the well-performed [rite].

Approve [it], for I sacrifice with a good sacrifice; / let this oblation be pleasing to the gods."

With these [two verses], he offers the two dedicating oblations.

1.8.3.s: iṣe tvā \\ iti darbhāv ādatte // upāvīr asi \\ iti hariṇīṃ plakṣaśākhāṃ palāśavatīm //
1.8.3.d: इषे त्वा \\ इति दर्भाव् आदत्ते // उपावीर् असि \\ इति हरिणीं प्लक्षशाखां पलाशवतीम् //
1.8.3.m: With "For food thee!" he takes two darbha blades. With "Thou art the helper!" [he takes] a green twig of the plakṣa tree with leaves.

1.8.3.s:
upo devān daivīr viśas \\ iti darbhābhyām̐ śākhayā copaspṛśyopākṛtya pañca juhoti
prajānantaḥ pratigṛhṇantu pūrve \ prāṇam aṅgebhyo 'dhi niścarantam /
huto yāhi pathibhir devayānair \ oṣadhīṣu pratitiṣṭhā śarīraiḥ //
ye badhyamānam //
ya āraṇyāḥ paśavo viśvarūpās\ virūpāḥ santo bahudhaikarūpāḥ /
vāyuṣ ṭaṃ agre pramumoktu devaḥ \ prajāpatiḥ prajayā sam̐rarāṇaḥ //
yeṣām īśe paśupatiḥ paśūnām\ catuṣpāda uta ye dvipādaḥ /
niṣkrītās te yajñiyaṃ bhāgam̐ yantu \ rāyaspoṣā yajamānam̐ sacantām //
pramuñcamānā bhuvanasya retas\ gātuṃ dhatta yajamānāya devāḥ /
upākṛtam̐ śaśamānam̐ sadhasthāt\ jīvaṃ devānām apyetu pāthaḥ //
iti hutvā nirmanthena pracarati / sa vyākhyātaḥ //
1.8.3.d:
उपो देवान् दैवीर् विशस् \\ इति दर्भाभ्याम्̐ शाखया चोपस्पृश्योपाकृत्य पञ्च जुहोति
प्रजानन्तः प्रतिगृह्णन्तु पूर्वे \ प्राणम् अङ्गेभ्यो ऽधि निश्चरन्तम् /
हुतो याहि पथिभिर् देवयानैर् \ ओषधीषु प्रतितिष्ठा शरीरैः //
ये बध्यमानम् //
य आरण्याः पशवो विश्वरूपास्\ विरूपाः सन्तो बहुधैकरूपाः /
वायुष् टं अग्रे प्रमुमोक्तु देवः \ प्रजापतिः प्रजया सम्̐रराणः //
येषाम् ईशे पशुपतिः पशूनाम्\ चतुष्पाद उत ये द्विपादः /
निष्क्रीतास् ते यज्ञियं भागम्̐ यन्तु \ रायस्पोषा यजमानम्̐ सचन्ताम् //
प्रमुञ्चमाना भुवनस्य रेतस्\ गातुं धत्त यजमानाय देवाः /
उपाकृतम्̐ शशमानम्̐ सधस्थात्\ जीवं देवानाम् अप्येतु पाथः //
इति हुत्वा निर्मन्थेन प्रचरति / स व्याख्यातः //
1.8.3.m:
Having touched and dedicated [the animal] with the two darbha blades and the twig with "Approach the gods, the divine peoples!", he offers five [oblations]:

"Knowing, let the ancients receive / the breath going out from the limbs;

offered, go by the paths traveled by the gods; / stand firm among the plants with thy bodies."

"The wild animals of all forms, / being diverse, manifold, of one form,

let god Vāyu release that one at first, / Prajāpati rejoicing with offspring."

"The animals over which the lord of animals rules, / the four-footed and the two-footed,

bought off, let them go to the sacrificial portion; / let riches and abundance accompany the sacrificer."

"Releasing the seed of the world, / grant a path to the sacrificer, O gods;

dedicated, stilled from the gathering place, / alive let it go to the food of the gods."

1.8.3.s: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave \\ iti raśanām ādatte /
1.8.3.d: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवे \\ इति रशनाम् आदत्ते /
1.8.3.m:
Having offered [these], he proceeds with the friction-fire; that has [already] been explained.

With "At the impulse of god Savitṛ..." he takes the halter.

1.8.3.s: dakṣiṇaṃ bāhuṃ parihṛtyordhvam unmṛjya \\ ṛtasya tvā devahaviḥ pāśena \\ iti yathādevatam akṣṇayā śirasy upadadhāti //
1.8.3.d: दक्षिणं बाहुं परिहृत्योर्ध्वम् उन्मृज्य \\ ऋतस्य त्वा देवहविः पाशेन \\ इति यथादेवतम् अक्ष्णया शिरस्य् उपदधाति //
1.8.3.m: Having wrapped his right arm [with it] and stroked it upward, he lays it across the head according to the deity with "With the noose of truth, O divine oblation..."

1.8.3.s: dharṣā mānuṣas \\ ity uttarato yūpe raśanayāvāṅ niyunakti //
1.8.3.d: धर्षा मानुषस् \\ इत्य् उत्तरतो यूपे रशनयावाङ् नियुनक्ति //
1.8.3.m: With "Thou art bold, the human..." he binds [the animal] downward on the sacrificial post to the north with the halter.

1.8.3.s: adbhyas tvauṣadhībhyas \\ iti prokṣati //
1.8.3.d: अद्भ्यस् त्वौषधीभ्यस् \\ इति प्रोक्षति //
1.8.3.m: With "For the waters, for the plants..." he sprinkles [it].

1.8.3.s: anu tvā mātā manyatām ity anumānayati //
1.8.3.d: अनु त्वा माता मन्यताम् इत्य् अनुमानयति //
1.8.3.m: He makes [its relatives] give consent with "Let thy mother give consent to thee..."

1.8.3.s: apāṃ perur asi \\ ity apa upapāyayati //
1.8.3.d: अपां पेरुर् असि \\ इत्य् अप उपपाययति //
1.8.3.m: With "Thou art the drinker of waters!" he makes it drink water.

1.8.3.s: svāttam̐ sad dhavir ity uraḥ prokṣan sarvataḥ prokṣati /
1.8.3.d: स्वात्तम्̐ सद् धविर् इत्य् उरः प्रोक्षन् सर्वतः प्रोक्षति /
1.8.3.m: With "Being a sweet oblation...", sprinkling its chest, he sprinkles it on all sides.

1.8.3.s: pūrṇasruvam̐ sādayitvā siddham āghārāt /
1.8.3.d: पूर्णस्रुवम्̐ सादयित्वा सिद्धम् आघारात् /
1.8.3.m: Having placed the full sruva spoon, [the procedure] is established up to the pouring of the clarifying line of butter.

1.8.3.s: sraucam āghāram āghārya juhvā paśum anakti saṃ te vāyur iti prāṇadeśe sam̐ yajatrair aṅgāni \\ iti kakubdeśe sam̐ yajñapatir āśiṣā \\ iti bhasadi /
1.8.3.d: स्रौचम् आघारम् आघार्य जुह्वा पशुम् अनक्ति सं ते वायुर् इति प्राणदेशे सम्̐ यजत्रैर् अङ्गानि \\ इति ककुब्देशे सम्̐ यज्ञपतिर् आशिषा \\ इति भसदि /
1.8.3.m: Having poured the clarifying line of butter with the sruc, he anoints the animal with the juhū: on the region of breath with "May Vāyu unite with thee!", on the region of the hump with "May the limbs unite with the worshipful ones!", on the rump with "May the lord of the sacrifice unite with the prayer!"

1.8.3.s: siddham ā pravarāt /
1.8.3.d: सिद्धम् आ प्रवरात् /

1.8.3.s: pravṛte maitrāvaruṇāyaudumbaram āsyadaghnaṃ daṇḍam \\ mitrāvaruṇayos tvā bāhubhyāṃ prayachāmi \\ iti prayachati /
1.8.3.d: प्रवृते मैत्रावरुणायौदुम्बरम् आस्यदघ्नं दण्डम् \\ मित्रावरुणयोस् त्वा बाहुभ्यां प्रयछामि \\ इति प्रयछति /
1.8.3.m: When [the hotṛ] is chosen, he hands over to the maitrāvaruṇa priest an udumbara staff reaching up to the mouth with "With the arms of Mitra and Varuṇa I hand [thee] over!"

1.8.3.s: siddham ā prayājebhyaḥ /
1.8.3.d: सिद्धम् आ प्रयाजेभ्यः /
1.8.3.m: [The procedure] is established up to the fore-offerings.

1.8.3.s: āśrāvam ekādaśa prayājān yajati //
1.8.3.d: आश्रावम् एकादश प्रयाजान् यजति //
1.8.3.m: Having called for the call, he offers eleven fore-offerings.

1.8.3.s: samidbhyaḥ preṣya \\ iti prathamam \\ preṣya preṣya \\ ity uttarān /
1.8.3.d: समिद्भ्यः प्रेष्य \\ इति प्रथमम् \\ प्रेष्य प्रेष्य \\ इत्य् उत्तरान् /
1.8.3.m: With "Prompt for the firewood!" for the first; with "Prompt, prompt!" for the subsequent ones.

1.8.3.s: caturthecaturthe samānīyaikādaśāya śiṣṭvātyākramya saṃgṛhya svarum̐ svadhitiṃ juhvām aktvā ghṛtenāktau paśūm̐s trāyethām ity antarāśṛṅge svaruṇā paśum anakty aspṛśan svadhitinā /
1.8.3.d: चतुर्थेचतुर्थे समानीयैकादशाय शिष्ट्वात्याक्रम्य संगृह्य स्वरुम्̐ स्वधितिं जुह्वाम् अक्त्वा घृतेनाक्तौ पशूम्̐स् त्रायेथाम् इत्य् अन्तराशृङ्गे स्वरुणा पशुम् अनक्त्य् अस्पृशन् स्वधितिना /
1.8.3.m: Pouring [clarified butter] together at every fourth [offering], leaving [some] for the eleventh, stepping across, having taken hold of the chip and the sacrificial knife and anointed them in the juhū, he anoints the animal between the horns with the chip with "Anointed with clarified butter, protect the animals!", not touching [it] with the sacrificial knife.

1.8.3.s: aktayā śṛtasyāvadyaty anaktayā viśasati /
1.8.3.d: अक्तया शृतस्यावद्यत्य् अनक्तया विशसति /
1.8.3.m: With the anointed [portion of the knife] he cuts off the cooked [flesh]; with the unanointed [portion] he dismembers [the animal].

1.8.3.s: uttarataścātvālasya śāmitrāya lakṣaṇaṃ karoti /
1.8.3.d: उत्तरतश्चात्वालस्य शामित्राय लक्षणं करोति /
1.8.3.m: To the north of the pit he makes a mark for the slaughtering place.

1.8.3.s: uddhatyāvokṣya paryagnaye kriyamāṇāyānubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati /
1.8.3.d: उद्धत्यावोक्ष्य पर्यग्नये क्रियमाणायानुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति /
1.8.3.m: Having raised [the earth] and sprinkled water, he makes [the hotṛ] recite with "Recite for the fire being carried around [the animal]!"

1.8.3.s: āhavanīyād ulmukena paśum āhavanīyam̐ yūpam ājyāni cātvālam̐ śāmitralakṣaṇe nidhāyanidhāya triḥ paryagniṃ karoti /
1.8.3.d: आहवनीयाद् उल्मुकेन पशुम् आहवनीयम्̐ यूपम् आज्यानि चात्वालम्̐ शामित्रलक्षणे निधायनिधाय त्रिः पर्यग्निं करोति /
1.8.3.m: With a firebrand from the āhavanīya fire, placing [it] repeatedly on the animal, the āhavanīya fire, the sacrificial post, the clarified butter portions, the pit, and the mark of the slaughtering place, he performs the carrying around of the fire three times.

1.8.3.s: ulmukam āgnīdhrāya pradāya ye badhyamānam \\ ya āraṇyāḥ \ pramuñcamānās \\ iti tisra āhutīr juhoti /
1.8.3.d: उल्मुकम् आग्नीध्राय प्रदाय ये बध्यमानम् \\ य आरण्याः \ प्रमुञ्चमानास् \\ इति तिस्र आहुतीर् जुहोति /
1.8.3.m: Having given the firebrand to the āgnīdhra priest, he offers three oblations with "Those who to the bound one...", "The wild animals...", [and] "Releasing..."

1.8.3.s: yūpāt pramucya paśum anvārabhyāśrāvayati /
1.8.3.d: यूपात् प्रमुच्य पशुम् अन्वारभ्याश्रावयति /
1.8.3.m: Having released the animal from the sacrificial post and touched it from behind, he causes [the call] to be proclaimed.

1.8.3.s: pratyāśruta upapreṣya hotar havyā devebhyas iti preṣyati /
1.8.3.d: प्रत्याश्रुत उपप्रेष्य होतर् हव्या देवेभ्यस् इति प्रेष्यति /
1.8.3.m: When the response has been made, he prompts with "Prompt, O hotṛ, the oblations to the gods!"

1.8.3.s: kārṣmaryasya vapāśrapaṇyāv ekaśṛṅgā dviśṛṅgā ca / tābhyām̐ yajamānas \\ revati predhā \\ iti paśum anvārabhate //
1.8.3.d: कार्ष्मर्यस्य वपाश्रपण्याव् एकशृङ्गा द्विशृङ्गा च / ताभ्याम्̐ यजमानस् \\ रेवति प्रेधा \\ इति पशुम् अन्वारभते //
1.8.3.m: There are two omentum-spits of kārkandhu wood: one single-pronged and one double-pronged. With them, the sacrificer touches the animal from behind with "O wealthy one, go forth!"

1.8.3.s: uro antarikṣa \\ ity udañcaṃ prakramayati /
1.8.3.d: उरो अन्तरिक्ष \\ इत्य् उदञ्चं प्रक्रमयति /
1.8.3.m: With "Broad atmosphere..." he makes it step forward to the north.

1.8.3.s: ulmukam āgnīdhro 'grato hṛtvā śāmitralakṣaṇe nidadhāti /
1.8.3.d: उल्मुकम् आग्नीध्रो ऽग्रतो हृत्वा शामित्रलक्षणे निदधाति /
1.8.3.m: The āgnīdhra priest, carrying the firebrand ahead, places it on the mark of the slaughtering place.

1.8.3.s: dakṣiṇataḥpaścāc chāmitrasya samasya tanvā bhava \\ ity aupākaraṇaṃ darbhaṃ nyasyati /
1.8.3.d: दक्षिणतःपश्चाच् छामित्रस्य समस्य तन्वा भव \\ इत्य् औपाकरणं दर्भं न्यस्यति /
1.8.3.m: To the southwest of the slaughtering place he casts down the dedicating darbha blade with "Be united with its body!"

1.8.3.s: tasmiñ śamitā pratyakśirasam udakpādam antar evoṣmāṇam̐ sam̐jñapayati /
1.8.3.d: तस्मिञ् शमिता प्रत्यक्शिरसम् उदक्पादम् अन्तर् एवोष्माणम्̐ सम्̐ज्ञपयति /
1.8.3.m: Upon it, the slaughterer suffocates [the animal] with its head to the west and feet to the north, keeping its breath within.

1.8.3.s:
nānā prāṇo yajamānasya paśunā \ yajño devebhiḥ saha devayānaḥ /
samyag āyur yajñam̐ yajñapatau dhāḥ //
ity uktvāvartate //
1.8.3.d:
नाना प्राणो यजमानस्य पशुना \ यज्ञो देवेभिः सह देवयानः /
सम्यग् आयुर् यज्ञम्̐ यज्ञपतौ धाः //
इत्य् उक्त्वावर्तते //
1.8.3.m:
"Separate is the breath of the sacrificer and that of the animal; / the sacrifice with the gods goes to the gods;

place complete life, the sacrifice, in the lord of the sacrifice."

1.8.3.s: svarvid asi \\ iti saṃjñapyamāne yajamāno japati //
1.8.3.d: स्वर्विद् असि \\ इति संज्ञप्यमाने यजमानो जपति //
1.8.3.m: While [the animal] is being suffocated, the sacrificer mutters: "Thou art heaven-finding!"

1.8.3.s: iha prajā viśvarūpā ramantām ity avekṣamāṇāḥ pṛṣadājyam āśāsate yāvat paśusaṃjñapanāt /
1.8.3.d: इह प्रजा विश्वरूपा रमन्ताम् इत्य् अवेक्षमाणाः पृषदाज्यम् आशासते यावत् पशुसंज्ञपनात् /
1.8.3.m: Looking on with "Here let offspring of all forms rejoice!", they pray for the speckled clarified butter until the suffocation of the animal.

1.8.3.s:
yat paśur māyum akṛta\ uro vā padbhir āhate /
agnir nas tasmād enasas\ viśvān muñcatv am̐hasaḥ //
iti saṃjñaptahomaṃ juhoti //
1.8.3.d:
यत् पशुर् मायुम् अकृत\ उरो वा पद्भिर् आहते /
अग्निर् नस् तस्माद् एनसस्\ विश्वान् मुञ्चत्व् अम्̐हसः //
इति संज्ञप्तहोमं जुहोति //
1.8.3.m:
"If the animal made a bleat, / or struck its chest with its feet,

from that sin let Agni release us, / from all distress."

With this [verse] he offers the suffocation expiation oblation.

1.8.3.s: śamitāra upetana \\ iti japati //
1.8.3.d: शमितार उपेतन \\ इति जपति //
1.8.3.m: He mutters: "O slaughterers, approach!"

1.8.3.s: aditiḥ pāśān ity unmuñcati raśanāṃ paśoḥ //
1.8.3.d: अदितिः पाशान् इत्य् उन्मुञ्चति रशनां पशोः //
1.8.3.m: With "Aditi [loosens] the bonds..." he loosens the halter from the animal.

1.8.3.s: yo no dveṣṭy adharaḥ sa padyatām ity abhicarataḥ stambaṃ dāru vāpidadhyāt tūṣṇīm anabhicarataḥ /
1.8.3.d: यो नो द्वेष्ट्य् अधरः स पद्यताम् इत्य् अभिचरतः स्तम्बं दारु वापिदध्यात् तूष्णीम् अनभिचरतः /
1.8.3.m: With "Whoever hates us, let him fall low!" he should cover a clump of grass or a piece of wood for one who performs sorcery; silently for one who does not perform sorcery.

1.8.3.s: ekaśṛṅgayā cātvāle raśanāṃ pravidhyati /
1.8.3.d: एकशृङ्गया चात्वाले रशनां प्रविध्यति /
1.8.3.m: With the single-pronged [spit] he flings the halter into the pit.

1.8.4.s: namas ta ātāna \\ iti patnīm ādityam upasthāpayati //
1.8.4.d: नमस् त आतान \\ इति पत्नीम् आदित्यम् उपस्थापयति //
1.8.4.m: With "Homage to thee, O extended one!" he makes the wife revere the sun.

1.8.4.s: anarvā prehi \\ ity abhyudānayati //
1.8.4.d: अनर्वा प्रेहि \\ इत्य् अभ्युदानयति //
1.8.4.m: With "Go forth unopposed!" he brings her forward toward [the pit].

1.8.4.s: devīr āpas \\ iti cātvāle patny apo 'bhimantrayate //
1.8.4.d: देवीर् आपस् \\ इति चात्वाले पत्न्य् अपो ऽभिमन्त्रयते //
1.8.4.m: With "O divine waters..." the wife addresses the waters in the pit with a sacred formula.

1.8.4.s: vācam asya mā him̐sīḥ \ prāṇam asya mā him̐sīr iti yathāliṅgam aṅgāni prakṣālayati patny āsiñcati // yat te krūram iti kaṇṭham //
1.8.4.d: वाचम् अस्य मा हिम्̐सीः \ प्राणम् अस्य मा हिम्̐सीर् इति यथालिङ्गम् अङ्गानि प्रक्षालयति पत्न्य् आसिञ्चति // यत् ते क्रूरम् इति कण्ठम् //
1.8.4.m: With [the formulas]: 'Do not harm his voice,' and 'Do not harm his breath,' he washes the limbs according to the characteristic words; the wife pours [water]. With 'What is raw of you,' [he touches or washes] the throat.

1.8.4.s: gātrāṇy asya mā him̐sīs \ caritrān asya mā him̐sīr iti yathāliṅgam aṅgāni saṃmṛśati //
1.8.4.d: गात्राण्य् अस्य मा हिम्̐सीस् \ चरित्रान् अस्य मा हिम्̐सीर् इति यथालिङ्गम् अङ्गानि संमृशति //
1.8.4.m: With: 'Do not harm his limbs,' and 'Do not harm his organs of motion,' he touches the limbs according to the characteristic words.

1.8.4.s: śam adbhyas \\ ity apām̐ stokān bhūmigatān anumantrayate //
1.8.4.d: शम् अद्भ्यस् \\ इत्य् अपाम्̐ स्तोकान् भूमिगतान् अनुमन्त्रयते //
1.8.4.m: With: 'Homage to the waters,' he accompanies the drops of water that have fallen to the ground.

1.8.4.s: oṣadhe trāyasvainam ity aupākaraṇaṃ darbham agreṇa nābheḥ pārśvato nidadhāti //
1.8.4.d: ओषधे त्रायस्वैनम् इत्य् औपाकरणं दर्भम् अग्रेण नाभेः पार्श्वतो निदधाति //
1.8.4.m: With: 'O plant, protect him,' he places the grass-blade used at the dedicating rite across by the side, in front of the navel.

1.8.4.s: svadhite mainam̐ him̐sīr iti svadhitinā tiryag āchinatti /
1.8.4.d: स्वधिते मैनम्̐ हिम्̐सीर् इति स्वधितिना तिर्यग् आछिनत्ति /
1.8.4.m: With: 'O knife, do not harm him,' he cuts horizontally with the sacrificial knife.

1.8.4.s: tvacaṃ cāgram upaniyamya mūlam āśasane 'ktvā pṛthivyai tvā \ rakṣasāṃ bhāgo 'si \\ iti dakṣiṇāparam avāntaradeśaṃ nyasyati //
1.8.4.d: त्वचं चाग्रम् उपनियम्य मूलम् आशसने ऽक्त्वा पृथिव्यै त्वा \ रक्षसां भागो ऽसि \\ इति दक्षिणापरम् अवान्तरदेशं न्यस्यति //
1.8.4.m: Having drawn near the tip [of the grass-blade] and the skin, and having smeared its root at the slaughter-place, he casts it to the south-west intermediate quarter with: 'To the earth, you; you are the portion of the demons.'

1.8.4.s: idam aham̐ rakṣo 'vabādhe \\ idam aham̐ rakṣo 'dhamaṃ tamo nayāmi \\ iti pārṣṇyā nyadhitiṣṭhate //
1.8.4.d: इदम् अहम्̐ रक्षो ऽवबाधे \\ इदम् अहम्̐ रक्षो ऽधमं तमो नयामि \\ इति पार्ष्ण्या न्यधितिष्ठते //
1.8.4.m: With: 'Here do I press down the demon; here do I lead the demon to the lowest darkness,' he treads upon it with his heel.

1.8.4.s: iṣe tvā \\ iti vapām utkhidati //
1.8.4.d: इषे त्वा \\ इति वपाम् उत्खिदति //
1.8.4.m: With: 'For vigor, you,' he pulls out the omentum.

1.8.4.s: ūrje tvā \\ ity ekaśṛṅgayā taniṣṭha upatṛṇatti //
1.8.4.d: ऊर्जे त्वा \\ इत्य् एकशृङ्गया तनिष्ठ उपतृणत्ति //
1.8.4.m: With: 'For strength, you,' he pierces [it] with the single-pronged spit where it is thinnest.

1.8.4.s: devabhyaḥ śundhasva \\ ity adbhir avokṣate //
1.8.4.d: देवभ्यः शुन्धस्व \\ इत्य् अद्भिर् अवोक्षते //
1.8.4.m: With: 'Be purified for the gods,' he sprinkles it with water.

1.8.4.s: devebhyaḥ śumbhasva \\ iti svadhitinā vapāṃ pratyūhati //
1.8.4.d: देवेभ्यः शुम्भस्व \\ इति स्वधितिना वपां प्रत्यूहति //
1.8.4.m: With: 'Be adorned for the gods,' he pushes back the omentum with the knife.

1.8.4.s: ghṛtena dyāvāpṛthivī prorṇuvātām iti dviśṛṅgāṃ prachādayati //
1.8.4.d: घृतेन द्यावापृथिवी प्रोर्णुवाताम् इति द्विशृङ्गां प्रछादयति //
1.8.4.m: With: 'May heaven and earth cover each other with clarified butter,' he covers [it] with the two-pronged spit.

1.8.4.s: amuṣmai tvā \\ iti yathādevatam̐ vapām utkṛntati /
1.8.4.d: अमुष्मै त्वा \\ इति यथादेवतम्̐ वपाम् उत्कृन्तति /
1.8.4.m: With: 'For so-and-so, you,' according to the divinity, he cuts off the omentum.

1.8.4.s: muṣṭinā śamitā vapoddharaṇam̐ saṃgṛhyāsītā vapāyā homāt //
1.8.4.d: मुष्टिना शमिता वपोद्धरणम्̐ संगृह्यासीता वपाया होमात् //
1.8.4.m: Grasping the instrument for taking out the omentum with his fist, the slaughterer sits until the offering of the omentum.

1.8.4.s: namaḥ sūryasya saṃdṛśe \\ ity ādityam upatiṣṭhate //
1.8.4.d: नमः सूर्यस्य संदृशे \\ इत्य् आदित्यम् उपतिष्ठते //
1.8.4.m: With: 'Homage to the sight of the sun,' [the adhvaryu] attends the sun.

1.8.4.s: urv antarikṣam̐ vīhi \\ iti samayā paśum̐ vapām̐ harati //
1.8.4.d: उर्व् अन्तरिक्षम्̐ वीहि \\ इति समया पशुम्̐ वपाम्̐ हरति //
1.8.4.m: With: 'Traverse the broad intermediate space,' he carries the omentum across the animal.

1.8.4.s: pratyuṣṭam̐ rakṣas \\ iti śāmitre niṣṭapati /
1.8.4.d: प्रत्युष्टम्̐ रक्षस् \\ इति शामित्रे निष्टपति /
1.8.4.m: With: 'Scorched is the demon,' he roasts it at the slaughterer's fire.

1.8.4.s: ulmukam āgnīdhro 'grato hṛtvāhavanīye pratyavasṛjati /
1.8.4.d: उल्मुकम् आग्नीध्रो ऽग्रतो हृत्वाहवनीये प्रत्यवसृजति /
1.8.4.m: The āgnīdhra priest, having carried a firebrand in front, deposits it back into the āhavanīya fire.

1.8.4.s: antarāgnim̐ yūpaṃ ca harati /
1.8.4.d: अन्तराग्निम्̐ यूपं च हरति /
1.8.4.m: He carries [it] between the fire and the sacrificial post.

1.8.4.s: dakṣiṇataḥ pratiprasthātāsīno vapām̐ śrapayati //
1.8.4.d: दक्षिणतः प्रतिप्रस्थातासीनो वपाम्̐ श्रपयति //
1.8.4.m: The pratiprasthātṛ priest, seated to the south, cooks the omentum.

1.8.4.s: vāyoḥ stokānām iti darbhāgram upāsyati /
1.8.4.d: वायोः स्तोकानाम् इति दर्भाग्रम् उपास्यति /
1.8.4.m: With: 'Of the drops of Vāyu,' he casts the tip of the darbha-grass into [the fire].

1.8.4.s:
tvām u te dadhire devayanto havyavāham\ śṛtaṃkartāram uta yajñiyaṃ ca /
agniḥ sudakṣaḥ sutanur ha bhūtvā \ devebhyo havyā vaha jātavedaḥ //
iti vapām abhijuhoti //
1.8.4.d:
त्वाम् उ ते दधिरे देवयन्तो हव्यवाहम्\ शृतंकर्तारम् उत यज्ञियं च /
अग्निः सुदक्षः सुतनुर् ह भूत्वा \ देवेभ्यो हव्या वह जातवेदः //
इति वपाम् अभिजुहोति //
1.8.4.m:
With: 'Thee, indeed, the god-fearing have appointed as oblation-bearer, as cook, and worthy of sacrifice;

Having become Agni, very skillful and well-formed, bear the oblations to the gods, O Jātavedas'—

1.8.4.s: stokebhyo 'nubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati /
1.8.4.d: स्तोकेभ्यो ऽनुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति /
1.8.4.m: With: 'Recite [the invitatory verse] for the drops,' he causes [the hotṛ] to recite.

1.8.4.s: śyenīm̐ śṛtām \\ supippalā oṣadhīs kṛdhi \\ iti dakṣiṇato barhiṣi sādayati //
1.8.4.d: श्येनीम्̐ शृताम् \\ सुपिप्पला ओषधीस् कृधि \\ इति दक्षिणतो बर्हिषि सादयति //
1.8.4.m: With: 'Cooked white, make the plants bear good fruit,' he sets it down to the south on the sacrificial grass.

1.8.4.s: prayutā dveṣām̐si \\ iti vapāśrapaṇyau pravṛhati //
1.8.4.d: प्रयुता द्वेषाम्̐सि \\ इति वपाश्रपण्यौ प्रवृहति //
1.8.4.m: With: 'Turned aside are the enmities,' he pulls out the two omentum-spits.

1.8.4.s: svāhākṛtibhyaḥ preṣya \\ ity uttamena prayājena pracaryātyākramyābhighārayati dhruvāṃ pṛṣadājyam̐ vapāṃ nopabhṛtam /
1.8.4.d: स्वाहाकृतिभ्यः प्रेष्य \\ इत्य् उत्तमेन प्रयाजेन प्रचर्यात्याक्रम्याभिघारयति ध्रुवां पृषदाज्यम्̐ वपां नोपभृतम् /
1.8.4.m: Having performed the last fore-offering with the call: 'Prompt [the hotṛ to recite] for the Svāhā-calls,' and having stepped across, he bastes with clarified butter the dhruvā spoon, the clotted butter, and the omentum, but not the upabhṛt spoon.

1.8.4.s: kṛtākṛtāv ājyabhāgau /
1.8.4.d: कृताकृताव् आज्यभागौ /

1.8.4.s: āgneyena pracaryāpareṇa srugdaṇḍān dakṣiṇātikramya saumyena pracarati /
1.8.4.d: आग्नेयेन प्रचर्यापरेण स्रुग्दण्डान् दक्षिणातिक्रम्य सौम्येन प्रचरति /
1.8.4.m: Having performed [the rite] with [the portion] belonging to Agni, having stepped to the south behind the handles of the offering spoons, he performs [the rite] with [the portion] belonging to Soma.

1.8.4.s: ata eva tiṣṭhann upastīryāvadyati hiraṇyaśakalam̐ vapām̐ hiraṇyaśakalaṃ tato 'bhighārayati //
1.8.4.d: अत एव तिष्ठन्न् उपस्तीर्यावद्यति हिरण्यशकलम्̐ वपाम्̐ हिरण्यशकलं ततो ऽभिघारयति //
1.8.4.m: Standing right there, having spread an underlayer [of butter], he cuts off a piece of gold, the omentum, and a piece of gold; then he bastes [it] with clarified butter.

1.8.4.s: indrāgnibhyāṃ chāgasya vapāyā medaso 'nubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati /
1.8.4.d: इन्द्राग्निभ्यां छागस्य वपाया मेदसो ऽनुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति /
1.8.4.m: With: 'Recite [the invitatory verse] for Indra and Agni, for the fat of the goat's omentum,' he causes [the hotṛ] to recite.

1.8.4.s: āśrāvya \\ indrāgnibhyāṃ chāgasya vapāyā medasaḥ preṣya \\ iti pracarati //
1.8.4.d: आश्राव्य \\ इन्द्राग्निभ्यां छागस्य वपाया मेदसः प्रेष्य \\ इति प्रचरति //
1.8.4.m: Having caused [the āgnīdhra] to announce, he proceeds with: 'Prompt [the hotṛ to recite] for Indra and Agni, for the fat of the goat's omentum.'

1.8.4.s: svāhā devebhyas \\ iti purastād vapāyā juhuyāt \\ viśvebhyo devebhyaḥ svāhā \\ ity upariṣṭāt /
1.8.4.d: स्वाहा देवेभ्यस् \\ इति पुरस्ताद् वपाया जुहुयात् \\ विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यः स्वाहा \\ इत्य् उपरिष्टात् /
1.8.4.m: He may offer with: 'Svāhā to the gods,' before the omentum, and with: 'To the All-gods, svāhā,' after it.

1.8.4.s:
jātavedo vapayā gacha devān\ tvam̐ hi hotā prathamo babhūva /
ghṛtasyāgne tanvā saṃbhava \ satyāḥ santu yajamānasya kāmāḥ / svāhā //
iti pratinigadya vaṣaṭkṛte vapāṃ juhoti /
1.8.4.d:
जातवेदो वपया गछ देवान्\ त्वम्̐ हि होता प्रथमो बभूव /
घृतस्याग्ने तन्वा संभव \ सत्याः सन्तु यजमानस्य कामाः / स्वाहा //
इति प्रतिनिगद्य वषट्कृते वपां जुहोति /

1.8.4.s: atyākramya yathādevatam āśasane paśum abhighārayati //
1.8.4.d: अत्याक्रम्य यथादेवतम् आशसने पशुम् अभिघारयति //
1.8.4.m: Having stepped across, he bastes the animal at the slaughter-place with clarified butter according to the divinity.

1.8.4.s: svāhordhvanabhasam iti vapāśrapaṇyau praharati prācīm ekaśṛṅgāṃ pratīcīṃ dviśṛṅgām /
1.8.4.d: स्वाहोर्ध्वनभसम् इति वपाश्रपण्यौ प्रहरति प्राचीम् एकशृङ्गां प्रतीचीं द्विशृङ्गाम् /
1.8.4.m: With: 'Svāhā to him of high clouds,' he throws the two omentum-spits [into the fire], the single-pronged one pointing east, the two-pronged one pointing west.

1.8.4.s: saṃpātenābhijuhoti /
1.8.4.d: संपातेनाभिजुहोति /

1.8.4.s:
idam āpaḥ pravahata \ yat kiṃcid duritaṃ mayi /
yad vāham abhidudroha \ yad vā śepa utānṛtam //
iti cātvāle mārjayitvā brāhmaṇām̐s tarpaya \\ iti preṣyati /
1.8.4.d:
इदम् आपः प्रवहत \ यत् किंचिद् दुरितं मयि /
यद् वाहम् अभिदुद्रोह \ यद् वा शेप उतानृतम् //
इति चात्वाले मार्जयित्वा ब्राह्मणाम्̐स् तर्पय \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
1.8.4.m:
With: 'Carry away, O waters, whatever wrong is in me,

or whatever harm I have done, or whatever curse or falsehood I have spoken'—

having cleansed himself at the cātvāla trench with this, he commands: 'Satiate the brāhmaṇas.'

1.8.4.s: [ uttarataḥ śāmitrasya ] ūvadhyaṃ garte pravidhyati /
1.8.4.d: [ उत्तरतः शामित्रस्य ] ऊवध्यं गर्ते प्रविध्यति /
1.8.4.m: [To the north of the slaughterer's fire] he casts the stomach contents into a pit.

1.8.4.s: gudam aparyāvartayann avadānāni śrapayati / savyadakṣiṇāni prajñātāni / śūle hṛdayam /
1.8.4.d: गुदम् अपर्यावर्तयन्न् अवदानानि श्रपयति / सव्यदक्षिणानि प्रज्ञातानि / शूले हृदयम् /
1.8.4.m: Without turning the intestine over, he cooks the portions; the left and right ones are distinguished; the heart on a spit.

1.8.5.s: srucam̐ śūrpaṃ cādāyādhvaryuḥ pratyupakrāmati /
1.8.5.d: स्रुचम्̐ शूर्पं चादायाध्वर्युः प्रत्युपक्रामति /
1.8.5.m: Taking the offering spoon and the winnowing basket, the adhvaryu priest steps back.

1.8.5.s: vrīhīṇāṃ paśupuroḍāśam anunirvapati samānadevataṃ paśunaikādaśakapālaṃ dvādaśakapālam̐ vā /
1.8.5.d: व्रीहीणां पशुपुरोडाशम् अनुनिर्वपति समानदेवतं पशुनैकादशकपालं द्वादशकपालम्̐ वा /
1.8.5.m: He apportions supplementary rice for the animal sacrificial cake, sharing the same deity with the animal, on eleven potsherds or on twelve potsherds.

1.8.5.s: na pātrāṇi prokṣati / nājyaṃ nirvapati /
1.8.5.d: न पात्राणि प्रोक्षति / नाज्यं निर्वपति /
1.8.5.m: He does not sprinkle the vessels; he does not apportion clarified butter.

1.8.5.s: paścād uttaraveder vyuhyauṣadhīḥ piṣṭalepaṃ ninayati /
1.8.5.d: पश्चाद् उत्तरवेदेर् व्युह्यौषधीः पिष्टलेपं निनयति /
1.8.5.m: Behind the uttaravedi, having pushed aside the plants, he pours down the dough-scrapings.

1.8.5.s: alaṃkṛtya juhūpabhṛtor avadāya \\ indrāgnibhyāṃ puroḍāśasyānubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati /
1.8.5.d: अलंकृत्य जुहूपभृतोर् अवदाय \\ इन्द्राग्निभ्यां पुरोडाशस्यानुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति /
1.8.5.m: Having decorated [it] and having cut portions into the juhū and upabhṛt ladles, he causes [the hotṛ] to recite: 'Recite [the invitatory verse] for Indra and Agni, for the sacrificial cake.'

1.8.5.s: āśrāvya \\ indrāgnibhyāṃ puroḍāśasya preṣya \\ iti pracarati /
1.8.5.d: आश्राव्य \\ इन्द्राग्निभ्यां पुरोडाशस्य प्रेष्य \\ इति प्रचरति /
1.8.5.m: Having caused [the āgnīdhra] to announce, he proceeds with: 'Prompt [the hotṛ to recite] for Indra and Agni, for the sacrificial cake.'

1.8.5.s: aupabhṛtaṃ juhvām ānīya \\ agnaye puroḍāśasyānubrūhi \\ agnaye puroḍāśasya preṣya \\ iti pracarati /
1.8.5.d: औपभृतं जुह्वाम् आनीय \\ अग्नये पुरोडाशस्यानुब्रूहि \\ अग्नये पुरोडाशस्य प्रेष्य \\ इति प्रचरति /
1.8.5.m: Having poured the contents of the upabhṛt into the juhū, he proceeds with: 'Recite [the invitatory verse] for Agni, for the sacrificial cake,' and 'Prompt [the hotṛ to recite] for Agni, for the sacrificial cake.'

1.8.5.s: āgnīdhrabhāgam apāyātyeḍāyai puroḍāśaṃ pratyābhighārayati /
1.8.5.d: आग्नीध्रभागम् अपायात्येडायै पुरोडाशं प्रत्याभिघारयति /
1.8.5.m: Having set aside the portion for the āgnīdhra priest, he bastes the sacrificial cake again for the iḍā portion.

1.8.5.s: dākṣiṇāgnikau homau hutvā kapālāni vimuñcati /
1.8.5.d: दाक्षिणाग्निकौ होमौ हुत्वा कपालानि विमुञ्चति /
1.8.5.m: Having offered the two oblations at the southern fire, he unburdens the potsherds.

1.8.5.s: śṛteṣv avadāneṣu pratiprasthātā pṛṣadājyasya sruveṇopahatya vedopayāmaḥ śṛtam̐ haviḥ śamitās \\ iti pṛchati // śṛtam iti pratyāha / samayārdhe dvitīyaṃ prāpya tṛtīyam //
1.8.5.d: शृतेष्व् अवदानेषु प्रतिप्रस्थाता पृषदाज्यस्य स्रुवेणोपहत्य वेदोपयामः शृतम्̐ हविः शमितास् \\ इति पृछति // शृतम् इति प्रत्याह / समयार्धे द्वितीयं प्राप्य तृतीयम् //
1.8.5.m: When the portions are cooked, the pratiprasthātṛ priest, having drawn [clotted butter] with the sruva-spoon from the clotted butter, holding the veda-broom as an underlayer, asks: 'Slaughterer, is the oblation cooked?' He replies: 'Cooked.' [He asks] a second time at the middle, and a third time when it has arrived [at full readiness].

1.8.5.s: svāhoṣmaṇo 'vyathiṣe \\ ity ūṣmāṇam anumantrayate /
1.8.5.d: स्वाहोष्मणो ऽव्यथिषे \\ इत्य् ऊष्माणम् अनुमन्त्रयते /
1.8.5.m: With: 'Svāhā! You are not harmed by the heat,' he accompanies the steam.

1.8.5.s: hṛdayam avadāneṣu kṛtvā śūlaṃ nidadhāty aspṛśan pratiṣiddhāni /
1.8.5.d: हृदयम् अवदानेषु कृत्वा शूलं निदधात्य् अस्पृशन् प्रतिषिद्धानि /
1.8.5.m: Having placed the heart among the portions, he puts down the spit without touching the forbidden parts.

1.8.5.s: uttarataḥ parikramya juṣṭaṃ devebhyas \\ iti yathādevataṃ paśum abhighārayati /
1.8.5.d: उत्तरतः परिक्रम्य जुष्टं देवेभ्यस् \\ इति यथादेवतं पशुम् अभिघारयति /
1.8.5.m: Having circumambulated from the north, he bastes the animal with clarified butter according to the divinity, with: 'Pleasing to the gods.'

1.8.5.s: vivājināni kṛtvāntarāgnim̐ yūpaṃ ca harati /
1.8.5.d: विवाजिनानि कृत्वान्तराग्निम्̐ यूपं च हरति /
1.8.5.m: Having divided them by their parts, he carries them between the fire and the sacrificial post.

1.8.5.s: dakṣiṇataḥ pratiprasthātā pañcahotrā [ uttarato ] barhiṣy upasādayati /
1.8.5.d: दक्षिणतः प्रतिप्रस्थाता पञ्चहोत्रा [ उत्तरतो ] बर्हिष्य् उपसादयति /
1.8.5.m: The pratiprasthātṛ priest, being to the south, sets [them] down on the sacrificial grass [to the north] with the Pañcahotṛ formula.

1.8.5.s: upastṛṇāti juhvām upabhṛtīḍāpātryām̐ vasāhomahavanyām /
1.8.5.d: उपस्तृणाति जुह्वाम् उपभृतीडापात्र्याम्̐ वसाहोमहवन्याम् /
1.8.5.m: He spreads [a base of clarified butter] into the juhū ladle, into the upabhṛt ladle, into the iḍā platter, [and] into the ladle for the omentum/fat-offering.

1.8.5.s: juhvām̐ hiraṇyaśakalam avadhāya manotāyai haviṣo 'vadīyamānasyānubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati /
1.8.5.d: जुह्वाम्̐ हिरण्यशकलम् अवधाय मनोतायै हविषो ऽवदीयमानस्यानुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति /
1.8.5.m: Having placed a piece of gold in the juhū, he causes [the hotṛ] to recite: 'For Manotā, recite for the oblation that is being cut off.'

1.8.5.s: utsādato 'ṅgānāṃ plakṣaśākhāyā adhi svadhitinā dvirdvir avadyati hṛdayāj jihvāyāḥ kroḍāt savyāt kapilalāṭāt pārśvayor yakno vṛkkayor dakṣiṇasyāḥ śroṇeḥ pūrvārdhāt gudaṃ tredhā vibhajya tasyāṇīyasaḥ /
1.8.5.d: उत्सादतो ऽङ्गानां प्लक्षशाखाया अधि स्वधितिना द्विर्द्विर् अवद्यति हृदयाज् जिह्वायाः क्रोडात् सव्यात् कपिललाटात् पार्श्वयोर् यक्नो वृक्कयोर् दक्षिणस्याः श्रोणेः पूर्वार्धात् गुदं त्रेधा विभज्य तस्याणीयसः /
1.8.5.m: Cutting from the limbs upon the plakṣa branch, he cuts twice each with the sacrificial knife: from the heart, from the tongue, from the breast, from the left flank, from both sides, from the liver, from the kidneys, from the front part of the right haunch, and having divided the rectum into three parts, from the thinnest part of it.

1.8.5.s: upabhṛti tryaṅgāṇām̐ sviṣṭakṛte samavadyati dakṣiṇasya kapilalāṭasya pūrvārdhād gudasya madhyāt savyāyāḥ śroṇeḥ paścārdhāt /
1.8.5.d: उपभृति त्र्यङ्गाणाम्̐ स्विष्टकृते समवद्यति दक्षिणस्य कपिललाटस्य पूर्वार्धाद् गुदस्य मध्यात् सव्यायाः श्रोणेः पश्चार्धात् /
1.8.5.m: Into the upabhṛt, he cuts together [portions] of the three limbs for the Sviṣṭakṛt: from the front part of the right flank, from the middle of the rectum, [and] from the rear part of the left haunch.

1.8.5.s: anasthīnāṃ daivatānām iḍām avadāya yūṣeṇopasiñcati //
1.8.5.d: अनस्थीनां दैवतानाम् इडाम् अवदाय यूषेणोपसिञ्चति //
1.8.5.m: Having cut off the iḍā from the boneless parts offered to the deities, he moistens it with the broth.

1.8.5.s: apām oṣadīnām̐ rasas \\ iti svadhitinā yūṣam āyauti
1.8.5.d: अपाम् ओषदीनाम्̐ रसस् \\ इति स्वधितिना यूषम् आयौति
1.8.5.m: With the formula, 'Sap of the waters, of the plants,' he stirs the broth with the sacrificial knife.

1.8.5.s: tasmin medaḥ paryasyati /
1.8.5.d: तस्मिन् मेदः पर्यस्यति /
1.8.5.m: In it, he turns over the fat.

1.8.5.s: tredhāvadyati juhvām upabhṛtīḍāpātryām /
1.8.5.d: त्रेधावद्यति जुह्वाम् उपभृतीडापात्र्याम् /
1.8.5.m: He cuts it into three parts: into the juhū, into the upabhṛt, [and] into the iḍā platter.

1.8.5.s: vasāhomahavanyām̐ reḍ asi \\ iti vasāhomaṃ gṛhītvā pārśvenāpidadhāti /
1.8.5.d: वसाहोमहवन्याम्̐ रेड् असि \\ इति वसाहोमं गृहीत्वा पार्श्वेनापिदधाति /
1.8.5.m: Having taken up the fat-offering in the fat-offering ladle with the formula, 'You are bright,' he covers it with the rib.

1.8.5.s: juhvām̐ hiraṇyaśakalam avadhāyābhighārayati dvir upabhṛtam //
1.8.5.d: जुह्वाम्̐ हिरण्यशकलम् अवधायाभिघारयति द्विर् उपभृतम् //
1.8.5.m: Having placed a piece of gold in the juhū, he bastes [it] with clarified butter; twice [he bastes] the upabhṛt.

1.8.5.s: indrāgnibhyāṃ chāgasya haviṣo 'nubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati /
1.8.5.d: इन्द्राग्निभ्यां छागस्य हविषो ऽनुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति /
1.8.5.m: He causes [the hotṛ] to recite: 'For Indra and Agni, recite for the goat oblation.'

1.8.5.s: āśrāvya \\ indrāgnibhyāṃ chāgasya haviṣaḥ preṣya \\ iti pracarati /
1.8.5.d: आश्राव्य \\ इन्द्राग्निभ्यां छागस्य हविषः प्रेष्य \\ इति प्रचरति /
1.8.5.m: Having called for the response, he proceeds [giving the command]: 'For Indra and Agni, summon for the goat oblation.'

1.8.5.s: ardharce yājyāyāḥ pratiprasthātā ghṛtaṃ ghṛtapāvānaḥ pibata \\ iti vasāhomaṃ juhoti /
1.8.5.d: अर्धर्चे याज्यायाः प्रतिप्रस्थाता घृतं घृतपावानः पिबत \\ इति वसाहोमं जुहोति /
1.8.5.m: At the half-verse of the offering verse, the pratiprasthātṛ offers the fat-offering with the formula: 'Ghee, o drinkers of ghee, drink!'

1.8.5.s: daivataiḥ pracarya vasāhomaśeṣeṇa diśaḥ pratiyajati yathā vājinena / vanaspatiṃ pṛṣadajyāsya /
1.8.5.d: दैवतैः प्रचर्य वसाहोमशेषेण दिशः प्रतियजति यथा वाजिनेन / वनस्पतिं पृषदज्यास्य /
1.8.5.m: Having proceeded with the [offerings to the] deities, he offers to the quarters with the remainder of the fat-offering, as with the vājina; for Vanaspati, [he offers] clotted butter.

1.8.5.s: sakṛd avadāya vanaspataye 'nubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati /
1.8.5.d: सकृद् अवदाय वनस्पतये ऽनुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति /
1.8.5.m: Having cut once, he causes [the hotṛ] to recite: 'For Vanaspati, recite.'

1.8.5.s: āśrāvya vanaspataye preṣya \\ iti pracarati /
1.8.5.d: आश्राव्य वनस्पतये प्रेष्य \\ इति प्रचरति /
1.8.5.m: Having called for the response, he proceeds [giving the command]: 'For Vanaspati, summon.'

1.8.5.s: aupabhṛtaṃ juhvām ānīya \\ agnaye sviṣṭakṛte 'nubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati /
1.8.5.d: औपभृतं जुह्वाम् आनीय \\ अग्नये स्विष्टकृते ऽनुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति /
1.8.5.m: Having poured [the portion from] the upabhṛt into the juhū, he causes [the hotṛ] to recite: 'For Agni Sviṣṭakṛt, recite.'

1.8.5.s: āśrāvya \\ agnaye sviṣṭakṛte preṣya \\ iti pracarati //
1.8.5.d: आश्राव्य \\ अग्नये स्विष्टकृते प्रेष्य \\ इति प्रचरति //
1.8.5.m: Having called for the response, he proceeds [giving the command]: 'For Agni Sviṣṭakṛt, summon.'

1.8.5.s: aindraḥ prāṇas \\ ity avadānaśeṣam iḍāṃ ca saṃmṛśati /
1.8.5.d: ऐन्द्रः प्राणस् \\ इत्य् अवदानशेषम् इडां च संमृशति /
1.8.5.m: With the formula, 'The breath of Indra,' he touches the remainder of the cut portions and the iḍā.

1.8.5.s: upahūyamānāyām adhyūdhnīm̐ hotre haranti vaniṣṭhum agnīdhe /
1.8.5.d: उपहूयमानायाम् अध्यूध्नीम्̐ होत्रे हरन्ति वनिष्ठुम् अग्नीधे /
1.8.5.m: While [the iḍā] is being invoked, they bring the udder-part to the hotṛ, [and] the entrails to the āgnīdhra.

1.8.5.s: bhakṣayitvā mārjayante /
1.8.5.d: भक्षयित्वा मार्जयन्ते /
1.8.5.m: Having consumed [their shares], they cleanse themselves.

1.8.5.s: varo dakṣiṇā /
1.8.5.d: वरो दक्षिणा /

1.8.6.s: ānuyājikīm̐ samidham ādāya \\ agnīd aupayajān aṅgārān āhara \\ upayaṣṭar upasīda \ brahman prasthāsyāmaḥ \ samidham ādhāyāgnīt paridhīm̐ś cāgniṃ ca sakṛtsakṛt saṃmṛḍḍhi \\ iti preṣyati /
1.8.6.d: आनुयाजिकीम्̐ समिधम् आदाय \\ अग्नीद् औपयजान् अङ्गारान् आहर \\ उपयष्टर् उपसीद \ ब्रह्मन् प्रस्थास्यामः \ समिधम् आधायाग्नीत् परिधीम्̐श् चाग्निं च सकृत्सकृत् संमृड्ढि \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
1.8.6.m: Taking the after-offering stick, he commands: 'O āgnīdh, bring the embers for the upoyaja offerings; o secondary sacrificer, sit down; o brahman, we shall set out; having laid on the fuel stick, o āgnīdh, cleanse the enclosing sticks and the fire once each!'

1.8.6.s: śāmitrād aṅgārān āgnīdhro 'grato hotur antarvedi nivapati / yathā preṣitaṃ ca saṃmārṣṭi /
1.8.6.d: शामित्राद् अङ्गारान् आग्नीध्रो ऽग्रतो होतुर् अन्तर्वेदि निवपति / यथा प्रेषितं च संमार्ष्टि /
1.8.6.m: The āgnīdhra scatters embers from the śāmitra fire inside the altar before the hotṛ. And he cleanses as commanded.

1.8.6.s: siddham ānuyājebhyaḥ /
1.8.6.d: सिद्धम् आनुयाजेभ्यः /

1.8.6.s: pṛṣadājyaṃ juhvām ānīyāśrāvam ekādaśānuyājān yajati //
1.8.6.d: पृषदाज्यं जुह्वाम् आनीयाश्रावम् एकादशानुयाजान् यजति //
1.8.6.m: Having poured clotted butter into the juhū and called for the response, he offers the eleven after-offerings.

1.8.6.s: devebhyaḥ preṣya \\ iti prathamam \\ preṣya preṣya \\ ity uttarān /
1.8.6.d: देवेभ्यः प्रेष्य \\ इति प्रथमम् \\ प्रेष्य प्रेष्य \\ इत्य् उत्तरान् /
1.8.6.m: 'For the gods, summon,' is the first [call]; 'Summon, summon,' for the subsequent ones.

1.8.6.s: asaṃbhindan gudasya pratiprasthātā sthavimato 'vadāya samudraṃ gacha svāhā \\ itiprabhṛtibhir vaṣaṭkāre vaṣaṭkāre juhoti //
1.8.6.d: असंभिन्दन् गुदस्य प्रतिप्रस्थाता स्थविमतो ऽवदाय समुद्रं गछ स्वाहा \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् वषट्कारे वषट्कारे जुहोति //
1.8.6.m: Without severing [it completely], the pratiprasthātṛ, having cut off from the thick part of the rectum, offers at each vaṣaṭ-call with the formulas beginning with: 'Go to the sea, svāhā!'

1.8.6.s: mano hārdim̐ yacha \\ iti hṛdayadeśam ārabhya japati //
1.8.6.d: मनो हार्दिम्̐ यछ \\ इति हृदयदेशम् आरभ्य जपति //
1.8.6.m: Touching the region of the heart, he mutters: 'Restrain the mind, the heart.'

1.8.6.s: oṣadhībhyas tvā \\ iti darbheṣu lepaṃ nimārṣṭi /
1.8.6.d: ओषधीभ्यस् त्वा \\ इति दर्भेषु लेपं निमार्ष्टि /
1.8.6.m: With the formula, 'To the plants, thee,' he wipes off the ointment on the sacrificial grasses.

1.8.6.s: atyākramya saṃgṛhya svaruṃ juhvām anakty adhastāt trir upariṣṭāc ca /
1.8.6.d: अत्याक्रम्य संगृह्य स्वरुं जुह्वाम् अनक्त्य् अधस्तात् त्रिर् उपरिष्टाच् च /
1.8.6.m: Stepping across and taking the chip of the sacrificial post, he anoints it in the juhū three times below and three times above.

1.8.6.s: juhvām̐ svarum avadhāya divaṃ te dhūmo gachatu \\ iti juhoti /
1.8.6.d: जुह्वाम्̐ स्वरुम् अवधाय दिवं ते धूमो गछतु \\ इति जुहोति /
1.8.6.m: Having placed the chip in the juhū, he offers it with the formula: 'May your smoke go to heaven!'

1.8.6.s: ūrdhvam̐ svaruhomāt prāg anudeśād yūpo nopaspṛśyaḥ /
1.8.6.d: ऊर्ध्वम्̐ स्वरुहोमात् प्राग् अनुदेशाद् यूपो नोपस्पृश्यः /
1.8.6.m: After the offering of the chip, until the assignment [of the post], the sacrificial post is not to be touched.

1.8.6.s: siddham ā sūktavākāt //
1.8.6.d: सिद्धम् आ सूक्तवाकात् //

1.8.6.s: sūktā preṣya \\ iti saṃpraiṣaḥ /
1.8.6.d: सूक्ता प्रेष्य \\ इति संप्रैषः /
1.8.6.m: 'Summon for the well-spoken,' is the command.

1.8.6.s: siddhaṃ patnīsaṃyājebhyaḥ /
1.8.6.d: सिद्धं पत्नीसंयाजेभ्यः /
1.8.6.m: [The procedure] is established up to the offerings to the wives of the gods.

1.8.6.s: jāghanyā patnīḥ sam̐yājayati /
1.8.6.d: जाघन्या पत्नीः सम्̐याजयति /
1.8.6.m: He performs the offerings to the wives [of the gods] with the tail.

1.8.6.s: uttānāyā devānāṃ patnībhyo 'vadyaty agnaye gṛhapataye nīcyā uttānāyā iḍām /
1.8.6.d: उत्तानाया देवानां पत्नीभ्यो ऽवद्यत्य् अग्नये गृहपतये नीच्या उत्तानाया इडाम् /
1.8.6.m: From [the tail turned] upward, he cuts off for the wives of the gods; for Agni Gṛhapati, from [the tail turned] downward; [and] from [the tail turned] upward, the iḍā.

1.8.6.s: siddam ā samiṣṭayajurbhyaḥ /
1.8.6.d: सिद्दम् आ समिष्टयजुर्भ्यः /
1.8.6.m: [The procedure] is established up to the samiṣṭayajus formulas.

1.8.6.s: trīṇi samiṣṭayajūm̐ṣi juhoti /
1.8.6.d: त्रीणि समिष्टयजूम्̐षि जुहोति /
1.8.6.m: He offers three samiṣṭayajus formulas.

1.8.6.s: śūlenāvabhṛtham̐ yanti prāñco dakṣiṇā vā //
1.8.6.d: शूलेनावभृथम्̐ यन्ति प्राञ्चो दक्षिणा वा //
1.8.6.m: They go with the roasting spit to the final bath, toward the east or toward the south.

1.8.6.s: śug asi \ tam abhiśoca yo asmān dveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmas \\ ity ārdreṇānūdakena khanati //
1.8.6.d: शुग् असि \ तम् अभिशोच यो अस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं च वयं द्विष्मस् \\ इत्य् आर्द्रेणानूदकेन खनति //
1.8.6.m: With the formula, 'You are heat; burn him who hates us and whom we hate,' he buries it in moist ground, without water.

1.8.6.s: dhāmnodhāmnas \\ iti tad vyākhyātam /
1.8.6.d: धाम्नोधाम्नस् \\ इति तद् व्याख्यातम् /
1.8.6.m: The formula beginning with 'From every abode' has been explained.

1.8.6.s:
āśāsānaḥ saumanasam\ prajāṃ puṣṭimatho bhagam /
svagākārakṛto mahyam\ yajamānāya tiṣṭhatu //
eṣa te vāyo \ namaḥ svarubhyo bṛhadbhyo mārutebhyaḥ \ sannān māvagām \ apaścāddaghvānnaṃ bhūyāsam ity anudiśati yūpam̐ yajamānaḥ /
1.8.6.d:
आशासानः सौमनसम्\ प्रजां पुष्टिमथो भगम् /
स्वगाकारकृतो मह्यम्\ यजमानाय तिष्ठतु //
एष ते वायो \ नमः स्वरुभ्यो बृहद्भ्यो मारुतेभ्यः \ सन्नान् मावगाम् \ अपश्चाद्दघ्वान्नं भूयासम् इत्य् अनुदिशति यूपम्̐ यजमानः /
1.8.6.m:
'Praying for goodwill, offspring, nourishment, and fortune,

may that which was offered with the svagā-call stand for me, the sacrificer!'

With the formulas: 'This is yours, o Vāyu,' 'Homage to the chips, the lofty ones of the Maruts,' 'May I not fall away from the firm ground,' 'May I not be one whose food fails,' the sacrificer addresses the sacrificial post.

1.8.6.s: vediṃ paryoṣati /
1.8.6.d: वेदिं पर्योषति /

1.8.6.s: ṣaṭsuṣaṭsu māseṣu paśunā yajeta sam̐vatsaresaṃvatsare vā /
1.8.6.d: षट्सुषट्सु मासेषु पशुना यजेत सम्̐वत्सरेसंवत्सरे वा /
1.8.6.m: Every six months he should sacrifice with an animal, or every year.

1.8.6.s: nainam anījānam̐ saṃvatsaro 'tīyāt / yady atīyān na mām̐sam aśnīyād ā paśubandhāt /
1.8.6.d: नैनम् अनीजानम्̐ संवत्सरो ऽतीयात् / यद्य् अतीयान् न माम्̐सम् अश्नीयाद् आ पशुबन्धात् /
1.8.6.m: A year should not pass him by without having sacrificed. If it should pass by, he should not eat meat until the animal sacrifice.

1.8.6.s: nātipraṇīteṣu praṇītā syād anyatra vacanāt /
1.8.6.d: नातिप्रणीतेषु प्रणीता स्याद् अन्यत्र वचनात् /
1.8.6.m: Water should not be brought forward when [the fires] have been brought forward in an excessive manner, except by special statement.

1.8.6.s: viṣṇukramaprabhṛti samānam̐ yājamānam̐ yājamānam /
1.8.6.d: विष्णुक्रमप्रभृति समानम्̐ याजमानम्̐ याजमानम् /
1.8.6.m: The duties of the sacrificer, beginning with the steps of Viṣṇu, are the same.

2.1.1.d: अग्निष्टोमेन वसन्ते यजेत /
2.1.1.m: He should sacrifice with the Agniṣṭoma in the spring.

2.1.1.d: आम्नातानि देवयजनानि /
2.1.1.m: The sacrificial grounds are handed down in tradition.

2.1.1.d: प्राचीनप्रवणं नित्यार्थम् /
2.1.1.m: [The ground] sloping to the east is for the regular [sacrifice].

2.1.1.s: ṛtvijo vṛṇīte mahato yūna ārṣeyān ādityo 'dhvaryuḥ sa me 'dhvaryur \ adhvaryo tvaṃ me 'dhvaryur asi \\ ity adhvaryuṃ // candramā brahmā sa me brahmā \ brahmam̐s tvaṃ me brahmāsi \\ iti brahmāṇam agnir hotā sa me hotā \ hotas tvaṃ me hotāsi \\ iti hotāraṃ // parjanya udgātā sa ma udgātā \\ udgātas tvaṃ ma udgātāsi \\ ity udgātāraṃ // diśo hotrāśam̐sinyas tā me hotrāśam̐sinyas \\ hotrāśam̐sinyo yūyaṃ me hotrāśam̐sinyaḥ stha \\ iti dvādaśa hotṛkān //
2.1.1.d: ऋत्विजो वृणीते महतो यून आर्षेयान् आदित्यो ऽध्वर्युः स मे ऽध्वर्युर् \ अध्वर्यो त्वं मे ऽध्वर्युर् असि \\ इत्य् अध्वर्युं // चन्द्रमा ब्रह्मा स मे ब्रह्मा \ ब्रह्मम्̐स् त्वं मे ब्रह्मासि \\ इति ब्रह्माणम् अग्निर् होता स मे होता \ होतस् त्वं मे होतासि \\ इति होतारं // पर्जन्य उद्गाता स म उद्गाता \\ उद्गातस् त्वं म उद्गातासि \\ इत्य् उद्गातारं // दिशो होत्राशम्̐सिन्यस् ता मे होत्राशम्̐सिन्यस् \\ होत्राशम्̐सिन्यो यूयं मे होत्राशम्̐सिन्यः स्थ \\ इति द्वादश होतृकान् //
2.1.1.m: He chooses the officiating priests—distinguished, young, and of ṛṣi descent: 'Āditya is the adhvaryu; he is my adhvaryu; o adhvaryu, you are my adhvaryu,'—thus the adhvaryu; 'The Moon is the brahman; he is my brahman; o brahman, you are my brahman,'—thus the brahman; 'Agni is the hotṛ; he is my hotṛ; o hotṛ, you are my hotṛ,'—thus the hotṛ; 'Parjanya is the udgātṛ; he is my udgātṛ; o udgātṛ, you are my udgātṛ,'—thus the udgātṛ; 'The quarters are the hotrā-reciters; they are my hotrā-reciters; o hotrā-reciters, you are my hotrā-reciters,'—thus the twelve subordinate priests.

2.1.1.d: महो मे ऽवोचस् \\ इति वृता जपन्ति /
2.1.1.m: Having been chosen, they mutter: 'Great things have you spoken of me.'

2.1.1.s:
edam aganma devayajanaṃ pṛthivyās\ yatra devāso ajuṣanta viśve /
ṛksāmābhyām̐ saṃtaranto yajurbhis\ rāyaspoṣeṇa sam iṣā madema //
iti samūlaṃ devayajanam adhyavasyati /
2.1.1.d:
एदम् अगन्म देवयजनं पृथिव्यास्\ यत्र देवासो अजुषन्त विश्वे /
ऋक्सामाभ्याम्̐ संतरन्तो यजुर्भिस्\ रायस्पोषेण सम् इषा मदेम //
इति समूलं देवयजनम् अध्यवस्यति /

2.1.1.s: tatra prācīnavam̐śaṃ kurvanty udyataṃ purastān niyataṃ paścāt /
2.1.1.d: तत्र प्राचीनवम्̐शं कुर्वन्त्य् उद्यतं पुरस्तान् नियतं पश्चात् /
2.1.1.m: There they make a hall with beams pointing eastward, raised in front and lowered behind.

2.1.1.d: तनुमिश्रेण परिश्रयन्ति /
2.1.1.m: They enclose it with thin [mats] interwoven.

2.1.1.d: परिश्रयन्तो ऽतिरोकान् कुर्वन्ति /
2.1.1.m: While enclosing it, they leave openings for light.

2.1.1.d: दिक्षु द्वाराणि कुर्वन्ति द्विशयानि सांकाशनानि /
2.1.1.m: They make doors in the cardinal directions, having two leaves [and] providing an outlook.

2.1.1.s: pūrvayā dvārā praviśya kratunirdeśaṃ kṛtvā tasminn agnīn viharati //
2.1.1.d: पूर्वया द्वारा प्रविश्य क्रतुनिर्देशं कृत्वा तस्मिन्न् अग्नीन् विहरति //
2.1.1.m: Entering by the eastern door and having made the specification of the rite, he spreads the fires in it.

2.1.1.d: इदं दास्यामि \\ इति निर्देशः /
2.1.1.m: "I shall give this" is the specification.

2.1.1.s: daikṣam aśanam aśnīto dadhnā madhumiśreṇa yajamānaḥ patnī ca /
2.1.1.d: दैक्षम् अशनम् अश्नीतो दध्ना मधुमिश्रेण यजमानः पत्नी च /
2.1.1.m: The sacrificer and his wife eat the food proper for initiation with curd mixed with honey.

2.1.1.s: amāvāsyāyāṃ dīkṣeta yathā vā parvaṇi sutyā syāt /
2.1.1.d: अमावास्यायां दीक्षेत यथा वा पर्वणि सुत्या स्यात् /
2.1.1.m: He should be initiated on the new-moon day, or so that the pressing day will be on a lunar conjunction.

2.1.1.s: saptahotāram̐ manasānudrutya vidhe nāman \\ iti graheṇa juhoti /
2.1.1.d: सप्तहोतारम्̐ मनसानुद्रुत्य विधे नामन् \\ इति ग्रहेण जुहोति /
2.1.1.m: Having mentally recited the saptahotṛ formula, he offers with the ladle [saying]: "O name, in worship..."

2.1.1.s: dīkṣaṇīyāṃ nirvapaty āgnāvaiṣṇavam ekādaśakapālaṃ ghṛte vā carum /
2.1.1.d: दीक्षणीयां निर्वपत्य् आग्नावैष्णवम् एकादशकपालं घृते वा चरुम् /
2.1.1.m: He apportions the initiation offering: [a cake] on eleven potsherds to Agni and Viṣṇu, or a boiled oblation in clarified butter.

2.1.1.s: apaḥ praṇeṣyann agnir yajurbhir itiprabhṛtīni dvādaśa saṃbhārayajūm̐ṣi teṣāṃ catvāricatvāri nigadya juhoti /
2.1.1.d: अपः प्रणेष्यन्न् अग्निर् यजुर्भिर् इतिप्रभृतीनि द्वादश संभारयजूम्̐षि तेषां चत्वारिचत्वारि निगद्य जुहोति /
2.1.1.m: When about to lead forth the waters, he recites the twelve gathering-formulas beginning with "Agni with the formulas...", and offers them pronouncing them four by four.

2.1.1.d: पत्नीसम्̐याजान्ता दीक्षणीया संतिष्ठते /
2.1.1.m: The initiation offering concludes with the offerings to the wives of the gods.

2.1.1.s: tasyāṃ mradīyān svaro darśapaurṇamāsikān mradīyān prāyaṇīyāyāṃ mradīyān ātithyāyāṃ dhvānenopasadaḥ / sarvā upām̐śudevatāḥ /
2.1.1.d: तस्यां म्रदीयान् स्वरो दर्शपौर्णमासिकान् म्रदीयान् प्रायणीयायां म्रदीयान् आतिथ्यायां ध्वानेनोपसदः / सर्वा उपाम्̐शुदेवताः /
2.1.1.m: At it, the tone is softer than that of the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices, softer at the introductory rite, softer at the guest-offering; the upasad rites are [performed] in an undertone. All deities are [addressed] in a whisper.

2.1.1.d: सम्̐वृत्य द्वाराणि प्रचरति /
2.1.1.m: Having closed the doors, he proceeds.

2.1.1.s: uttarataḥ pṛṣṭhayādeśasya pariśritya \\ āpo devīr ity abhyundati //
2.1.1.d: उत्तरतः पृष्ठयादेशस्य परिश्रित्य \\ आपो देवीर् इत्य् अभ्युन्दति //
2.1.1.m: Having enclosed [a space] to the north of the place of the central spine, he moistens [the hair] saying: "O divine waters..."

2.1.1.s: oṣadhe trāyasvainam iti dakṣiṇasmin keśānte darbham antardadhāti //
2.1.1.d: ओषधे त्रायस्वैनम् इति दक्षिणस्मिन् केशान्ते दर्भम् अन्तर्दधाति //
2.1.1.m: He places a blade of darbha grass in the right hair-part, saying: "O herb, protect him!"

2.1.1.d: स्वधिते मैनम्̐ हिम्̐सीर् इति क्षुरेणाभिनिदधाति //
2.1.1.m: He applies the razor, saying: "O axe, do not harm him!"

2.1.1.d: देवश्रुद् इमान् प्रवपे \\ इति प्रवपते //
2.1.1.m: He shaves, saying: "Listening to the gods, I shave these [hairs]."

2.1.1.s: svasty uttaraṃ aśīya \\ iti yajamāno japati /
2.1.1.d: स्वस्त्य् उत्तरं अशीय \\ इति यजमानो जपति /
2.1.1.m: The sacrificer mutters: "May I attain well-being beyond!"

2.1.1.d: केशश्मश्रु यजमानो वापयते /
2.1.1.m: The sacrificer has his head-hair and beard shaved.

2.1.1.d: दतो धावते /

2.1.1.s: lomāni sam̐hāya nakhān kārayate / na kakṣau /
2.1.1.d: लोमानि सम्̐हाय नखान् कारयते / न कक्षौ /
2.1.1.m: Collecting the body hair, he has his nails cut, but not [the hair of] the armpits.

2.1.1.d: पत्नी नखाम्̐श् च कारयीत /
2.1.1.m: The wife also should have her nails cut.

2.1.1.s: tīrthenāvagāhya sāvakāsu hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayas iti sthāvarāsu snātvānūpamrakṣam ācamya \\ ud id ābhyaḥ śucir ā pūta emi \\ ity utkrāmati //
2.1.1.d: तीर्थेनावगाह्य सावकासु हिरण्यवर्णाः शुचयस् इति स्थावरासु स्नात्वानूपम्रक्षम् आचम्य \\ उद् इद् आभ्यः शुचिर् आ पूत एमि \\ इत्य् उत्क्रामति //
2.1.1.m: Having plunged into the water by the ford, having bathed in standing [waters] containing avakā plants, saying: "Golden-colored, pure...", having rubbed [himself] dry with water, having sipped water, he steps out, saying: "From these waters I come forth pure and cleansed."

2.1.1.d: विष्णोः शर्मासि \\ इति क्षौमम् आछादयते //
2.1.1.m: He puts on a linen garment, saying: "You are Viṣṇu's shelter."

2.1.1.d: ऊर्जे त्वा \\ इति नीवीं कुरुते /
2.1.1.m: He makes a tuck, saying: "For strength, thee!"

2.1.1.d: दैक्षं पत्नी तूष्णीम् /
स्नात्वा प्राचीनमातृकं क्षौमं पत्न्य् आछादयते //
2.1.1.m: Having bathed, the wife puts on a linen garment whose warp-threads run eastward.

2.1.1.s: mahīnāṃ payo 'si \\ iti darbhapiñjūlābhyāṃ navanītam āyauti //
2.1.1.d: महीनां पयो ऽसि \\ इति दर्भपिञ्जूलाभ्यां नवनीतम् आयौति //
2.1.1.m: He stirs the fresh butter with two darbha grass-blades, saying: "You are the milk of the great ones."

2.1.1.s: varodhā asi \\ ity anulomaṃ trirabhyaṅkte mukham agre 'tha śiraḥ / svabhyavato bhavaty ā pādābhyām /
2.1.1.d: वरोधा असि \\ इत्य् अनुलोमं त्रिरभ्यङ्क्ते मुखम् अग्रे ऽथ शिरः / स्वभ्यवतो भवत्य् आ पादाभ्याम् /
2.1.1.m: He anoints himself from head to foot three times, saying: "You are the restrainer", first the face, then the head. He becomes well-anointed down to the two feet.

2.1.1.d: शेषेण पत्न्य् अभ्यङ्क्ते /
2.1.1.m: With the remainder, the wife anoints herself.

2.1.1.s: catasṛbhir darbheṣīkābhiḥ śareṣīkābhir vā samuñjābhiḥ satūlābhir ity ekakaikayā traikakubhasyāñjanasya saṃniṣkṛṣya vṛtrasyāsi kanīnikā \\ iti dakṣiṇam akṣi trir āṅkte 'nyayānyayāniṣevayan savyaṃ ca /
2.1.1.d: चतसृभिर् दर्भेषीकाभिः शरेषीकाभिर् वा समुञ्जाभिः सतूलाभिर् इत्य् एककैकया त्रैककुभस्याञ्जनस्य संनिष्कृष्य वृत्रस्यासि कनीनिका \\ इति दक्षिणम् अक्षि त्रिर् आङ्क्ते ऽन्ययान्ययानिषेवयन् सव्यं च /
2.1.1.m: With four reeds of darbha or reeds of reed-grass, along with muñja grass and tufts, drawing out one by one [some] ointment from Mount Trikakubh, he anoints his right eye three times, saying: "You are the pupil of Vṛtra", and the left eye using another and another, without dropping it.

2.1.1.d: शेषेण पत्न्य् आङ्क्ते /

2.1.1.s: darbhapiñjūlais triḥ pāvayaty ekavim̐śatyā tredhā vibhajya citpatis tvā \\ ity ūrdhvam \\ vācaspatis tvā \\ ity avāñcam \\ devas tvā savitā \\ ity ūrdhvam achidreṇa pavitreṇa \\ iti sarvatrānuṣajati //
2.1.1.d: दर्भपिञ्जूलैस् त्रिः पावयत्य् एकविम्̐शत्या त्रेधा विभज्य चित्पतिस् त्वा \\ इत्य् ऊर्ध्वम् \\ वाचस्पतिस् त्वा \\ इत्य् अवाञ्चम् \\ देवस् त्वा सविता \\ इत्य् ऊर्ध्वम् अछिद्रेण पवित्रेण \\ इति सर्वत्रानुषजति //
2.1.1.m: He purifies [him] three times with twenty-one darbha grass-blades, dividing them into three parts, upwards saying: "May the lord of thought [purify] you", downwards saying: "May the lord of speech [purify] you", upwards saying: "May the divine Savitṛ [purify] you", appending everywhere: "with an undamaged strainer."

2.1.1.s: tasya te pavitrapate pavitreṇa \\ iti yajamāno japati /
2.1.1.d: तस्य ते पवित्रपते पवित्रेण \\ इति यजमानो जपति /
2.1.1.m: The sacrificer mutters: "Of that strainer-lord, with your strainer..."

2.1.1.d: न प्राणान् अतिपावयेत् /
यं द्विष्यात् तम् अक्ष्णया पावयेत् /
2.1.1.m: He whom he might hate, him he should purify diagonally.

2.1.1.s: pūrvayā dvārā yajamānaṃ prapādyottareṇāhavanīyaṃ parikramya paścād āhavanīyasyopaveśayati /
2.1.1.d: पूर्वया द्वारा यजमानं प्रपाद्योत्तरेणाहवनीयं परिक्रम्य पश्चाद् आहवनीयस्योपवेशयति /
2.1.1.m: Having made the sacrificer enter through the eastern door and having walked around to the north of the āhavanīya fire, he seats him behind the āhavanīya fire.

2.1.1.s: pratiprasthātā tūṣṇīṃ patnīṃ pāvayitvāparayā dvārā prapādya dakṣiṇataḥpaścād aparasya patnīlokam upasthāpyopaveśayati /
2.1.1.d: प्रतिप्रस्थाता तूष्णीं पत्नीं पावयित्वापरया द्वारा प्रपाद्य दक्षिणतःपश्चाद् अपरस्य पत्नीलोकम् उपस्थाप्योपवेशयति /
2.1.1.m: The pratiprasthātṛ priest, having silently purified the wife and made her enter through the western door, having made her stand south of the western [fire] in the place of the wife, seats her.

2.1.2.s: ākūtyai prayuje \\ iti sruveṇādhītayajūm̐ṣi juhoti // āpo devīr iti srucā pañcamīm / ṣaṣṭhīṃ dvādaśagṛhītāṃ pūrṇāhutim \\ viśvo devasya netur iti nigadya juhoti /
2.1.2.d: आकूत्यै प्रयुजे \\ इति स्रुवेणाधीतयजूम्̐षि जुहोति // आपो देवीर् इति स्रुचा पञ्चमीम् / षष्ठीं द्वादशगृहीतां पूर्णाहुतिम् \\ विश्वो देवस्य नेतुर् इति निगद्य जुहोति /
2.1.2.m: With the dipping spoon he offers the learned formulas, saying: "For intention, for the yoke-mate..."; the fifth with the offering ladle, saying: "O divine waters..."; the sixth, a full-spoon offering taken twelve times, he offers having pronounced: "Of every divine leader..."

2.1.2.s: paścād āhavanīyasya kṛṣṇājine mām̐sataḥ samasya prāggrīve lomataḥ sam̐stṛṇāti /
2.1.2.d: पश्चाद् आहवनीयस्य कृष्णाजिने माम्̐सतः समस्य प्राग्ग्रीवे लोमतः सम्̐स्तृणाति /
2.1.2.m: Behind the āhavanīya fire, he spreads out two black antelope skins, joined flesh-side to flesh-side, with the necks pointing eastward, hair-side [upwards].

2.1.2.s: yady ekam̐ syād dakṣiṇaṃ kṛṣṇājinapādaṃ mām̐sataḥ samasya pratiṣīvyet //
2.1.2.d: यद्य् एकम्̐ स्याद् दक्षिणं कृष्णाजिनपादं माम्̐सतः समस्य प्रतिषीव्येत् //
2.1.2.m: If there should be only one, he should sew together the right foot of the black antelope skin, joining it flesh-side to [flesh-side].

2.1.2.s: ṛksāmayoḥ śilpe sthas \\ iti kṛṣṇaśukle rājī saṃmṛśati //
2.1.2.d: ऋक्सामयोः शिल्पे स्थस् \\ इति कृष्णशुक्ले राजी संमृशति //
2.1.2.m: He touches the black and white stripes, saying: "You two are the artworks of the ṛgveda and the sāmaveda."

2.1.2.s: viṣṇoḥ śarmāsi \\ iti bhasata ārohati //
2.1.2.d: विष्णोः शर्मासि \\ इति भसत आरोहति //
2.1.2.m: He steps onto the hind-part, saying: "You are Viṣṇu's shelter."

2.1.2.s: sūryāgnī dyāvāpṛthivī iti prāñjalir japati /
2.1.2.d: सूर्याग्नी द्यावापृथिवी इति प्राञ्जलिर् जपति /
2.1.2.m: With folded hands he mutters: "O sun and Agni, heaven and earth..."

2.1.2.s:
jālam ubhayataḥpāśaṃ patnyāḥ śirasy āmucya
saṃ tvā nahyāmi payasā pṛthivyāḥ \ saṃ tvā nahyāmy adbhir oṣadhībhiḥ /
saṃ tvā nahyāmi prajayā dhanena \ sā dīkṣitā sanavo vācam asmāt //
iti pratiprasthātā yoktreṇa patnīm̐ saṃnahyati /
2.1.2.d:
जालम् उभयतःपाशं पत्न्याः शिरस्य् आमुच्य
सं त्वा नह्यामि पयसा पृथिव्याः \ सं त्वा नह्याम्य् अद्भिर् ओषधीभिः /
सं त्वा नह्यामि प्रजया धनेन \ सा दीक्षिता सनवो वाचम् अस्मात् //
इति प्रतिप्रस्थाता योक्त्रेण पत्नीम्̐ संनह्यति /
2.1.2.m:
Having placed a net with loops on both sides on the wife's head,

"I gird you with the sap of the earth; / I gird you with the waters, with the herbs;

I gird you with offspring, with wealth; / as an initiated woman, may you win speech from this [sacrificer]!"

saying thus, the pratiprasthātṛ priest girds the wife with a girdle-cord.

2.1.2.s: mekhalāṃ dīkṣito mauñjīṃ pṛthvīṃ triguṇām̐ samastām udakpāśām ūrg asi \\ ity ābadhnāti /
2.1.2.d: मेखलां दीक्षितो मौञ्जीं पृथ्वीं त्रिगुणाम्̐ समस्ताम् उदक्पाशाम् ऊर्ग् असि \\ इत्य् आबध्नाति /
2.1.2.m: The initiated one ties around himself a broad, threefold, intertwined girdle of muñja grass, with the loop turned north, saying: "You are sap."

2.1.2.s: ucyarti granthiṃ karoti /
2.1.2.d: उच्यर्ति ग्रन्थिं करोति /
2.1.2.m: He ties a knot that pulls upward.

2.1.2.s: ayugmavalīṃ kṛṣṇaviṣāṇām ādāya \\ indrasya yonir asi \\ iti viṣāṇām anumantrayate //
2.1.2.d: अयुग्मवलीं कृष्णविषाणाम् आदाय \\ इन्द्रस्य योनिर् असि \\ इति विषाणाम् अनुमन्त्रयते //
2.1.2.m: Taking a black antelope horn with an odd number of rings, he accompanies the horn with the mantra: "You are the womb of Indra."

2.1.2.s: kṛṣim̐ susasyām utkṛṣe \\ iti viṣāṇayā bahirvedi prācīm uddhanti //
2.1.2.d: कृषिम्̐ सुसस्याम् उत्कृषे \\ इति विषाणया बहिर्वेदि प्राचीम् उद्धन्ति //
2.1.2.m: He digs up [the ground] eastward outside the altar with the horn, saying: "For agriculture producing good crops, I dig."

2.1.2.s: viṣāṇe viṣya \\ iti sicyābadhnāti /
2.1.2.d: विषाणे विष्य \\ इति सिच्याबध्नाति /
2.1.2.m: He ties it to the fringe of his garment, saying: "O horn, loosen [the knot]!"

2.1.2.s: tayā kaṇḍūyate kṛṣim̐ susasyām utkṛṣe \\ ity aṅgāni supippalā oṣadhīs kṛdhi \\ iti śiraḥ /
2.1.2.d: तया कण्डूयते कृषिम्̐ सुसस्याम् उत्कृषे \\ इत्य् अङ्गानि सुपिप्पला ओषधीस् कृधि \\ इति शिरः /
2.1.2.m: With it he scratches himself: his limbs saying: "For agriculture producing good crops, I dig", his head saying: "Make the herbs possess good fruit!"

2.1.2.s: vānaspatyena śaṅkunā patnnī kaṇḍūyeta /
2.1.2.d: वानस्पत्येन शङ्कुना पत्न्नी कण्डूयेत /
2.1.2.m: The wife should scratch herself with a wooden peg.

2.1.2.s: audumbaram āsyadaghnaṃ daṇḍam agreṇāhavanīyaṃ paryāhṛtya bṛhann asi vānaspatyas \\ iti yajamānāya prayachati //
2.1.2.d: औदुम्बरम् आस्यदघ्नं दण्डम् अग्रेणाहवनीयं पर्याहृत्य बृहन्न् असि वानस्पत्यस् \\ इति यजमानाय प्रयछति //
2.1.2.m: Having brought around the staff of udumbara wood, reaching up to the mouth, in front of the āhavanīya fire, he hands it to the sacrificer, saying: "Great are you, made of wood."

2.1.2.s: sūpasthā asi vānaspatyas \\ ūrjo mā pāhy odṛcam iti pratigṛhṇāti //
2.1.2.d: सूपस्था असि वानस्पत्यस् \\ ऊर्जो मा पाह्य् ओदृचम् इति प्रतिगृह्णाति //
2.1.2.m: He accepts it, saying: "You are easy to lean upon, made of wood; protect me from exhaustion until the end."

2.1.2.s: nakṣatrāṇāṃ mātīkāśāt \\ ity uttarāntena prorṇute //
2.1.2.d: नक्षत्राणां मातीकाशात् \\ इत्य् उत्तरान्तेन प्रोर्णुते //
2.1.2.m: He covers his head with the upper fringe of the garment, saying: "May I not be visible to the stars!"

2.1.2.s: ā vo devāsa īmahe \\ iti japati /
2.1.2.d: आ वो देवास ईमहे \\ इति जपति /
2.1.2.m: He mutters: "Unto you, O gods, we approach..."

2.1.2.s: nāpachādayed ā krayāt //
2.1.2.d: नापछादयेद् आ क्रयात् //

2.1.2.s: svāhā yajñaṃ manasas \\ itiprabhṛtibhir aṅgulī dvedve nibhujan muṣṭī kurute / vācam̐ yachati /
2.1.2.d: स्वाहा यज्ञं मनसस् \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् अङ्गुली द्वेद्वे निभुजन् मुष्टी कुरुते / वाचम्̐ यछति /
2.1.2.m: With [the formulas] beginning with “Svāhā, the sacrifice from the mind…”, bending two fingers at a time, he makes fists [and] restrains his speech.

2.1.2.s: tūṣṇīṃ patnī muṣṭī kṛtvā vācam̐ yachati /
2.1.2.d: तूष्णीं पत्नी मुष्टी कृत्वा वाचम्̐ यछति /
2.1.2.m: Silently having made fists, the wife restrains her speech.

2.1.2.s: lomataḥ kṛṣṇājinam āchādayeta / yadi dve viṣūcī pratimucya /
2.1.2.d: लोमतः कृष्णाजिनम् आछादयेत / यदि द्वे विषूची प्रतिमुच्य /
2.1.2.m: He should put on the black antelope skin with the hair turned inwards; if there are two, having fastened them facing opposite directions.

2.1.2.s: agreṇa prāgvam̐śaṃ dīkṣitam anvārabdham āvedayati // dīkṣito 'yam asau \\ iti nāma gṛhṇāti \\ āmuṣyāyaṇas \\ iti gotram amuṣya putras \\ iti pitur nāmnā \\ amuṣya pautras \\ iti pitāmahasya \\ amuṣya naptā \\ iti prapitāmahasya // sa indrāgnibhyāṃ dīkṣāṃ prāha \ mitrāvaruṇābhyāṃ dīkṣāṃ prāha \ viśvebhyo devebhyo brāhmaṇebhyaḥ somyebhyaḥ somapebhyo dīkṣāṃ prāha \\ iti /
2.1.2.d: अग्रेण प्राग्वम्̐शं दीक्षितम् अन्वारब्धम् आवेदयति // दीक्षितो ऽयम् असौ \\ इति नाम गृह्णाति \\ आमुष्यायणस् \\ इति गोत्रम् अमुष्य पुत्रस् \\ इति पितुर् नाम्ना \\ अमुष्य पौत्रस् \\ इति पितामहस्य \\ अमुष्य नप्ता \\ इति प्रपितामहस्य // स इन्द्राग्निभ्यां दीक्षां प्राह \ मित्रावरुणाभ्यां दीक्षां प्राह \ विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यो ब्राह्मणेभ्यः सोम्येभ्यः सोमपेभ्यो दीक्षां प्राह \\ इति /
2.1.2.m: In front of the hall with rafters pointing east, he announces the consecrated sacrificer who holds on to him: “This N.N. has become consecrated,” he mentions his name; “descendant of N.N.,” the gotra; “son of N.N.,” with the name of the father; “grandson of N.N.,” of the grandfather; “great-grandson of N.N.,” of the great-grandfather. “He has announced his consecration to Indra and Agni; he has announced his consecration to Mitra and Varuṇa; he has announced his consecration to the Viśve Devas, to the brāhmaṇas rich in Soma, drinking Soma.”

2.1.2.s: evam uccais trir āvedayati //
2.1.2.d: एवम् उच्चैस् त्रिर् आवेदयति //
2.1.2.m: Thus he announces aloud three times.

2.1.2.s: eṣṭrīḥ stha \\ iti tisro 'nyasya pāṇer aṅgulīr utsṛjati tisro 'nyasya /
2.1.2.d: एष्ट्रीः स्थ \\ इति तिस्रो ऽन्यस्य पाणेर् अङ्गुलीर् उत्सृजति तिस्रो ऽन्यस्य /
2.1.2.m: With “You are seekers,” he releases three fingers of one hand and three of the other.

2.1.2.s: tūṣṇīṃ patnī //
2.1.2.d: तूष्णीं पत्नी //

2.1.2.s: nakṣatrāṇām̐ sakāśāt \\ iti nakṣatraṃ dṛṣṭvā vācam̐ visṛjate // vrataṃ carata \ yāḥ paśūnām ity udite /
2.1.2.d: नक्षत्राणाम्̐ सकाशात् \\ इति नक्षत्रं दृष्ट्वा वाचम्̐ विसृजते // व्रतं चरत \ याः पशूनाम् इत्य् उदिते /
2.1.2.m: Having seen a constellation with “From the presence of the constellations…,” he releases his speech, [or] when it has risen, with “Observe the vow, which of the animals…”.

2.1.2.s: maṅgalyam uktvā patnī vācam̐ visṛjate /
2.1.2.d: मङ्गल्यम् उक्त्वा पत्नी वाचम्̐ विसृजते /
2.1.2.m: Having spoken an auspicious word, the wife releases her speech.

2.1.2.s: na pratyakṣanāmnācakṣīta // canasita \\ ity arhatā saha saṃbhāṣamāṇo brūyāt \\ vicakṣaṇa \\ itītaraiḥ /
2.1.2.d: न प्रत्यक्षनाम्नाचक्षीत // चनसित \\ इत्य् अर्हता सह संभाषमाणो ब्रूयात् \\ विचक्षण \\ इतीतरैः /
2.1.2.m: He should not address [the consecrated one] by his actual name. Conversing with an arhat, he should say “O Canasita”; with others, “O Vicakṣaṇa”.

2.1.2.s: dīkṣitasaṃcaraḥ / uttareṇāhavanīyam apareṇa vediṃ dakṣiṇātikramya dakṣiṇata āhavanīyasyodaṅmukha upaviśaty eṣa saṃcaraḥ /
2.1.2.d: दीक्षितसंचरः / उत्तरेणाहवनीयम् अपरेण वेदिं दक्षिणातिक्रम्य दक्षिणत आहवनीयस्योदङ्मुख उपविशत्य् एष संचरः /
2.1.2.m: The movement of the consecrated one: passing to the north of the āhavanīya fire, to the west of the altar, along the south, he sits down to the south of the āhavanīya fire facing north; this is the movement.

2.1.2.s: lomataḥ kṛṣṇājinasya śayyāsanam āchādanaṃ ca /
2.1.2.d: लोमतः कृष्णाजिनस्य शय्यासनम् आछादनं च /
